related.differenceEn: Hoover is an arch-gravity dam and Three Gorges a gravity dam, differing in valley shape, load paths, spillway and navigation conditions.
practice: 畫出向兩岸與向基礎傳力的差別
比較大體積混凝土熱量管理
列出不能依壩高直接推估的效能
practiceEn: Compare load transfer toward abutments and foundations
Compare mass-concrete heat management
List performance that dam height alone cannot predict

related.transfer: 爐內均勻性影響氧化及擴散；快速熱處理改變時間尺度而非取消熱物理。
related.transferEn: Furnace uniformity affects oxidation and diffusion; rapid processing changes timescales rather than removing thermal physics.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓；「熱氧化閘極介電層」則以氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles; Thermally grown gate dielectrics treats oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出擴散爐均勻性控制與熱氧化閘極介電層之間的材料或資料交接
用「批次位置圖」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓的觀察，說明還需哪個熱氧化閘極介電層證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Diffusion-furnace uniformity control and Thermally grown gate dielectrics
Use map batch positions to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles and state which additional Thermally grown gate dielectrics evidence is needed for acceptance

related.transfer: CFET 把奈米片元件與背面接觸需求連在一起。

related.difference: 本課驗收重點是上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸；「環繞閘極奈米片電晶體」則以片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts; Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors treats inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.

practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Complementary FET research process flows and Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors
Use draw vertical complementary stacking to identify one shared and one different boundary

courses.overview: 比較相近工法的共同原理、適用差異與驗證方式。

related.transfer: 內間隔保護源汲極，使 GAA 犧牲層能在保留通道下移除。
related.transferEn: Inner spacers protect source-drain during sacrificial-layer removal while preserving GAA channels.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護；「環繞閘極奈米片電晶體」則以片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection; Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors treats inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出奈米片內側間隔層製作與環繞閘極奈米片電晶體之間的材料或資料交接
用「內外間隔差別」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護的觀察，說明還需哪個環繞閘極奈米片電晶體證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication and Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors
Use separate inner and outer spacers to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection and state which additional Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors evidence is needed for acceptance

courses.overviewEn: Extend Interconnect electromigration reliability by comparing Copper dual-damascene interconnects and Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 互連線與通孔幾何決定局部電流密度；材料、介面與熱路徑共同影響電遷移。
related.transferEn: Line/via geometry sets local current density; materials, interfaces and thermal paths jointly affect electromigration.
related.difference: 雙鑲嵌製程建立導線；電遷移課分析通電老化。室溫導通良好不代表長期電流應力合格。
related.differenceEn: Damascene creates conductors; electromigration studies powered aging. Initial continuity does not establish lifetime under current stress.
practice: 用假設截面計算相同電流下的 J。
畫通孔轉角擁擠與可能熱點。
列出電阻漂移與截面影像的交叉證據。
practiceEn: Calculate J for equal current through hypothetical cross-sections.
Draw via-corner crowding and possible hotspots.
List cross-evidence from resistance drift and cross-sectional images.

related.why: 互連線與通孔幾何決定局部電流密度；材料、介面與熱路徑共同影響電遷移。
related.whyEn: Line/via geometry sets local current density; materials, interfaces and thermal paths jointly affect electromigration.

related.transfer: 兩者都需要失效定義、加速模型、截尾樣本與機制一致性，不能只報最長存活時間。
related.transferEn: Both require failure criteria, acceleration models, censoring and mechanism consistency, not merely the longest survival time.
related.difference: 電遷移是導體原子輸運與空洞；TDDB 是介電層耗損及導通路徑形成。電流與電場加速參數不能交換。
related.differenceEn: Electromigration concerns atomic transport and voiding; TDDB concerns dielectric wear-out and conductive paths. Current and field acceleration parameters are not interchangeable.
practice: 對同一批假設資料標出失效及右截尾。
分開 J、電場及實際試件溫度。
比較模型在測試區與使用區的外推差異。
practiceEn: Label failures and right-censored observations in hypothetical data.
Separate current density, electric field and specimen temperature.
Compare model extrapolation inside stress and use regimes.

courses.overview: 從「時間相依介電崩潰量測」延伸比較高介電常數原子層沉積、鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement by comparing High-k atomic layer deposition and Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 高介電膜的厚度、介面層與局部場分布會影響漏電及可靠度，需聯合結構與電性證據。
related.transferEn: High-k thickness, interfaces and local fields affect leakage and reliability, requiring structural and electrical evidence.
related.difference: ALD 課著重成膜均勻與反應控制；TDDB 課著重隨時間的耗損統計。良好平均膜厚不是壽命保證。
related.differenceEn: ALD targets film uniformity and reaction control; TDDB targets time-dependent wear statistics. Good mean thickness is no lifetime guarantee.
practice: 畫多層介質並比較各層電場。
區分初始漏電、早期缺陷及長時耗損。
指定厚度分布與崩潰統計的共同驗收證據。
practiceEn: Draw a dielectric stack and compare layer fields.
Separate initial leakage, early defects and long-term wear.

courses.overview: 從「動態隨機存取記憶體電容製作」延伸比較高深寬比介電層蝕刻、時間相依介電崩潰量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend DRAM capacitor fabrication by comparing High-aspect-ratio dielectric etching and Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: DRAM 高柱電容與深孔蝕刻都須控制孔口、底部及側壁形貌，孔口尺寸不足以判斷整體品質。
related.transferEn: Tall DRAM capacitors and deep etching require opening, bottom and sidewall control; opening CD alone is insufficient.
related.difference: 蝕刻形成空間；電容整合還需連續電極、高介電覆蓋及機械支撐。深孔合格不等於儲存功能合格。
related.differenceEn: Etching creates space; capacitor integration additionally needs continuous electrodes, dielectric coverage and support. A good hole does not prove memory function.
practice: 標記上中下三段孔徑與側壁。
比較入口與底部電極／介電層覆蓋。
把形貌、電容、漏電與倒塌風險放入同表。
practiceEn: Mark top, middle and bottom widths and sidewalls.
Compare electrode and dielectric coverage at entrance and bottom.
Tabulate profile, capacitance, leakage and collapse risk together.
related.title: 高深寬比介電層蝕刻

related.whyEn: Tall DRAM capacitors and deep etching require opening, bottom and sidewall control; opening CD alone is insufficient.

related.transfer: 儲存電容增加 C 的同時必須守住漏電與介電層壽命；較薄膜不能只看電容收益。
related.transferEn: Increasing storage capacitance must preserve leakage and dielectric lifetime; thinning cannot be judged by capacitance alone.
related.difference: DRAM 保持時間關乎可接受電荷流失與刷新；TDDB 關乎耗損到失效的時間分布。兩種時間不是同一指標。
related.differenceEn: DRAM retention concerns allowable charge loss and refresh; TDDB concerns time-to-failure distributions. They are different time metrics.
practice: 用假設 Q=CV 與漏電估計電荷損失時間。
分開刷新需求與擊穿壽命資料。
檢查平均值相同但尾端不同的兩批電容。
practiceEn: Estimate charge-loss time from hypothetical Q=CV and leakage.
Separate refresh requirements from breakdown-life data.
Compare capacitor lots with equal means but different tails.
related.title: 時間相依介電崩潰量測

related.transfer: 3D NAND 通道穿過多層堆疊，與高深寬比蝕刻共用深度、傾斜、縮頸及底部可達性問題。
related.transferEn: 3D NAND channels traverse multilayers, sharing depth, tilt, necking and bottom-access challenges with high-aspect-ratio etching.
related.difference: 蝕刻輪廓是製程輸出之一；NAND 還須檢查各層記憶單元及選擇閘。孔深達標不能推定每層電性一致。
related.differenceEn: Etch profile is one process output; NAND also needs per-layer cells and select gates. Correct depth does not establish uniform electrical behavior.
practice: 畫通道沿高度的寬度變化。
對齊頂部／中部／底部形貌與電性群組。
區分層數、通道高度與每單元位元數。
practiceEn: Plot channel width along stack height.
Align top/middle/bottom profiles with electrical groups.
Distinguish layer count, channel height and bits per cell.

practiceEn: Place tunnel, trap and blocking layers in one vertical cell.

related.why: 垂直 NAND 的每層單元可利用電荷捕捉堆疊改變閾值，結構幾何與電荷保持共同決定窗口。
related.whyEn: Each vertical NAND cell can use a charge-trap stack to shift threshold; geometry and retention jointly determine the window.

related.transfer: 兩者都以閘堆疊的內部狀態改變讀取電性，需同時比較窗口、保持與耐久。
related.transferEn: Both modify readout through an internal gate-stack state, requiring window, retention and endurance comparisons.
related.difference: 電荷捕捉依賴載子陷阱；鐵電依賴可切換極化。相似遲滯窗口不能證明相同機制或相同寫入條件。
related.differenceEn: Charge trapping relies on carrier traps; ferroelectrics rely on switchable polarization. Similar hysteresis does not prove identical mechanisms or programming conditions.
practice: 畫陷阱電荷與極化方向兩種狀態圖。
比較保持漂移與循環退化的觀察量。
提出能區分捕捉效應與鐵電切換的量測。
practiceEn: Draw separate trapped-charge and polarization-state diagrams.
Compare observables for retention drift and cycling degradation.
Propose measurements distinguishing trapping from ferroelectric switching.

courses.overview: 從「相變化記憶體製作」延伸比較磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面、電阻式記憶體製作：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Phase-change memory fabrication by comparing MRAM magnetic tunnel junctions and Resistive memory fabrication: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩種非揮發記憶皆須平衡寫入能量、讀取窗口、保持及耐久，並考慮選擇元件。

practice: 對照相態與磁態兩種記憶狀態圖。
在假設負載下分列寫入、讀取與保持能量。

courses.overview: 從「鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜」延伸比較高介電常數原子層沉積、電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory by comparing High-k atomic layer deposition and Charge-trap memory gate engineering: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: HZO 與一般高介電膜都依賴薄膜厚度、界面與後續熱歷史；成膜品質需對應電性。
related.transferEn: HZO and conventional high-k films both depend on thickness, interfaces and thermal history, linking deposition quality to electrical behavior.
related.difference: 高介電材料不必具有鐵電性；HZO 的相組成、喚醒與疲勞不能由高 κ 或膜厚單獨證明。
related.differenceEn: A high-k material need not be ferroelectric; HZO phase, wake-up and fatigue cannot be proven by high kappa or thickness alone.
practice: 分開高介電常數與可切換極化兩項需求。
將熱史、相證據與循環電性放入同表。
比較介面層對電容與切換窗口的影響。
practiceEn: Separate high permittivity from switchable polarization requirements.
Tabulate thermal history, phase evidence and cycling behavior.
Compare interface effects on capacitance and switching windows.
related.title: 高介電常數原子層沉積

related.whyEn: HZO and conventional high-k films both depend on thickness, interfaces and thermal history, linking deposition quality to electrical behavior.

related.transfer: 兩者都以閘堆疊的內部狀態改變讀取電性，需同時比較窗口、保持與耐久。
related.transferEn: Both modify readout through an internal gate-stack state, requiring window, retention and endurance comparisons.
related.difference: 電荷捕捉依賴載子陷阱；鐵電依賴可切換極化。相似遲滯窗口不能證明相同機制或相同寫入條件。
related.differenceEn: Charge trapping relies on carrier traps; ferroelectrics rely on switchable polarization. Similar hysteresis does not prove identical mechanisms or programming conditions.
practice: 畫陷阱電荷與極化方向兩種狀態圖。
比較保持漂移與循環退化的觀察量。
提出能區分捕捉效應與鐵電切換的量測。
practiceEn: Draw separate trapped-charge and polarization-state diagrams.
Compare observables for retention drift and cycling degradation.
Propose measurements distinguishing trapping from ferroelectric switching.
related.title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程

courses.overviewEn: Extend CMOS image-sensor fabrication by comparing Single-photon avalanche-diode arrays and Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩者都可透過背照與堆疊讀出改善光收集與電路配置，像素與邏輯介面同樣重要。
related.transferEn: Both can use backside illumination and stacked readout to improve light collection and circuit allocation; pixel/logic interfaces matter.
related.difference: 一般 CMOS 成像累積光電荷；SPAD 像素偵測離散雪崩事件並受死區時間影響。飽和容量與最大計數率不是同一指標。
related.differenceEn: Conventional CMOS imaging accumulates charge; SPAD pixels detect discrete avalanches with dead time. Full-well capacity and maximum count rate are different metrics.
practice: 比較電荷積分與事件計數兩條訊號鏈。
在堆疊剖面標出光敏層、互連與讀出層。
區分暗電流、暗計數及讀出雜訊。
practiceEn: Compare charge-integration and event-counting signal chains.
Label photosensitive, interconnect and readout layers in a stack.
Distinguish dark current, dark counts and read noise.

related.transfer: 成像器的抗反射層與薄膜光學常數影響光穿透；橢偏可提供模型化膜厚／n、k 證據。
related.transferEn: Sensor antireflection layers and optical constants affect transmission; ellipsometry provides model-based thickness and n/k evidence.
related.difference: 成像驗收關乎像素響應、飽和及雜訊；橢偏量測偏振變化。好的薄膜擬合不能獨自證明像素功能。
related.differenceEn: Imaging qualification concerns response, saturation and noise; ellipsometry measures polarization change. A good film fit cannot alone prove pixel function.
practice: 畫光從表面薄膜到光二極體的路徑。

把膜厚證據與像素光譜響應交叉比對。
practiceEn: Trace light through surface films into the photodiode.
Compare coupling among n, k and thickness in reflection models.
Cross-check film evidence against pixel spectral response.

courses.overviewEn: Extend Avalanche photodiode fabrication by comparing Single-photon avalanche-diode arrays and Wafer-level parametric testing: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: APD 與 SPAD 都利用碰撞游離增益，需控制電場、暗訊號及溫度效應。
related.transferEn: APDs and SPADs both use impact-ionization gain and require field, dark-signal and temperature control.
related.difference: 線性 APD 通常低於崩潰偏壓；SPAD 工作於 Geiger 模式並須淬熄。連續增益不能直接換算成單光子計數性能。
related.differenceEn: Linear APDs usually operate below breakdown; SPADs use Geiger mode and quenching. Continuous gain does not directly determine photon-counting performance.
practice: 將兩模式標在同一概念 I-V 圖。
分開增益、額外雜訊、暗計數與死區時間。
比較連續電流讀出與事件計時讀出。
practiceEn: Place both modes on a conceptual I-V curve.
Separate gain, excess noise, dark count and dead time.
Compare continuous-current and event-timing readout.

related.why: APD 與 SPAD 都利用碰撞游離增益，需控制電場、暗訊號及溫度效應。
related.whyEn: APDs and SPADs both use impact-ionization gain and require field, dark-signal and temperature control.

related.transfer: 雪崩元件的增益與漏電判讀依賴 I-V、溫度、頻寬與測試回路，與晶圓參數測試共用校正原理。
related.transferEn: Avalanche gain and leakage interpretation depend on I-V, temperature, bandwidth and circuitry, sharing parametric-test calibration principles.
related.difference: 參數測試是量測平台；APD 需要光學輸入與倍增區物理。暗態 I-V 無法單獨給出光響應及光子統計。
related.differenceEn: Parametric testing is a measurement platform; APDs additionally need optical input and multiplication physics. Dark I-V alone cannot give photoresponse or photon statistics.
practice: 建立光源開／關與溫度條件的測試矩陣。
標出電流量程、限流與背景扣除。
比較同偏壓下暗電流與受光電流。
practiceEn: Build a light-on/off and temperature test matrix.
Mark current range, compliance and background subtraction.
Compare dark and illuminated current at matched bias.

courses.overview: 從「單光子雪崩二極體陣列」延伸比較雪崩光二極體製作、CMOS 影像感測器製作：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Single-photon avalanche-diode arrays by comparing Avalanche photodiode fabrication and CMOS image-sensor fabrication: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: APD 與 SPAD 都利用碰撞游離增益，需控制電場、暗訊號及溫度效應。
related.transferEn: APDs and SPADs both use impact-ionization gain and require field, dark-signal and temperature control.
related.difference: 線性 APD 通常低於崩潰偏壓；SPAD 工作於 Geiger 模式並須淬熄。連續增益不能直接換算成單光子計數性能。
related.differenceEn: Linear APDs usually operate below breakdown; SPADs use Geiger mode and quenching. Continuous gain does not directly determine photon-counting performance.
practice: 將兩模式標在同一概念 I-V 圖。
分開增益、額外雜訊、暗計數與死區時間。
比較連續電流讀出與事件計時讀出。
practiceEn: Place both modes on a conceptual I-V curve.
Separate gain, excess noise, dark count and dead time.
Compare continuous-current and event-timing readout.
related.title: 雪崩光二極體製作

related.why: APD 與 SPAD 都利用碰撞游離增益，需控制電場、暗訊號及溫度效應。
related.whyEn: APDs and SPADs both use impact-ionization gain and require field, dark-signal and temperature control.

related.transfer: 兩者都可透過背照與堆疊讀出改善光收集與電路配置，像素與邏輯介面同樣重要。
related.transferEn: Both can use backside illumination and stacked readout to improve light collection and circuit allocation; pixel/logic interfaces matter.
related.difference: 一般 CMOS 成像累積光電荷；SPAD 像素偵測離散雪崩事件並受死區時間影響。飽和容量與最大計數率不是同一指標。
related.differenceEn: Conventional CMOS imaging accumulates charge; SPAD pixels detect discrete avalanches with dead time. Full-well capacity and maximum count rate are different metrics.
practice: 比較電荷積分與事件計數兩條訊號鏈。
在堆疊剖面標出光敏層、互連與讀出層。
區分暗電流、暗計數及讀出雜訊。
practiceEn: Compare charge-integration and event-counting signal chains.
Label photosensitive, interconnect and readout layers in a stack.
Distinguish dark current, dark counts and read noise.
related.title: CMOS 影像感測器製作

courses.overview: 從「碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制」延伸比較碳化矽 MOSFET 製程、晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Silicon-carbide epitaxy and defect control by comparing Silicon-carbide MOSFET processing and Wafer defect classification and yield analysis: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SiC 磊晶的缺陷與摻雜會進入功率元件的導通、阻斷及可靠度問題，需保持晶圓座標追溯。
related.transferEn: SiC epitaxial defects and doping feed into conduction, blocking and reliability, requiring wafer-coordinate genealogy.
related.difference: 磊晶品質是材料入口；MOSFET 還需閘介面、終端與體二極體整合。低缺陷密度不等於完整元件合格。
related.differenceEn: Epitaxy is a material input; MOSFETs also need gate interfaces, termination and body-diode integration. Low defect density does not qualify the whole device.
practice: 將磊晶缺陷圖與晶粒電性圖配準。
分開閘極失效與體二極體退化假說。
列出材料入料與元件出貨的不同證據。
practiceEn: Register epitaxial defect maps with die-level electrical maps.
Separate gate failure and body-diode degradation hypotheses.
List distinct evidence for material acceptance and device qualification.
related.title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程

related.whyEn: SiC epitaxial defects and doping feed into conduction, blocking and reliability, requiring wafer-coordinate genealogy.

related.transfer: 材料缺陷與良率分析都需要一致座標、檢出門檻及分類真值，才能研究缺陷是否對電性有害。
related.transferEn: Material-defect and yield analysis need consistent coordinates, thresholds and reference labels to test electrical criticality.
related.difference: SiC 缺陷圖可能包含差排與表面缺陷；良率圖統計失效晶粒。檢出事件數不能直接當作報廢晶粒數。
related.differenceEn: SiC maps may include dislocations and surface defects; yield maps count failing dies. Detection counts are not automatically rejected-die counts.
practice: 把缺陷類別、位置與晶粒 ID 組成追溯表。
比較有缺陷但通過與無檢出但失效的樣本。
檢查檢出門檻變動是否造成假良率趨勢。
practiceEn: Join defect classes, positions and die IDs in a genealogy table.
Compare detected-but-passing and undetected-but-failing samples.
Check whether threshold changes create apparent yield trends.
related.title: 晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析
related.titleEn: Wafer defect classification and yield analysis

courses.overviewEn: Extend Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors by comparing Silicon-carbide MOSFET processing and Gallium-arsenide RF-device fabrication: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SiC 與 GaN 功率元件都需處理導通損失、開關損失、熱與可靠度，系統評估必須同一工作條件。

related.difference: SiC MOSFET 依 MOS 通道與體二極體；GaN HEMT 依異質接面載子氣。反向導通與閘極應力不能套同一元件模型。
related.differenceEn: SiC MOSFETs use a MOS channel and body diode; GaN HEMTs use a heterojunction carrier gas. Reverse conduction and gate stress need different models.
practice: 畫兩者通道與反向電流路徑。
在相同假設工作點比較損失項。
分開材料優勢與封裝／驅動造成的差異。
practiceEn: Draw each channel and reverse-current path.
Compare loss terms at the same hypothetical operating point.
Separate material advantages from package and drive differences.
related.title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程

practiceEn: Draw substrate, buffer and quantum-well ordering.
Compare thickness/composition maps with emission-wavelength maps.
Separate growth defects, injection losses and extraction losses.

courses.overview: 從「二維半導體轉移與接觸」延伸比較源汲極接觸電阻控制、互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts by comparing Source-drain contact resistance control and Complementary FET research process flows: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 二維通道與一般接觸工程都可能受金屬／半導體界面及載子注入限制，需把接觸與通道電阻分開。

related.difference: 二維材料對轉移殘留、界面損傷及接觸幾何特別敏感；傳統體材料的接觸模型不能不驗證就套用。
related.differenceEn: Two-dimensional materials are especially sensitive to transfer residue, interface damage and contact geometry; bulk-material contact models need validation.
practice: 畫通道與兩端接觸的電阻分解。
比較不同間距測試結構的截距與斜率。
列出轉移前後需固定的材料與量測條件。
practiceEn: Draw channel and two-contact resistance decomposition.
Compare intercepts and slopes of different-spacing structures.
List material and measurement conditions to hold fixed across transfer.
related.title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制

比較 n/p 配對、接觸與對準三項需求。
訂定單元件展示與互補整合的不同驗收。

Compare n/p pairing, contacts and alignment requirements.
Define distinct acceptance criteria for single-device demonstrations and complementary integration.

courses.overview: 從「微機電慣性感測器製程」延伸比較微機電壓力感測器製程、深反應式離子蝕刻：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend MEMS inertial-sensor processing by comparing MEMS pressure-sensor processing and Deep reactive-ion etching: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩者都是將微小機械變形轉為電性訊號，殘留應力、封裝與溫漂會影響零點及靈敏度。
related.transferEn: Both convert microscopic deformation into electrical signals; residual stress, packaging and temperature affect offset and sensitivity.
related.difference: 慣性感測器常用質量／彈簧對加速度響應；壓力感測器以膜片承受壓差。加速度與壓差的輸入單位及邊界條件不同。
related.differenceEn: Inertial sensors often use a mass/spring responding to acceleration; pressure sensors use a diaphragm under pressure difference. Inputs and boundary conditions differ.
practice: 分別畫質量彈簧與膜片受力圖。
用假設資料比較零點、靈敏度及溫漂。
辨識封裝應力與真實輸入造成的訊號。
practiceEn: Draw mass/spring and diaphragm free-body diagrams.
Compare offset, sensitivity and thermal drift in hypothetical data.
Distinguish packaging stress from actual input signals.
related.title: 微機電壓力感測器製程

Build a pressure/temperature test matrix.
List distinct diagnostics for wiring parasitics and diaphragm hysteresis.

courses.overview: 從「薄膜電晶體顯示背板」延伸比較電漿增強化學氣相沉積、晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Thin-film-transistor display backplanes by comparing Plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition and Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 顯示背板與 PECVD 都重視大面積膜厚、介面及氫相關影響，需將沉積條件連到元件漂移。
related.transferEn: Display backplanes and PECVD both require area uniformity, interfaces and hydrogen-related effects to be linked to device drift.
related.difference: 沉積平台提供介電／保護層；IGZO TFT 的通道化學與偏壓穩定性另須驗證。膜厚均勻不能代替閾值一致性。
related.differenceEn: Deposition provides dielectric/passivation films; IGZO channel chemistry and bias stability require separate validation. Thickness uniformity cannot replace threshold uniformity.
practice: 畫玻璃、閘介電層、通道與保護層。
比較膜厚圖與 TFT 閾值圖的相關性。
區分氫來源、熱史與量測偏壓應力。
practiceEn: Draw glass, gate dielectric, channel and passivation layers.
Compare film-thickness maps with TFT threshold maps.
Separate hydrogen sources, thermal history and measurement bias stress.
related.title: 電漿增強化學氣相沉積

related.why: 顯示背板與 PECVD 都重視大面積膜厚、介面及氫相關影響，需將沉積條件連到元件漂移。
related.whyEn: Display backplanes and PECVD both require area uniformity, interfaces and hydrogen-related effects to be linked to device drift.

related.transfer: TFT 背板的薄膜厚度與光學常數可用橢偏模型輔助追蹤，但需和電性一起判讀。
related.transferEn: Ellipsometric models can help track backplane film thickness and optical constants, but electrical evidence remains necessary.
related.difference: 橢偏所得 n、k 與厚度不是載子遷移率或閾值的直接量測；玻璃背反射與大面積不均也會影響擬合。
related.differenceEn: Ellipsometric n, k and thickness are not direct mobility or threshold measurements; glass backside reflection and area nonuniformity affect fitting.
practice: 把光學膜堆疊和 TFT 電流路徑並排畫出。
比較多角度擬合與背反射抑制條件。
檢查膜參數改變是否有獨立電性證據。
practiceEn: Draw the optical stack beside the TFT current path.
Compare multi-angle fits and backside-reflection suppression.
Check whether film changes have independent electrical evidence.

courses.overview: 從「晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測」延伸比較光學散射量測、套刻誤差量測與補償：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer critical-dimension electron microscopy by comparing Optical scatterometry and Overlay metrology and compensation: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: CD-SEM 與散射量測可交叉檢查線寬及輪廓，但比較前須對齊量測定義與空間平均。
related.transferEn: CD-SEM and scatterometry can cross-check linewidth and profile after aligning measurand definitions and spatial averaging.
related.difference: SEM 是局部電子影像的邊緣抽取；散射量測是週期結構光譜反演。二者數值不同不必然代表其中一方錯誤。
related.differenceEn: SEM extracts edges from local electron images; scatterometry inverts spectra from periodic structures. Different values do not automatically invalidate either method.
practice: 指定頂部 CD、底部 CD 與平均 CD 的定義。
比較 SEM 視野與光學光斑的取樣範圍。
將充電偏差與反問題參數相關分開報告。
practiceEn: Define top, bottom and averaged CD.
Compare SEM fields of view with optical sampling spots.
Report charging bias separately from inverse-parameter correlation.
related.title: 光學散射量測

related.why: CD-SEM 與散射量測可交叉檢查線寬及輪廓，但比較前須對齊量測定義與空間平均。
related.whyEn: CD-SEM and scatterometry can cross-check linewidth and profile after aligning measurand definitions and spatial averaging.

related.transfer: 兩者都依賴標靶、座標與校正，可把圖形尺寸變化和層間位置偏移分開追蹤。
related.transferEn: Both rely on targets, coordinates and calibration to distinguish feature-size changes from layer-to-layer displacement.
related.difference: CD 是尺寸；套刻是相對位置。線寬合格不能證明上下層對準，單一位置偏移也不等於尺寸誤差。
related.differenceEn: CD is size; overlay is relative position. Correct linewidth does not prove layer alignment, and displacement is not a dimensional error.
practice: 畫線寬改變與整層平移兩種圖形。
對齊晶圓座標與標靶方向。
建立 CD 與套刻各自的誤差預算。
practiceEn: Draw linewidth change and whole-layer translation separately.
Align wafer coordinates and target orientations.
Build separate CD and overlay uncertainty budgets.
related.title: 套刻誤差量測與補償

related.why: CD-SEM 與散射量測可交叉檢查線寬及輪廓，但比較前須對齊量測定義與空間平均。
related.whyEn: CD-SEM and scatterometry can cross-check linewidth and profile after aligning measurand definitions and spatial averaging.

related.transfer: 兩者都把光學訊號配合物理模型反推出結構，必須處理 n、k、幾何耦合及不唯一性。
related.transferEn: Both infer structures from optical signals and physical models, requiring treatment of n/k, geometry coupling and nonuniqueness.
related.difference: 散射量測常針對週期圖形；薄膜橢偏常用層狀堆疊。不能把平面膜厚模型直接套用有側壁的光柵。
related.differenceEn: Scatterometry commonly targets periodic features; film ellipsometry commonly uses layered stacks. A planar-film model cannot simply replace a grating model.
practice: 畫層狀膜與光柵的不同模型邊界。
改變一個 n 或幾何參數並比較敏感度。
以第二角度或獨立量測檢查退化解。
practiceEn: Draw different model boundaries for films and gratings.
Perturb one optical or geometric parameter and compare sensitivity.
Use another angle or independent metrology to test degenerate solutions.

courses.overview: 從「晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測」延伸比較光學散射量測、高介電常數原子層沉積：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer thin-film ellipsometry by comparing Optical scatterometry and High-k atomic layer deposition: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩者都把光學訊號配合物理模型反推出結構，必須處理 n、k、幾何耦合及不唯一性。
related.transferEn: Both infer structures from optical signals and physical models, requiring treatment of n/k, geometry coupling and nonuniqueness.
related.difference: 散射量測常針對週期圖形；薄膜橢偏常用層狀堆疊。不能把平面膜厚模型直接套用有側壁的光柵。
related.differenceEn: Scatterometry commonly targets periodic features; film ellipsometry commonly uses layered stacks. A planar-film model cannot simply replace a grating model.
practice: 畫層狀膜與光柵的不同模型邊界。
改變一個 n 或幾何參數並比較敏感度。
以第二角度或獨立量測檢查退化解。
practiceEn: Draw different model boundaries for films and gratings.
Perturb one optical or geometric parameter and compare sensitivity.
Use another angle or independent metrology to test degenerate solutions.
related.title: 光學散射量測

practiceEn: Compare hypothetical thickness-versus-cycle data and intercepts.
Include a possible interface layer in the model.
Use multiple angles and independent standards to assess thickness intervals.

courses.overview: 從「製程統計管制系統」延伸比較先進製程控制與虛擬量測、晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Statistical process-control systems by comparing Advanced process control and virtual metrology and Wafer defect classification and yield analysis: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SPC 與 APC／虛擬量測都以時間序列監控製程，漂移、延遲與資料版本會影響決策。
related.transferEn: SPC and APC/virtual metrology both use process time series, with drift, delay and data versions affecting decisions.
related.difference: SPC 主要判斷統計穩定與調查；APC 會調整輸入，虛擬量測則預測未量值。預測不能自動當成實測閉環依據。
related.differenceEn: SPC primarily assesses stability and investigation; APC changes inputs, while virtual metrology predicts unmeasured values. Predictions are not automatically physical measurements.
practice: 分開監控警報、預測及控制動作三條流程。
用時間切分驗證模型，避免未來資料洩漏。
訂定漂移時恢復實體量測與人工審查的門檻。
practiceEn: Separate monitoring alarms, predictions and control actions.
Validate with temporal splits to avoid future-data leakage.
Define drift thresholds for physical metrology and human review.
related.title: 先進製程控制與虛擬量測
related.titleEn: Advanced process control and virtual metrology

courses.overview: 從「晶圓級參數測試」延伸比較源汲極接觸電阻控制、時間相依介電崩潰量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer-level parametric testing by comparing Source-drain contact resistance control and Time-dependent dielectric breakdown measurement: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 接觸電阻需要有定義的結構、電流路徑與寄生校正，參數測試提供 Kelvin／TLM 等比較方法。
related.transferEn: Contact resistance needs defined structures, current paths and parasitic correction; parametric testing supports Kelvin/TLM comparisons.
related.difference: 測試平台能量到電壓電流，不代表接觸電阻可不依模型直接取得；負截距或非線性須先檢查模型與接觸。
related.differenceEn: Measuring voltage/current does not make contact resistance model-free; negative intercepts or nonlinearities require model and contact checks.
practice: 將兩線電阻拆成接觸、導線與通道。
比較 Kelvin 結構與不同間距 TLM。
檢查探針重測規則，避免只保留通過值。
practiceEn: Decompose two-wire resistance into contacts, leads and channel.
Compare Kelvin structures with variable-spacing TLM.
Check probe retest rules to avoid retaining only passes.
related.title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制

related.transfer: TDDB 的漏電與崩潰量測需要參數測試中的量程、限流、時間戳與測試順序控制。
related.transferEn: TDDB leakage and breakdown measurements need parametric-test ranges, compliance, timestamps and ordering.
related.difference: 一般 I-V/C-V 抽參數可能近似非破壞；TDDB 故意施加老化應力。被應力改變的試件不能再當作未測過的基準。
related.differenceEn: Ordinary I-V/C-V extraction may be approximately nondestructive; TDDB deliberately ages specimens. Stressed devices cannot remain untouched references.
practice: 分開初始電性與加速應力的測試次序。
標出寄生儲能與限流延遲。
用採樣間隔報告失效時間區間。
practiceEn: Separate initial characterization from accelerated-stress sequencing.
Mark stored parasitic energy and compliance delay.
Report a failure-time interval based on sampling cadence.
related.title: 時間相依介電崩潰量測

courses.overview: 從「台積電 GIGAFAB 廠務整合案例」延伸比較超純水供應系統、晶圓廠自動搬運系統：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend TSMC GIGAFAB facility-integration case study by comparing Ultrapure-water supply systems and Automated material handling in fabs: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 大型晶圓廠的水系統需要產量、純度、取用點與回流一起設計，廠務資料能連到製程風險。
related.transferEn: Large-fab water systems jointly consider capacity, purity, use points and return loops, linking utilities to process risk.
related.difference: GIGAFAB 是整體製造管理案例；超純水是其中一個子系統。公開節水績效不能還原內部每段水處理設定。
related.differenceEn: GIGAFAB is an overall manufacturing-management case; ultrapure water is one subsystem. Public water-saving metrics do not reveal every treatment setting.
practice: 畫製程用水、冷卻水及再利用的邊界。
檢查回收率分母，避免重複計算循環量。
連接取用點監測與異常批次追溯。
practiceEn: Draw boundaries among process water, cooling and reuse.
Check recovery denominators to avoid double-counting circulation.
Connect point-of-use monitoring to affected-lot genealogy.
related.title: 超純水供應系統

courses.overviewEn: Extend imec NanoIC pilot-line architecture by comparing High-numerical-aperture EUV imaging and Complementary FET research process flows: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: NanoIC 的先進微影需把 High-NA 曝光、光阻、蝕刻與量測放入共同學習迴圈。
related.transferEn: Advanced lithography in NanoIC connects High-NA exposure, resist, etch and metrology in a shared learning loop.
related.difference: High-NA 是成像模組；試驗線還需載具、合作接口與成熟度驗證。設備到貨不等於完成安裝校正或穩定產出。
related.differenceEn: High-NA is an imaging module; a pilot line also needs test vehicles, collaboration interfaces and maturity validation. Arrival is not qualification or stable output.
practice: 分開設備到貨、驗收及試片結果的里程碑。
畫曝光結果如何傳到蝕刻與量測。
以試片定義圖形可重複性的證據。
practiceEn: Separate arrival, qualification and test-wafer milestones.
Trace exposure results into etch and metrology.
Define pattern-repeatability evidence using a test vehicle.

related.title: 企業零信任網路
related.why: 可移植「OT 資產邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from ot asset boundaries; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「OT 資產邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from ot asset boundaries; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據；「企業零信任網路」主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence; Enterprise zero-trust networks emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「工控網路分區與隔離」與「企業零信任網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「流矩陣」的對照方法至「裝置證據」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Industrial-control network segmentation and Enterprise zero-trust networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from flow matrices to device evidence, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.

practice: 對照Yb離子與集體模態與Aquila光鑷佔位，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

related.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統

related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層；NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統改以Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。

practice: 對照H100與主記憶拓撲與Grace與Blackwell記憶，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare h100 and host-memory topology with grace/blackwell memory and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from bmc and job recovery and propose an observation distinguishing dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers from grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling, including uncertainty.

related.title: NIF 慣性融合能量邊界
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界；NIF 慣性融合能量邊界改以高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries; NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries centers on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照緊湊tokamak幾何與慣性約束系統邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NIF 慣性融合能量邊界，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以目標與已證明能力為起點，設計一項能區分「高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界」與「高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare compact tokamak geometry with inertial-confinement boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from goals/demonstrated capabilities and propose an observation distinguishing hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries from high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy, including uncertainty.

related.title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」與「錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；EUV 多層膜反射鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」與「反射式光路與真空腔」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到EUV 多層膜反射鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” and “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to EUV multilayer mirrors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」與「PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；共軛焦顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦Abbe 極限、二級光譜與部分色散、齊明前鏡組、蓋玻片球差與 PSF 驗證；共軛焦顯微鏡則以針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on abbe limit, secondary spectrum and partial dispersion, aplanatic front group, cover-glass spherical aberration and PSF validation; Confocal microscopy centres on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」與「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到共軛焦顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture” and “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confocal microscopy, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「濺射去除的物理與去除率」與「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" and "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以濺射去除函數與駐留時間反卷積，把拋光後的面形誤差收斂到奈米級；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on converging polished figure error to the nanometre level with a sputter removal function and dwell-time deconvolution; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「氬離子束與工件表面」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到非球面光學加工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aspheric-optics manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” and “MR ribbon and electromagnet”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Magnetorheological optical finishing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget, convergence ratio and tool-path texture", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 增透膜設計與沉積
related.transfer: 可遷移「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」與「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；增透膜設計與沉積的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering; Antireflection coating design and deposition centres on designing single-layer, V-coat and broadband antireflection films by admittance matching and tying deposition, metrology and lens ghost budgets into acceptable engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「單層膜的兩個界面」與「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到增透膜設計與沉積，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “The two interfaces of a single film” and “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Antireflection coating design and deposition, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: LAYERTEC：光學干涉鍍膜技術說明

references.title: Edmund Optics：雷射損傷門檻縮放工具

references.scopeEn: Vendor technical tool explaining approximate damage-threshold scaling with pulse width, wavelength and spot size and its range of validity; course numbers are computed from these principles.

references.title: LIGO（Caltech）：LIGO 光學元件

references.scopeEn: Public page describing the 40 kg fused-silica test-mass mirrors, multilayer coatings, nanometre-level polish and extremely low absorption (about one part in 3.3 million); used for extreme-application context.

references.title: ISO 21254-1：雷射損傷門檻測試方法 第 1 部分
references.titleEn: ISO 21254-1: Test methods for laser-induced damage threshold, Part 1
references.scope: 標準頁面，定義損傷門檻測試的術語與一般原則（1-on-1、S-on-1 等測試模式的基礎）；本課引用其框架而非條文內容。
references.scopeEn: Standards page defining terminology and general principles for damage-threshold testing (basis of 1-on-1 and S-on-1 modes); the course cites its framework, not the text.

related.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
related.transfer: 可遷移「雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限」與「ppm 損耗的量測：衰盪、光熱與散射」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror" and "Measuring ppm loss: ring-down, photothermal and scatter" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical interference coatings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把 ppm 級損耗、駐波場與損傷門檻、離子束濺鍍與衰盪量測整合成可驗收的雷射鏡工程；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜則以以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on integrating ppm-level loss, standing-wave field and damage threshold, ion-beam sputtering and ring-down metrology into acceptable laser-mirror engineering; Optical interference coatings centres on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」與「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學薄膜干涉鍍膜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「入射角、偏振與公差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” and “The two interfaces of a single film”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical interference coatings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
related.transfer: 可遷移「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」與「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；橢圓偏光儀建置的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" and "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Ellipsometer construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Malus 定律與雙折射出發，製作並驗證波片、晶體稜鏡、線柵與薄膜偏振元件；橢圓偏光儀建置則以從 Ψ/Δ 與菲涅耳反演到偏光元件、測角儀與擬合的橢偏儀建置為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Malus's law and birefringence to fabricating and verifying waveplates, crystal prisms, wire-grid and thin-film polarizers; Ellipsometer construction centres on from Ψ/Δ and Fresnel inversion to polarizing optics, goniometer and model fitting in ellipsometer construction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「交叉偏振片與消光比」與「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橢圓偏光儀建置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模型擬合、參數相關性與不確定度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” and “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ellipsometer construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Model fitting, parameter correlation and uncertainty", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.why: 可遷移「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」與「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；液晶空間光調制器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" and "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators must be respecified.

references.title: Edmund Optics：認識波片
references.scope: 供應商應用筆記，說明雙折射、延遲量、零級與多級波片的差異及消色差設計；不含製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Vendor application note on birefringence, retardance, the difference between zero-order and multi-order plates and achromatic designs; no process parameters.

references.title: 加州大學聖塔芭芭拉分校 MAT 288 講義：偏振與波片
references.titleEn: UC Santa Barbara MAT 288 lecture: Polarization and waveplates
references.publisher: University of California, Santa Barbara (course notes)
references.scope: 大學課程講義，涵蓋 Stokes 向量、偏振片類型、以 Malus 定律量消光比、波片的波長與角度敏感度及 Faraday 隔離器。
references.scopeEn: University lecture notes covering Stokes vectors, polarizer types, extinction measured with Malus's law, waveplate wavelength and angle sensitivity and Faraday isolators.

references.title: Thorlabs：偏振光學產品指南
references.scope: 供應商產品導覽，列出波片、偏振片、Fresnel 菱體與偏振分光器的類別、典型消光比與延遲量規格；用於規格表對照。
references.scopeEn: Vendor product guide listing waveplate, polarizer, Fresnel-rhomb and polarizing-splitter classes with typical extinction and retardance specifications; used for specification comparison.

references.title: J.A. Woollam：橢偏術常見問題
references.scope: 說明 Ψ、Δ 的定義、為何用比值量測、入射角選擇與模型擬合的基本概念；為廠商公開教材，不含專有演算法。
references.scopeEn: Explains the definitions of Ψ and Δ, why ratio measurement is used, the choice of angle of incidence and the basics of model fitting; public vendor material without proprietary algorithms.

references.title: HORIBA：橢偏術學院
references.scope: 光譜橢偏術原理、儀器架構（偏光鏡、調制器、分析器）與應用的公開教學入口。
references.scopeEn: Public tutorial portal on spectroscopic-ellipsometry principles, instrument architecture (polarizer, modulator, analyzer) and applications.

references.title: SVC 教程 M-102：橢偏術導論
references.titleEn: SVC tutorial M-102: Introduction to Ellipsometry
references.scope: 專業學會的橢偏術課程大綱，涵蓋菲涅耳反射、薄膜模型與資料分析；用於確認本課的教學範圍符合業界教程。
references.scopeEn: Professional-society course outline covering Fresnel reflection, thin-film models and data analysis; used to confirm that the course scope matches industry tutorials.

references.title: 普渡大學 RIC：J.A. Woollam 橢偏術教程講義
references.titleEn: Purdue University RIC: J.A. Woollam ellipsometry tutorial handout
references.publisher: Purdue University, Chemistry Research Instrumentation Center
references.scope: 大學儀器中心轉載的廠商教程，含 Ψ–Δ 軌跡圖與薄膜週期性的說明；作為輔助閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Vendor tutorial redistributed by a university instrumentation centre, including Ψ–Δ trajectories and thin-film periodicity; supplementary reading.

references.title: 濱松光子學：LCOS-SLM 光相位調制器產品頁
references.titleEn: Hamamatsu Photonics: LCOS-SLM optical phase modulator
references.scope: 說明反射式液晶相位調制器的用途（波前控制、像差修正、雷射加工）、寬頻鋁電極與特定波長介電多層膜兩種反射層，以及高功率耐受（700 W 級）與每單位面積建議照度；不含像素層級設計資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes reflective liquid-crystal phase modulators for wavefront control, aberration correction and laser processing, the broadband aluminium versus wavelength-specific dielectric mirror options, high-power tolerance (700 W class) and recommended irradiance per unit area; no pixel-level design data.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器產品總覽
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。
references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 超穎透鏡製程研究
related.transfer: 可遷移「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」與「浮雕量測與繞射級功率分佈」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超穎透鏡製程研究的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" and "Relief metrology and diffraction-order power distribution" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Metalens fabrication research must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以純量繞射效率、相位階數與蝕刻深度控制，把微影製作的繞射元件做到可驗收的效率與零級洩漏；超穎透鏡製程研究則以從超穎原子相位庫到 EBL／DUV 曝光、高深寬比蝕刻與聚焦效率驗收的平面透鏡製程工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bringing lithographically made diffractive elements to acceptable efficiency and zero-order leakage through scalar efficiency, phase-level count and etch-depth control; Metalens fabrication research centres on from meta-atom phase libraries to EBL/DUV exposure, high-aspect-ratio etching and focusing-efficiency acceptance of flat lenses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」與「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超穎透鏡製程研究，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「色差、景深與消色差極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” and “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Metalens fabrication research, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 全像光學元件製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」與「浮雕量測與繞射級功率分佈」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；全像光學元件製作的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" and "Relief metrology and diffraction-order power distribution" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Holographic optical-element fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以純量繞射效率、相位階數與蝕刻深度控制，把微影製作的繞射元件做到可驗收的效率與零級洩漏；全像光學元件製作則以以 Kogelnik 耦合波理論為核心的體全像元件記錄、材料、布拉格選擇性量測與系統整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bringing lithographically made diffractive elements to acceptable efficiency and zero-order leakage through scalar efficiency, phase-level count and etch-depth control; Holographic optical-element fabrication centres on volume-hologram element recording, materials, Bragg-selectivity metrology and system integration built on Kogelnik coupled-wave theory, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」與「記錄層內的折射率條紋」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到全像光學元件製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「重建條件誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” and “Index fringes inside the recording layer”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Holographic optical-element fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Replay-condition error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: MIT 林肯實驗室技術報告 854：二元光學技術—多階繞射元件的理論與設計
references.titleEn: MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Report 854: Binary optics technology, theory and design of multi-level diffractive optical elements
references.publisher: MIT Lincoln Laboratory via Defense Technical Information Center
references.scope: 1989 年公開技術報告，推導 N 階繞射元件的第一級效率（2、4、8、16 階分別約 0.41、0.81、0.95、0.99）與光罩製程原理；本課的效率公式直接以此為基礎。
references.scopeEn: Public 1989 technical report deriving first-order efficiency of N-level elements (about 0.41, 0.81, 0.95 and 0.99 for 2, 4, 8 and 16 levels) and the mask-process principles; the course's efficiency formulas rest directly on it.

references.title: Holo/Or：繞射光學元件製作能力
references.scope: 製造商公開能力頁，說明直寫微影、光阻、乾式電漿蝕刻、灰階寫入、熔融石英與 ZnSe 基材及光束整形元件類型；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer capabilities page describing direct-write lithography, resist, dry plasma etching, grayscale writing, fused-silica and ZnSe substrates and beam-shaping element types; no process recipe.

references.title: Jenoptik：繞射光學元件與微光學
references.titleEn: Jenoptik: Diffractive optical elements and micro-optics
references.scope: 製造商產品頁，說明以晶圓級微影製作的繞射元件類別、材料與應用波段；用於規格與應用脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer product page describing wafer-level lithographically made diffractive element classes, materials and application bands; used for specification and application context.

references.title: 哈佛 SEAS 新聞：10 公分 DUV 微影超穎透鏡拍攝天體
references.titleEn: Harvard SEAS news: Metalens meets stars
references.publisher: Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
references.scope: 公開說明以 DUV 投影微影與場拼接製作 10 公分、約 187 億根奈米柱的全玻璃超穎透鏡，以及其熱、冷與振動測試；不含設計檔或製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Publicly describes a 10 cm all-glass metalens of about 18.7 billion nanopillars made by DUV projection lithography with field stitching, plus its thermal and vibration tests; no design files or process parameters.

references.title: NIST NanoFab：JEOL JBX-6300FS 電子束直寫系統工具頁
references.titleEn: NIST NanoFab tool page: JEOL JBX-6300FS direct-write electron-beam lithography
references.publisher: NIST Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology
references.scope: 列出 100 keV、2 nm 光點、10 nm 特徵、1 mm 寫場、拼接與套刻小於 20 nm、最大 200 mm 晶圓等公開能力，為課程中 EBL 數值的依據。
references.scopeEn: Lists public capabilities of 100 keV, 2 nm spot, 10 nm features, 1 mm write field, stitching and overlay under 20 nm and wafers up to 200 mm, the basis for the EBL numbers in this course.

references.title: NIL Technology：超穎光學元件產品頁
references.titleEn: NIL Technology: Meta optics product page
references.scope: 說明近紅外超穎光學元件採矽於玻璃基板、以奈米壓印為基礎的量產與半導體等級設備組裝；屬產品分類頁，不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Describes near-infrared meta-optical elements on silicon-on-glass substrates, nanoimprint-based mass production and assembly with semiconductor-class equipment; a product page, no process recipe.

references.title: STMicroelectronics 新聞室：與 Metalenz 推出消費電子首個光學超穎表面技術
references.titleEn: STMicroelectronics newsroom: Metalenz and ST deliver first optical metasurface technology for consumer devices
references.scope: 2022 年 6 月的公開新聞稿，證實超穎表面光學元件在半導體產線量產並用於感測模組；僅為商業化脈絡，不含技術規格。
references.scopeEn: June 2022 public press release confirming metasurface optics manufactured on semiconductor lines for sensing modules; commercial context only, no technical specifications.

references.title: Covestro：Bayfol 工程與全像光聚合物薄膜品牌頁
references.titleEn: Covestro: Bayfol engineering and holographic photopolymer films
references.scope: 說明 Bayfol HX 自顯影全像光聚合物的記錄波長範圍（440–680 nm 等級）、三層結構與擴增實境、車用透明顯示等應用；不含折射率調制或配方數據。
references.scopeEn: Describes the Bayfol HX self-developing holographic photopolymer, its recording-wavelength range (440–680 nm class), three-layer structure and applications in augmented reality and automotive transparent displays; no index-modulation or formulation data.

references.title: Wasatch Photonics：體相位全像光柵技術說明
references.titleEn: Wasatch Photonics: Volume phase holographic grating technology
references.scope: 說明 VPH 光柵以折射率調制而非表面刻槽工作、以厚度與調制幅度設計工作波長，以及相對表面浮雕光柵的偏振相依性與入射角調諧行為；為公開技術頁。
references.scopeEn: Explains that VPH gratings work by index modulation rather than grooves, that working wavelength is set by thickness and modulation amplitude, and compares polarization dependence and angle tuning with surface-relief gratings; a public technology page.

references.title: ESO：MUSE 儀器描述（體相位全像光柵光譜儀）
references.titleEn: ESO: MUSE instrument description (VPH grating spectrographs)
references.scope: 公開列出 MUSE 每個光譜儀由準直鏡、體相位全像光柵與相機組成，波段 480–930 nm、解析力約 1770 至 3590；作為體全像光柵在天文儀器中的實際應用參照。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists each MUSE spectrograph as collimator, volume phase holographic grating and camera, covering 480–930 nm with resolving power about 1770 to 3590; a reference for volume gratings in a real astronomical instrument.

references.title: HORIBA：刻劃式與全像式繞射光柵技術頁
references.titleEn: HORIBA: Ruled and holographic diffraction gratings
references.scope: 說明全像光柵以兩束雷射干涉條紋曝光製作、無週期刻劃誤差故無鬼線、雜散光較低、可達 6000 線/mm 與離子蝕刻層狀槽形；不含製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Explains that holographic gratings are exposed with two-beam laser interference fringes, have no ghosts because there are no periodic ruling errors, show lower stray light, reach 6000 lines/mm and can be ion-etched to laminar profiles; no process parameters.

related.why: 可遷移「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」與「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；繞射光學元件製作的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" and "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Diffractive optical-element fabrication must be respecified.

related.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」與「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" and "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從超穎原子相位庫到 EBL／DUV 曝光、高深寬比蝕刻與聚焦效率驗收的平面透鏡製程工程；掃描電子顯微鏡則以電子探針直徑預算、Everhart–Thornley 偵測、作用體積與放大率校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from meta-atom phase libraries to EBL/DUV exposure, high-aspect-ratio etching and focusing-efficiency acceptance of flat lenses; Scanning electron microscopes centres on probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」與「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掃描電子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” and “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scanning electron microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: 哈佛 SEAS 新聞：10 公分 DUV 微影超穎透鏡拍攝天體
references.titleEn: Harvard SEAS news: Metalens meets stars
references.publisher: Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
references.scope: 公開說明以 DUV 投影微影與場拼接製作 10 公分、約 187 億根奈米柱的全玻璃超穎透鏡，以及其熱、冷與振動測試；不含設計檔或製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Publicly describes a 10 cm all-glass metalens of about 18.7 billion nanopillars made by DUV projection lithography with field stitching, plus its thermal and vibration tests; no design files or process parameters.

references.title: NIST NanoFab：JEOL JBX-6300FS 電子束直寫系統工具頁
references.titleEn: NIST NanoFab tool page: JEOL JBX-6300FS direct-write electron-beam lithography
references.publisher: NIST Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology
references.scope: 列出 100 keV、2 nm 光點、10 nm 特徵、1 mm 寫場、拼接與套刻小於 20 nm、最大 200 mm 晶圓等公開能力，為課程中 EBL 數值的依據。
references.scopeEn: Lists public capabilities of 100 keV, 2 nm spot, 10 nm features, 1 mm write field, stitching and overlay under 20 nm and wafers up to 200 mm, the basis for the EBL numbers in this course.

references.title: NIL Technology：超穎光學元件產品頁
references.titleEn: NIL Technology: Meta optics product page
references.scope: 說明近紅外超穎光學元件採矽於玻璃基板、以奈米壓印為基礎的量產與半導體等級設備組裝；屬產品分類頁，不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Describes near-infrared meta-optical elements on silicon-on-glass substrates, nanoimprint-based mass production and assembly with semiconductor-class equipment; a product page, no process recipe.

references.title: STMicroelectronics 新聞室：與 Metalenz 推出消費電子首個光學超穎表面技術
references.titleEn: STMicroelectronics newsroom: Metalenz and ST deliver first optical metasurface technology for consumer devices
references.scope: 2022 年 6 月的公開新聞稿，證實超穎表面光學元件在半導體產線量產並用於感測模組；僅為商業化脈絡，不含技術規格。
references.scopeEn: June 2022 public press release confirming metasurface optics manufactured on semiconductor lines for sensing modules; commercial context only, no technical specifications.

references.title: MIT 林肯實驗室技術報告 854：二元光學技術—多階繞射元件的理論與設計
references.titleEn: MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Report 854: Binary optics technology, theory and design of multi-level diffractive optical elements
references.publisher: MIT Lincoln Laboratory via Defense Technical Information Center
references.scope: 1989 年公開技術報告，推導 N 階繞射元件的第一級效率（2、4、8、16 階分別約 0.41、0.81、0.95、0.99）與光罩製程原理；本課的效率公式直接以此為基礎。
references.scopeEn: Public 1989 technical report deriving first-order efficiency of N-level elements (about 0.41, 0.81, 0.95 and 0.99 for 2, 4, 8 and 16 levels) and the mask-process principles; the course's efficiency formulas rest directly on it.

references.title: Holo/Or：繞射光學元件製作能力
references.scope: 製造商公開能力頁，說明直寫微影、光阻、乾式電漿蝕刻、灰階寫入、熔融石英與 ZnSe 基材及光束整形元件類型；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer capabilities page describing direct-write lithography, resist, dry plasma etching, grayscale writing, fused-silica and ZnSe substrates and beam-shaping element types; no process recipe.

references.title: Jenoptik：繞射光學元件與微光學
references.titleEn: Jenoptik: Diffractive optical elements and micro-optics
references.scope: 製造商產品頁，說明以晶圓級微影製作的繞射元件類別、材料與應用波段；用於規格與應用脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer product page describing wafer-level lithographically made diffractive element classes, materials and application bands; used for specification and application context.

references.title: JEOL：掃描電子顯微鏡產品
references.scope: 從桌上型到高階場發射 SEM 的公開產品分類與配件（X 光分析器、製樣與軟體）；課程數值不引用其規格。
references.scopeEn: Public product catalogue from benchtop to high-end field-emission SEMs with accessories (X-ray analysers, sample preparation, software); course numbers do not quote its specifications.

references.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific：掃描電子顯微鏡
references.titleEn: Thermo Fisher Scientific: Scanning electron microscopes
references.scope: 落地型與桌上型 SEM 的公開產品頁，呈現低真空、場發射與體積成像等不同構型的用途。
references.scopeEn: Public product page for floor-standing and desktop SEMs, showing the uses of low-vacuum, field-emission and volume-imaging configurations.

references.title: ZEISS：SEM 與 FIB-SEM 產品分類
references.titleEn: ZEISS: SEM and FIB-SEM product category
references.scope: 電子顯微鏡與聚焦離子束電子顯微鏡兩類儀器的公開入口，說明兩者的定位差異。
references.scopeEn: Public entry page for electron microscopes and focused-ion-beam electron microscopes, distinguishing the two instrument types.

references.title: Wikipedia：掃描電子顯微鏡
references.scope: 以聚焦電子束掃描樣品並由二次電子等訊號成像的二手概述，僅作背景導讀。
references.scopeEn: Secondary overview of imaging by scanning a focused electron beam and detecting secondary-electron and other signals; background reading only.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 繞射光學元件製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「厚光柵條件與 Kogelnik 耦合波」與「繞射效率量測與參數反推」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；繞射光學元件製作的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Thick-grating condition and Kogelnik coupled waves" and "Diffraction-efficiency metrology and parameter extraction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Diffractive optical-element fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 Kogelnik 耦合波理論為核心的體全像元件記錄、材料、布拉格選擇性量測與系統整合；繞射光學元件製作則以以純量繞射效率、相位階數與蝕刻深度控制，把微影製作的繞射元件做到可驗收的效率與零級洩漏為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on volume-hologram element recording, materials, Bragg-selectivity metrology and system integration built on Kogelnik coupled-wave theory; Diffractive optical-element fabrication centres on bringing lithographically made diffractive elements to acceptable efficiency and zero-order leakage through scalar efficiency, phase-level count and etch-depth control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「記錄層內的折射率條紋」與「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到繞射光學元件製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「效率預算：量化、深度、套準與散射」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Index fringes inside the recording layer” and “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Diffractive optical-element fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Efficiency budget: quantisation, depth, overlay and scatter", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 天文高解析光譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「厚光柵條件與 Kogelnik 耦合波」與「繞射效率量測與參數反推」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文高解析光譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Thick-grating condition and Kogelnik coupled waves" and "Diffraction-efficiency metrology and parameter extraction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of High-resolution astronomical spectrographs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 Kogelnik 耦合波理論為核心的體全像元件記錄、材料、布拉格選擇性量測與系統整合；天文高解析光譜儀則以階梯光柵色散、光纖擾頻、真空溫控、波長校正與公分每秒級徑向速度誤差預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on volume-hologram element recording, materials, Bragg-selectivity metrology and system integration built on Kogelnik coupled-wave theory; High-resolution astronomical spectrographs centres on echelle dispersion, fibre scrambling, vacuum thermal control, wavelength calibration and cm/s radial-velocity error budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「記錄層內的折射率條紋」與「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文高解析光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Index fringes inside the recording layer” and “Doppler shift of stellar lines”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-resolution astronomical spectrographs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: Covestro：Bayfol 工程與全像光聚合物薄膜品牌頁
references.titleEn: Covestro: Bayfol engineering and holographic photopolymer films
references.scope: 說明 Bayfol HX 自顯影全像光聚合物的記錄波長範圍（440–680 nm 等級）、三層結構與擴增實境、車用透明顯示等應用；不含折射率調制或配方數據。
references.scopeEn: Describes the Bayfol HX self-developing holographic photopolymer, its recording-wavelength range (440–680 nm class), three-layer structure and applications in augmented reality and automotive transparent displays; no index-modulation or formulation data.

references.title: Wasatch Photonics：體相位全像光柵技術說明
references.titleEn: Wasatch Photonics: Volume phase holographic grating technology
references.scope: 說明 VPH 光柵以折射率調制而非表面刻槽工作、以厚度與調制幅度設計工作波長，以及相對表面浮雕光柵的偏振相依性與入射角調諧行為；為公開技術頁。
references.scopeEn: Explains that VPH gratings work by index modulation rather than grooves, that working wavelength is set by thickness and modulation amplitude, and compares polarization dependence and angle tuning with surface-relief gratings; a public technology page.

references.title: ESO：MUSE 儀器描述（體相位全像光柵光譜儀）
references.titleEn: ESO: MUSE instrument description (VPH grating spectrographs)
references.scope: 公開列出 MUSE 每個光譜儀由準直鏡、體相位全像光柵與相機組成，波段 480–930 nm、解析力約 1770 至 3590；作為體全像光柵在天文儀器中的實際應用參照。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists each MUSE spectrograph as collimator, volume phase holographic grating and camera, covering 480–930 nm with resolving power about 1770 to 3590; a reference for volume gratings in a real astronomical instrument.

references.title: HORIBA：刻劃式與全像式繞射光柵技術頁
references.titleEn: HORIBA: Ruled and holographic diffraction gratings
references.scope: 說明全像光柵以兩束雷射干涉條紋曝光製作、無週期刻劃誤差故無鬼線、雜散光較低、可達 6000 線/mm 與離子蝕刻層狀槽形；不含製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Explains that holographic gratings are exposed with two-beam laser interference fringes, have no ghosts because there are no periodic ruling errors, show lower stray light, reach 6000 lines/mm and can be ion-etched to laminar profiles; no process parameters.

references.title: MIT 林肯實驗室技術報告 854：二元光學技術—多階繞射元件的理論與設計
references.titleEn: MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Report 854: Binary optics technology, theory and design of multi-level diffractive optical elements
references.publisher: MIT Lincoln Laboratory via Defense Technical Information Center
references.scope: 1989 年公開技術報告，推導 N 階繞射元件的第一級效率（2、4、8、16 階分別約 0.41、0.81、0.95、0.99）與光罩製程原理；本課的效率公式直接以此為基礎。
references.scopeEn: Public 1989 technical report deriving first-order efficiency of N-level elements (about 0.41, 0.81, 0.95 and 0.99 for 2, 4, 8 and 16 levels) and the mask-process principles; the course's efficiency formulas rest directly on it.

references.title: Holo/Or：繞射光學元件製作能力
references.scope: 製造商公開能力頁，說明直寫微影、光阻、乾式電漿蝕刻、灰階寫入、熔融石英與 ZnSe 基材及光束整形元件類型；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer capabilities page describing direct-write lithography, resist, dry plasma etching, grayscale writing, fused-silica and ZnSe substrates and beam-shaping element types; no process recipe.

references.title: Jenoptik：繞射光學元件與微光學
references.titleEn: Jenoptik: Diffractive optical elements and micro-optics
references.scope: 製造商產品頁，說明以晶圓級微影製作的繞射元件類別、材料與應用波段；用於規格與應用脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer product page describing wafer-level lithographically made diffractive element classes, materials and application bands; used for specification and application context.

references.title: ESO：ESPRESSO 超穩定光纖饋入階梯光柵光譜儀
references.titleEn: ESO: ESPRESSO ultra-stable fibre-fed echelle spectrograph
references.scope: 官方儀器頁，列出 R 約 70 000、140 000 與 190 000 三種模式、單座或四座 UT 饋入，以及 10 cm/s 的長期 RV 目標；課程其餘數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Official instrument page listing resolving-power modes of about 70 000, 140 000 and 190 000, single- or four-UT feeding, and the 10 cm/s long-term RV goal; other course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: ESO：HARPS 高精度徑向速度行星搜尋儀
references.titleEn: ESO: HARPS High Accuracy Radial velocity Planet Searcher
references.scope: 官方頁面，說明 HARPS 為 ESO 3.6 m 望遠鏡上專門搜尋系外行星的光纖饋入高解析階梯光柵光譜儀。
references.scopeEn: Official page describing HARPS as a fibre-fed high-resolution echelle spectrograph on the ESO 3.6 m telescope dedicated to exoplanet searches.

references.title: ESPRESSO：下一代歐洲系外行星獵手（設計論文）
references.titleEn: ESPRESSO: The next European exoplanet hunter (design paper)

references.scopeEn: Study of the repeatability and consistency of laser-frequency-comb wavelength calibration on a high-resolution spectrograph, used as background for the comb calibration unit.

related.title: 相位式計算全像
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙折射與 2π 相位行程」與「相位查找表校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；相位式計算全像的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke" and "Phase lookup-table calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Phase-only computer-generated holography must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合；相位式計算全像則以傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on phase stroke, pixel diffraction, liquid-crystal response, lookup-table calibration and system integration of reflective LCOS phase modulators; Phase-only computer-generated holography centres on sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「平行配向向列液晶層」與「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到相位式計算全像，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「散斑、零階與波長的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer” and “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Phase-only computer-generated holography, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Speckle, zeroth-order and wavelength error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 天文自適應光學

related.difference: 本課聚焦反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合；天文自適應光學則以從 Fried 參數到 Strehl 預算的 VLT／ELT 自適應光學工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「平行配向向列液晶層」與「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文自適應光學，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算與 Strehl 比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer” and “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Astronomical adaptive optics, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget and the Strehl ratio", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.
