references.title: 濱松光子學：LCOS-SLM 光相位調制器產品頁
references.titleEn: Hamamatsu Photonics: LCOS-SLM optical phase modulator
references.scope: 說明反射式液晶相位調制器的用途（波前控制、像差修正、雷射加工）、寬頻鋁電極與特定波長介電多層膜兩種反射層，以及高功率耐受（700 W 級）與每單位面積建議照度；不含像素層級設計資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes reflective liquid-crystal phase modulators for wavefront control, aberration correction and laser processing, the broadband aluminium versus wavelength-specific dielectric mirror options, high-power tolerance (700 W class) and recommended irradiance per unit area; no pixel-level design data.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器產品總覽
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。
references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

references.title: 史丹佛計算影像實驗室：Neural Holography 專案頁
references.titleEn: Stanford Computational Imaging Lab: Neural Holography project page
references.scope: 說明相位型 LCoS SLM 全像顯示原型、相機閉環最佳化、Gerchberg–Saxton 與 SGD、Wirtinger 等演算法的比較，以及 HoloNet 約 30 dB PSNR 的即時彩色結果；為公開研究頁。
references.scopeEn: Describes a phase-only LCoS SLM holographic-display prototype, camera-in-the-loop optimization, comparison of Gerchberg–Saxton, SGD and Wirtinger algorithms, and HoloNet's real-time colour results at about 30 dB PSNR; a public research page.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器軟體（圖樣產生器與 SDK）
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE: Spatial light modulator software (pattern generator and SDK)
references.scope: 說明以 SLM 圖樣產生器產生動態光學函數、以 C/C++、LabVIEW、MATLAB、Python 的 SDK 載入相位圖，以及 SLM 以 DVI/HDMI 作為第二顯示器驅動的方式；不含演算法細節。
references.scopeEn: Explains generating dynamic optical functions with the SLM Pattern Generator, loading phase maps through SDKs for C/C++, LabVIEW, MATLAB and Python, and driving the SLM as a second DVI/HDMI monitor; no algorithm details.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：全像光鑷空間光調制器套件
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: Spatial light modulator optical tweezing kit
references.scope: 公開列出 1920×1200、8 µm 像素 SLM、639 nm 160 mW 雷射、1.35 NA 物鏡、以 SDK 計算全像並做相機與陷阱座標仿射對位、像差修正等功能，為全像光鑷系統的實際參照。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists a 1920×1200, 8 µm SLM, a 639 nm 160 mW laser, a 1.35 NA objective, SDK hologram computation with affine alignment of camera and trap coordinates and aberration correction; a practical reference for holographic tweezer systems.

references.title: ESO：自適應光學技術說明
references.scope: 說明變形鏡即時校正湍流、參考星與雷射導星的角色，以及 ESO 自 1989 年以來的 AO 發展與 ELT 展望；為概念層級的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Explains real-time correction of turbulence by deformable mirrors, the role of reference stars and laser guide stars, and ESO's AO development since 1989 with the ELT outlook; a concept-level public explanation.

references.title: ESO ELT：M4 自適應鏡
references.scope: 2.4 m 平面變形鏡、六片 1.95 mm 玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器、每秒 1000 次更新、±50 µm 行程與承包商（SCHOTT、Safran Reosc、AdOptica）。
references.scopeEn: The 2.4 m flat deformable mirror, six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells, more than 5000 voice-coil actuators, 1000 updates per second, ±50 µm stroke and the contractors (SCHOTT, Safran Reosc, AdOptica).

references.title: ESO ELT：自適應光學架構
references.scope: M4 與 M5 的角色、6–8 顆雷射導星、三種波前感測相機（含與 Teledyne 共同開發的 LISA）、每秒 500 次的即時計算、MORFEO 與 HARMONI 的 AO 模式。
references.scopeEn: Roles of M4 and M5, six to eight laser guide stars, three wavefront-sensing cameras (including LISA co-developed with Teledyne), real-time computation 500 times per second, and the AO modes of MORFEO and HARMONI.

references.title: ESO 公告：GALACSI 自適應光學模組完成測試
references.titleEn: ESO announcement: GALACSI adaptive-optics module ready for the VLT
references.scope: GALACSI 模組、變形副鏡與四顆鈉雷射導星如何為 MUSE 提供校正；公開公告，不含設計參數。
references.scopeEn: How the GALACSI module, the deformable secondary and four sodium laser guide stars provide correction for MUSE; a public announcement without design parameters.

references.scopeEn: Explains that a DLP chipset comprises the digital micromirror device, controller and driver, and lists automotive lighting, projection display and industrial pattern projection (3D printing, machine vision, spectroscopy) applications; a product category page without optical design parameters.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器產品總覽
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。
references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

references.title: Silicon Light Machines：雷射投影顯示的散斑對比抑制（Trisnadi）
references.titleEn: Silicon Light Machines: Speckle contrast reduction in laser projection displays (Trisnadi)
references.scope: 公開技術論文，定義散斑對比、角度／偏振／波長多樣性相乘的縮減因子，並報告光柵光閥投影機以 Hadamard 擴散片把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public technical paper defining speckle contrast and the product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity factors, and reporting a Hadamard diffuser that cut contrast from about 70% to 8% on a grating-light-valve projector; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Christie：雷射投影技術（RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉）
references.titleEn: Christie: Laser projection (RGB pure laser and laser phosphor)
references.scope: 官方頁面說明 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉兩種投影架構、色域與壽命；頁面未討論散斑，課程以其架構差異說明為何 RGB 純雷射需要散斑抑制。
references.scopeEn: Official page describing RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor projection architectures, colour gamut and lifetime; it does not discuss speckle, and the course uses the architectural difference to explain why RGB pure laser needs speckle reduction.

references.title: Laser Focus World：小型低成本雷射散斑抑制技術
references.titleEn: Laser Focus World: Laser-speckle reduction technology boasts minimal size and low cost
references.scope: 產業報導，描述以電活性聚合物膜與 x、y 電極 90° 相位差驅動擴散片做圓周運動的散斑抑制器；未提供對比數據。
references.scopeEn: Trade report describing a speckle reducer whose diffuser is driven in circular motion by an electroactive-polymer membrane with x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase; no contrast figures given.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 液晶空間光調制器
related.transfer: 可遷移「傅立葉全像的取樣與視窗」與「相機閉環校正與影像品質指標」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；液晶空間光調制器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sampling and window of Fourier holograms" and "Camera-in-the-loop calibration and image-quality metrics" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化；液晶空間光調制器則以反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays; Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators centres on phase stroke, pixel diffraction, liquid-crystal response, lookup-table calibration and system integration of reflective LCOS phase modulators, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」與「平行配向向列液晶層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液晶空間光調制器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「相位誤差預算與熱負載」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane” and “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Phase-error budget and thermal load", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transfer: 可遷移「傅立葉全像的取樣與視窗」與「相機閉環校正與影像品質指標」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；多視角全像顯示校正的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sampling and window of Fourier holograms" and "Camera-in-the-loop calibration and image-quality metrics" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Multiview holographic-display calibration must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化；多視角全像顯示校正則以角取樣、空間頻寬積、透鏡與光柵對位、相機式視點映射、串擾與眼動延遲預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays; Multiview holographic-display calibration centres on angular sampling, space–bandwidth product, lens and grating registration, camera-based view mapping, crosstalk and eye-tracking latency budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面」與「視角錐與角取樣」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到多視角全像顯示校正，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「串擾、角亮度漣波與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “SLM plane and Fourier replay plane” and “View cone and angular sampling”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Multiview holographic-display calibration, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Crosstalk, angular luminance ripple and error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: 史丹佛計算影像實驗室：Neural Holography 專案頁
references.titleEn: Stanford Computational Imaging Lab: Neural Holography project page
references.scope: 說明相位型 LCoS SLM 全像顯示原型、相機閉環最佳化、Gerchberg–Saxton 與 SGD、Wirtinger 等演算法的比較，以及 HoloNet 約 30 dB PSNR 的即時彩色結果；為公開研究頁。
references.scopeEn: Describes a phase-only LCoS SLM holographic-display prototype, camera-in-the-loop optimization, comparison of Gerchberg–Saxton, SGD and Wirtinger algorithms, and HoloNet's real-time colour results at about 30 dB PSNR; a public research page.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器軟體（圖樣產生器與 SDK）
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE: Spatial light modulator software (pattern generator and SDK)
references.scope: 說明以 SLM 圖樣產生器產生動態光學函數、以 C/C++、LabVIEW、MATLAB、Python 的 SDK 載入相位圖，以及 SLM 以 DVI/HDMI 作為第二顯示器驅動的方式；不含演算法細節。
references.scopeEn: Explains generating dynamic optical functions with the SLM Pattern Generator, loading phase maps through SDKs for C/C++, LabVIEW, MATLAB and Python, and driving the SLM as a second DVI/HDMI monitor; no algorithm details.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：全像光鑷空間光調制器套件
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: Spatial light modulator optical tweezing kit
references.scope: 公開列出 1920×1200、8 µm 像素 SLM、639 nm 160 mW 雷射、1.35 NA 物鏡、以 SDK 計算全像並做相機與陷阱座標仿射對位、像差修正等功能，為全像光鑷系統的實際參照。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists a 1920×1200, 8 µm SLM, a 639 nm 160 mW laser, a 1.35 NA objective, SDK hologram computation with affine alignment of camera and trap coordinates and aberration correction; a practical reference for holographic tweezer systems.

references.title: 濱松光子學：LCOS-SLM 光相位調制器產品頁
references.titleEn: Hamamatsu Photonics: LCOS-SLM optical phase modulator
references.scope: 說明反射式液晶相位調制器的用途（波前控制、像差修正、雷射加工）、寬頻鋁電極與特定波長介電多層膜兩種反射層，以及高功率耐受（700 W 級）與每單位面積建議照度；不含像素層級設計資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes reflective liquid-crystal phase modulators for wavefront control, aberration correction and laser processing, the broadband aluminium versus wavelength-specific dielectric mirror options, high-power tolerance (700 W class) and recommended irradiance per unit area; no pixel-level design data.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器產品總覽
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。

references.title: Looking Glass：多視角光場顯示運作原理
references.scope: 官方文件說明最多約 100 個視點分布在約 58° 視角錐、quilt 視點拼圖與零視差平面外的模糊；課程中的 45 視點與 40° 為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Official documentation describing up to about 100 views over a roughly 58° view cone, the quilt view mosaic and blur away from the zero-parallax plane; the course's 45 views and 40° are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Sony：ELF-SR2 空間實境顯示器
references.scope: 官方產品頁，說明以第二代高速視覺感測器做眼動追蹤的 27 吋裸眼立體顯示器；課程的延遲預算為教學假設，非該產品數據。
references.scopeEn: Official product page for a 27-inch glasses-free 3D display that uses a second-generation high-speed vision sensor for eye tracking; the course latency budget is a teaching assumption, not product data.

references.title: Leia：繞射式背光如何實現 3D 光場螢幕
references.titleEn: Leia: How Leia brings 3D Lightfield screens to life
references.scope: 官方文章說明以背光中的奈米結構把光導向特定方向並控制視點數，對比傳統柱狀透鏡與視差屏障；課程中的光柵方程式數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Official article explaining nanostructures in the backlight that direct light to specific directions and control the number of views, contrasted with lenticular film and parallax barriers; the course's grating-equation numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.scope: 官方產品頁，說明以第二代高速視覺感測器做眼動追蹤的 27 吋裸眼立體顯示器；課程的延遲預算為教學假設，非該產品數據。
references.scopeEn: Official product page for a 27-inch glasses-free 3D display that uses a second-generation high-speed vision sensor for eye tracking; the course latency budget is a teaching assumption, not product data.

references.title: Leia：繞射式背光如何實現 3D 光場螢幕
references.titleEn: Leia: How Leia brings 3D Lightfield screens to life
references.scope: 官方文章說明以背光中的奈米結構把光導向特定方向並控制視點數，對比傳統柱狀透鏡與視差屏障；課程中的光柵方程式數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Official article explaining nanostructures in the backlight that direct light to specific directions and control the number of views, contrasted with lenticular film and parallax barriers; the course's grating-equation numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: 史丹佛計算影像實驗室：Neural Holography 專案頁
references.titleEn: Stanford Computational Imaging Lab: Neural Holography project page
references.scope: 說明相位型 LCoS SLM 全像顯示原型、相機閉環最佳化、Gerchberg–Saxton 與 SGD、Wirtinger 等演算法的比較，以及 HoloNet 約 30 dB PSNR 的即時彩色結果；為公開研究頁。
references.scopeEn: Describes a phase-only LCoS SLM holographic-display prototype, camera-in-the-loop optimization, comparison of Gerchberg–Saxton, SGD and Wirtinger algorithms, and HoloNet's real-time colour results at about 30 dB PSNR; a public research page.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器軟體（圖樣產生器與 SDK）
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE: Spatial light modulator software (pattern generator and SDK)
references.scope: 說明以 SLM 圖樣產生器產生動態光學函數、以 C/C++、LabVIEW、MATLAB、Python 的 SDK 載入相位圖，以及 SLM 以 DVI/HDMI 作為第二顯示器驅動的方式；不含演算法細節。
references.scopeEn: Explains generating dynamic optical functions with the SLM Pattern Generator, loading phase maps through SDKs for C/C++, LabVIEW, MATLAB and Python, and driving the SLM as a second DVI/HDMI monitor; no algorithm details.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：全像光鑷空間光調制器套件
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: Spatial light modulator optical tweezing kit
references.scope: 公開列出 1920×1200、8 µm 像素 SLM、639 nm 160 mW 雷射、1.35 NA 物鏡、以 SDK 計算全像並做相機與陷阱座標仿射對位、像差修正等功能，為全像光鑷系統的實際參照。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists a 1920×1200, 8 µm SLM, a 639 nm 160 mW laser, a 1.35 NA objective, SDK hologram computation with affine alignment of camera and trap coordinates and aberration correction; a practical reference for holographic tweezer systems.

references.title: 濱松光子學：LCOS-SLM 光相位調制器產品頁
references.titleEn: Hamamatsu Photonics: LCOS-SLM optical phase modulator
references.scope: 說明反射式液晶相位調制器的用途（波前控制、像差修正、雷射加工）、寬頻鋁電極與特定波長介電多層膜兩種反射層，以及高功率耐受（700 W 級）與每單位面積建議照度；不含像素層級設計資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes reflective liquid-crystal phase modulators for wavefront control, aberration correction and laser processing, the broadband aluminium versus wavelength-specific dielectric mirror options, high-power tolerance (700 W class) and recommended irradiance per unit area; no pixel-level design data.

references.title: HOLOEYE：空間光調制器產品總覽
references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。
references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

related.title: 數位微鏡光學引擎
related.transfer: 可遷移「散斑的形成與統計」與「散斑對比的量測方法」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；數位微鏡光學引擎的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Speckle formation and statistics" and "Measuring speckle contrast" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Digital-micromirror optical engines must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦散斑統計、1/√N 多樣性預算、移動擴散片、光纖去同調、等效人眼量測與投影光展量限制；數位微鏡光學引擎則以以微鏡傾角、f 數、繞射級與光展量為核心的 DMD 照明、投影與圖樣投射引擎工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on speckle statistics, 1/√N diversity budgets, moving diffusers, fiber decoherence, eye-equivalent measurement and projector étendue limits; Digital-micromirror optical engines centres on DMD illumination, projection and pattern-projection engine design built on mirror tilt, f-number, diffraction orders and étendue, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」與「±12° 微鏡傾角與照明入射角」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到數位微鏡光學引擎，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱負載、灰階時序與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Screen roughness and observer pupil” and “±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Digital-micromirror optical engines, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal load, grey-scale timing and error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: Silicon Light Machines：雷射投影顯示的散斑對比抑制（Trisnadi）
references.titleEn: Silicon Light Machines: Speckle contrast reduction in laser projection displays (Trisnadi)
references.scope: 公開技術論文，定義散斑對比、角度／偏振／波長多樣性相乘的縮減因子，並報告光柵光閥投影機以 Hadamard 擴散片把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public technical paper defining speckle contrast and the product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity factors, and reporting a Hadamard diffuser that cut contrast from about 70% to 8% on a grating-light-valve projector; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Christie：雷射投影技術（RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉）
references.titleEn: Christie: Laser projection (RGB pure laser and laser phosphor)
references.scope: 官方頁面說明 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉兩種投影架構、色域與壽命；頁面未討論散斑，課程以其架構差異說明為何 RGB 純雷射需要散斑抑制。
references.scopeEn: Official page describing RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor projection architectures, colour gamut and lifetime; it does not discuss speckle, and the course uses the architectural difference to explain why RGB pure laser needs speckle reduction.

references.title: Laser Focus World：小型低成本雷射散斑抑制技術
references.titleEn: Laser Focus World: Laser-speckle reduction technology boasts minimal size and low cost
references.scope: 產業報導，描述以電活性聚合物膜與 x、y 電極 90° 相位差驅動擴散片做圓周運動的散斑抑制器；未提供對比數據。
references.scopeEn: Trade report describing a speckle reducer whose diffuser is driven in circular motion by an electroactive-polymer membrane with x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase; no contrast figures given.

references.title: 德州儀器：DLP 產品總覽
references.scope: 說明 DLP 晶片組由數位微鏡元件、控制器與驅動器組成，以及車用照明、投影顯示與工業圖樣投射（3D 列印、機器視覺、光譜）等應用；為產品分類頁，不含光學設計參數。
references.scopeEn: Explains that a DLP chipset comprises the digital micromirror device, controller and driver, and lists automotive lighting, projection display and industrial pattern projection (3D printing, machine vision, spectroscopy) applications; a product category page without optical design parameters.

references.title: 德州儀器：DLP6500FLQ 0.65 吋 1080p 數位微鏡元件產品頁
references.titleEn: Texas Instruments: DLP6500FLQ 0.65-inch 1080p DMD product page
references.scope: 公開列出 1920×1080 陣列、7.56 µm 微鏡間距、±12° 傾角、400–700 nm 波段、二元圖樣率 11,574 Hz 與 8 位元 1,446 Hz（搭配 DLPC910）等規格，為本課數值的依據。
references.scopeEn: Publicly lists the 1920×1080 array, 7.56 µm micromirror pitch, ±12° tilt, 400–700 nm range, 11,574 Hz binary and 1,446 Hz 8-bit pattern rates (with the DLPC910), the basis for the numbers in this course.

references.title: ViALUX：DMD 高速模組與光學量測系統
references.titleEn: ViALUX: High-speed DMD modules and optical measurement systems
references.scope: 介紹以 DMD 為核心的 UltraSpeed、SuperSpeed 與 Hi-Speed V-Module 開發模組、ALP 控制軟體與機器視覺、微影、3D 列印、光譜等應用；公開產品頁。
references.scopeEn: Introduces DMD-based UltraSpeed, SuperSpeed and Hi-Speed V-Module development kits, the ALP control software and applications in machine vision, lithography, 3D printing and spectroscopy; a public product page.

Using "Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: Janelia：晶格光片顯微鏡
references.scope: 研究機構頁面，說明 Betzig 團隊開發的晶格光片顯微鏡以薄光片逐層照明，具低光毒性與多小時多色 3D 成像能力，並經由先進影像中心開放使用；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Institutional page describing the lattice light-sheet microscope developed by Betzig's team, illuminating one thin sheet at a time with low phototoxicity for multi-hour multicolour 3D imaging, shared through the Advanced Imaging Center; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: ZEISS：Lightsheet 7 光片顯微鏡
references.scope: 官方產品頁，說明照明軸垂直於偵測軸、擺動掃描減少陰影條紋、活體培養槽，以及折射率 1.33 到 1.58 的透明化樣品槽；不提供內部設計參數。
references.scopeEn: Official product page describing illumination perpendicular to detection, pivot scanning to reduce shadow stripes, live-imaging incubation chambers and chambers for cleared samples from refractive index 1.33 to 1.58; no internal design parameters.

references.title: mesoSPIM 計畫：透明化組織用開源光片顯微鏡（PubMed 紀錄）
references.titleEn: The mesoSPIM initiative: open-source light-sheet microscopes for imaging cleared tissue (PubMed record)
references.scope: 同儕審查論文紀錄，介紹以電調焦透鏡軸向掃描光束腰並與相機滾動快門同步的開源大視野光片顯微鏡；課程中的同步時序數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Peer-reviewed paper record introducing open-source large-field light-sheet microscopes that sweep the waist axially with a tunable lens synchronized to the camera rolling shutter; the course's timing numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Nikon MicroscopyU：共軛焦顯微鏡入門概念
references.scope: 說明雷射掃描共軛焦如何以針孔排除離焦光、形成光學切片，並回顧技術歷史；教育性公開文章。
references.scopeEn: Explains how laser-scanning confocal rejects out-of-focus light with a pinhole to form optical sections and reviews the technique's history; public educational article.

references.title: Evident：什麼是共軛焦顯微鏡
references.scope: 描述針孔作為空間濾波器、厚樣品的序列光學切片與共軛焦影像的形成；廠商知識庫文章。
references.scopeEn: Describes the pinhole as a spatial filter, serial optical sections of thick specimens and confocal image formation; vendor knowledge-hub article.

references.title: ZEISS：共軛焦雷射掃描顯微鏡產品頁
references.scope: LSM 系列與 Airyscan 等模組的公開產品分類；用於理解現代雷射掃描共軛焦的系統構成，不含設計參數。
references.scopeEn: Public product classes of the LSM series and modules such as Airyscan; useful for the architecture of modern laser-scanning confocals, no design parameters.

references.title: 橫河電機：CSU-W1 寬視場轉盤式共軛焦掃描單元
references.titleEn: Yokogawa: CSU-W1 widefield confocal scanner unit
references.scope: 轉盤式（微透鏡陣列加針孔盤）共軛焦的公開產品說明，對比單點掃描的速度與劑量差異。
references.scopeEn: Public product description of spinning-disk confocal (microlens array plus pinhole disk), contrasting speed and dose with single-point scanning.

references.title: 諾貝爾獎：2014 年化學獎新聞稿（超解析螢光顯微術）
references.titleEn: Nobel Prize: Press release, Chemistry 2014 (super-resolved fluorescence microscopy)
references.publisher: Nobel Prize Outreach / Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
references.scope: 官方新聞稿，說明 Abbe 約 0.2 µm 的極限、STED 以第二道雷射關閉焦點周圍螢光的原理，以及單分子螢光開關疊加成像的原理；不含儀器參數。
references.scopeEn: Official press release explaining Abbe's roughly 0.2 µm limit, the STED principle of switching off fluorescence around the focus with a second laser, and imaging by accumulating switched single molecules; no instrument parameters.

references.title: abberior：萬用型 STED 顯微鏡（技術回顧摘要）
references.titleEn: abberior: A stimulated emission depletion (STED) microscope of all trades
references.scope: STED 儀器製造商公開的技術回顧摘要，涵蓋時間解析偵測、活細胞智慧照明、深層組織動態像差校正與 MINFLUX 展望；課程的飽和數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public technical-review abstract from a STED instrument maker covering time-resolved detection, intelligent illumination for live cells, dynamic aberration correction in deep tissue and an outlook on MINFLUX; the course's saturation numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Babraham 研究所：超解析成像設備（SIM 與 STORM）
references.titleEn: Babraham Institute: Super Resolution Imaging (SIM and STORM)
references.scope: 研究所影像核心設施頁面，說明 2D/3D/TIRF SIM 約兩倍解析度（理論 120 到 180 nm）與 N-STORM、dSTORM、PALM 約 20 到 50 nm 的理論解析度及其緩衝液需求。
references.scopeEn: Institute imaging-facility page describing 2D/3D/TIRF SIM at about twice conventional resolution (theoretical 120 to 180 nm) and N-STORM, dSTORM and PALM at a theoretical 20 to 50 nm with special buffer requirements.

related.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「繞射極限與三種繞過策略」與「漂移校正與焦距鎖定」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；共軛焦顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "The diffraction limit and three ways around it" and "Drift correction and focus lock" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Confocal microscopy must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦SIM 頻率混合、STED 損耗飽和、單分子定位精度、標記密度與奈奎斯特、漂移校正與解析度預算；共軛焦顯微鏡則以針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on SIM frequency mixing, STED depletion saturation, single-molecule localization precision, labeling density and Nyquist, drift correction and resolution budgets; Confocal microscopy centres on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

把本課算例的一個假設移到共軛焦顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching” and “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confocal microscopy, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
related.transfer: 可遷移「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」與「方位校正與 Ψ、Δ 的求解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" and "Azimuth calibration and the solution for Ψ and Δ" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical interference coatings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從 Ψ/Δ 與菲涅耳反演到偏光元件、測角儀與擬合的橢偏儀建置；光學薄膜干涉鍍膜則以以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from Ψ/Δ and Fresnel inversion to polarizing optics, goniometer and model fitting in ellipsometer construction; Optical interference coatings centres on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」與「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學薄膜干涉鍍膜，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「入射角、偏振與公差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” and “The two interfaces of a single film”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical interference coatings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: J.A. Woollam：橢偏術常見問題
references.scope: 說明 Ψ、Δ 的定義、為何用比值量測、入射角選擇與模型擬合的基本概念；為廠商公開教材，不含專有演算法。
references.scopeEn: Explains the definitions of Ψ and Δ, why ratio measurement is used, the choice of angle of incidence and the basics of model fitting; public vendor material without proprietary algorithms.

references.title: HORIBA：橢偏術學院
references.scope: 光譜橢偏術原理、儀器架構（偏光鏡、調制器、分析器）與應用的公開教學入口。
references.scopeEn: Public tutorial portal on spectroscopic-ellipsometry principles, instrument architecture (polarizer, modulator, analyzer) and applications.

references.title: SVC 教程 M-102：橢偏術導論
references.titleEn: SVC tutorial M-102: Introduction to Ellipsometry
references.scope: 專業學會的橢偏術課程大綱，涵蓋菲涅耳反射、薄膜模型與資料分析；用於確認本課的教學範圍符合業界教程。
references.scopeEn: Professional-society course outline covering Fresnel reflection, thin-film models and data analysis; used to confirm that the course scope matches industry tutorials.

references.title: 普渡大學 RIC：J.A. Woollam 橢偏術教程講義
references.titleEn: Purdue University RIC: J.A. Woollam ellipsometry tutorial handout
references.publisher: Purdue University, Chemistry Research Instrumentation Center
references.scope: 大學儀器中心轉載的廠商教程，含 Ψ–Δ 軌跡圖與薄膜週期性的說明；作為輔助閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Vendor tutorial redistributed by a university instrumentation centre, including Ψ–Δ trajectories and thin-film periodicity; supplementary reading.

references.title: Edmund Optics：光學鍍膜導論
references.titleEn: Edmund Optics: An introduction to optical coatings
references.scope: 供應商應用筆記，說明薄膜干涉、單層與多層膜的反射率行為、鍍膜類型與沉積方法概要；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Vendor application note explaining thin-film interference, single- and multilayer reflectance behaviour, coating types and an overview of deposition methods; no process recipe.

references.title: Fraunhofer IOF：功能性表面與鍍膜
references.titleEn: Fraunhofer IOF: Functional surfaces and coatings
references.publisher: Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Optics and Precision Engineering IOF
references.scope: 研究機構公開頁面，說明光學鍍膜與表面功能化的能力範圍、沉積技術與薄膜特性分析；提供機構與方法脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Institute page describing competences in optical coatings and surface functionalisation, deposition technologies and thin-film characterisation; provides institutional and methodological context.

references.title: LAYERTEC：光學干涉鍍膜技術說明
references.titleEn: LAYERTEC: Optical interference coatings technology note
references.scope: 鍍膜廠公開技術頁，說明干涉鍍膜的原理、四分之一波堆與材料對光譜性能的影響；不含專有配方。
references.scopeEn: Coating-manufacturer technology page explaining interference-coating principles, quarter-wave stacks and the influence of materials on spectral performance; no proprietary recipe.

references.title: Edmund Optics：增透（AR）鍍膜
references.scope: 供應商應用筆記，說明單層、V 形與寬帶增透膜的原理、典型反射率曲線與適用波段；不含製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Vendor application note on single-layer, V-coat and broadband antireflection principles, typical reflectance curves and applicable bands; no process parameters.

references.title: Thorlabs：光學鍍膜總覽
references.scope: 供應商鍍膜總覽頁，列出增透、高反射與其他鍍膜類型的波段、入射角與典型性能曲線；用於規格表的對照。
references.scopeEn: Vendor coating overview listing antireflection, high-reflection and other coating types with bands, incidence angles and typical performance curves; used for specification-sheet comparison.

references.title: Fraunhofer IOF：功能性光學表面與鍍膜業務領域
references.titleEn: Fraunhofer IOF: Functional optical surfaces and coatings business field
references.publisher: Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Optics and Precision Engineering IOF
references.scope: 研究機構公開頁面，涵蓋塑膠光學的增透結構、原子層沉積與可見近紅外鍍膜；提供奈米結構增透與低溫製程的脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Institute page covering antireflective structures on plastic optics, atomic layer deposition and visible/near-infrared coatings; provides context for nanostructured antireflection and low-temperature processes.

related.difference: 本課聚焦球倍增因子、塗層與開口、替代法校正與總光通量不確定度；傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀則以麥克森干涉儀、氦氖取樣、解析度與訊雜比交換的 FTIR 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sphere multiplier, coating and ports, substitution calibration and total-flux uncertainty; Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers centres on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「朗伯漫反射壁面與球倍增因子」與「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊、掃描次數與解析度的交換」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Lambertian wall and the sphere multiplier” and “Michelson interferometer and interferogram”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise, scan averaging and the resolution trade", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: Labsphere：積分球理論與應用技術指南
references.titleEn: Labsphere: Integrating Sphere Theory and Applications technical guide
references.scope: 推導球倍增因子、開口比、擋板與塗層對輻射交換的影響；本課的 M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)) 即其公開理論。

references.title: Labsphere：積分球輻射量測與光度量測指南
references.titleEn: Labsphere: Integrating Sphere Radiometry and Photometry guide
references.scope: 說明總通量、輻照度與輻射亮度量測的配置、替代法與自吸收修正；為廠商公開技術文件。
references.scopeEn: Describes configurations for total flux, irradiance and radiance measurement, substitution and self-absorption correction; a public vendor technical document.

references.title: NIST：總光譜輻射通量校正與傳遞標準
references.titleEn: NIST: Calibration and transfer standards for total spectral radiant flux
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 國家實驗室對標準燈總光譜輻射通量的校正服務與追溯鏈說明；本課的比對與 En 值程序以此類服務為對象。
references.scopeEn: National-laboratory description of total-spectral-radiant-flux calibration services for standard lamps and their traceability chain; the course's comparison and En procedures target such services.

references.title: Gigahertz-Optik 知識庫：積分球理論與應用
references.titleEn: Gigahertz-Optik knowledge base: Theory and applications of integrating spheres
references.scope: 光量測基礎教材中的積分球章節，涵蓋塗層材料、擋板與量測配置；為廠商公開教材。

references.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific：FTIR 光譜儀簡介技術說明（TN50674）
references.titleEn: Thermo Fisher Scientific: Introduction to FTIR spectroscopy, technical note TN50674
references.scope: 說明干涉儀、干涉圖、傅立葉轉換與 FTIR 相對於色散式儀器的優勢；為公開教學文件，不含任何機型的內部設計。
references.scopeEn: Explains the interferometer, the interferogram, the Fourier transform and the advantages of FTIR over dispersive instruments; a public tutorial document without internal design details of any model.

references.title: Bruker：FT-IR 例行光譜儀產品頁
references.scope: 商用 FT-IR 光譜儀的公開產品分類與功能說明；課程數值為教學假設，不引用其規格。
references.scopeEn: Public product classification and feature description of commercial FT-IR spectrometers; course numbers are teaching assumptions and do not quote its specifications.

references.title: NIST：SRM 1921b 聚苯乙烯紅外穿透波長標準證書

references.scopeEn: Certified peak positions and conditions of use for the polystyrene film used to calibrate FTIR wavenumber axes; the course uses it as the reference material for calibration and acceptance.

references.title: JASCO 學習中心：FTIR 光譜學基礎—紅外光譜儀
references.titleEn: JASCO Learning Center: Fundamentals of FTIR spectroscopy, the IR spectrometer
references.scope: 說明光源、分光鏡、動鏡、偵測器等 FTIR 光譜儀主要元件的功能；為廠商公開教材。
references.scopeEn: Describes the function of the main FTIR components such as source, beamsplitter, moving mirror and detector; a public vendor tutorial.

references.scopeEn: Laser-optics coater's capabilities page describing dielectric high-reflector materials, ion-beam and magnetron sputtering process types and low-loss, high-damage-threshold applications; no recipe.

references.title: Edmund Optics：雷射損傷門檻縮放工具
references.titleEn: Edmund Optics: Laser damage threshold scaling tool
references.scope: 供應商技術工具，說明損傷門檻隨脈寬、波長與光斑的近似縮放與其適用範圍；課程以其原理計算教學數值。
references.scopeEn: Vendor technical tool explaining approximate damage-threshold scaling with pulse width, wavelength and spot size and its range of validity; course numbers are computed from these principles.

references.title: LIGO（Caltech）：LIGO 光學元件
references.publisher: LIGO Laboratory, California Institute of Technology
references.scope: 說明 40 kg 熔融石英測試質量鏡、多層鍍膜、奈米級拋光與極低吸收（約三百萬分之一）的公開頁面；用於極限應用的脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Public page describing the 40 kg fused-silica test-mass mirrors, multilayer coatings, nanometre-level polish and extremely low absorption (about one part in 3.3 million); used for extreme-application context.

references.title: ISO 21254-1：雷射損傷門檻測試方法 第 1 部分
references.titleEn: ISO 21254-1: Test methods for laser-induced damage threshold, Part 1
references.scope: 標準頁面，定義損傷門檻測試的術語與一般原則（1-on-1、S-on-1 等測試模式的基礎）；本課引用其框架而非條文內容。

related.title: 光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統
related.titleEn: Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「物質波馬赫—曾德干涉與重力相位」與「系統效應的量測、反轉與修正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Matter-wave Mach–Zehnder interferometry and the gravity phase" and "Measuring, reversing and correcting systematic effects" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on raman-pulse atom interferometry, the k_eff·g·T² phase and microgal-level absolute-gravity engineering; Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems centres on ultrahigh vacuum, cooling and clock lasers, systematic shifts and 10⁻¹⁸-level evaluation of a strontium lattice clock, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「π/2–π–π/2 拉曼脈衝序列」與「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「不確定度預算與穩定度瓶頸」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “The π/2–π–π/2 Raman pulse sequence” and “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Uncertainty budget and stability bottlenecks", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 光纖陀螺儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子」與「比例因子校正與條紋計數讀出」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光纖陀螺儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor" and "Scale-factor calibration and fringe-counting readout" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Fiber-optic gyroscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦Sagnac 拍頻、鎖定與抖動、Zerodur 環腔製作與導航級誤差預算；光纖陀螺儀則以薩格納克相位、互易架構、線圈熱效應與散粒雜訊 ARW 的干涉式光纖陀螺工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sagnac beat frequency, lock-in and dither, Zerodur ring-cavity construction and navigation-grade error budgets; Fiber-optic gyroscopes centres on sagnac phase, reciprocal architecture, coil thermal effects and shot-noise ARW in interferometric fiber-optic gyroscopes, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「反向行進光束與拍頻」與「薩格納克相位與線圈比例因子」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光纖陀螺儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊與零偏誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency” and “Sagnac phase and coil scale factor”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fiber-optic gyroscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise and bias error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「電子波長、散射與對比機制」與「放大率、相機長度與像差量測的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" and "Calibrating magnification, camera length and aberration measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦300 kV 電子波長、相位對比傳遞函數、Cs 校正與資訊極限的穩定度工程；掃描電子顯微鏡則以電子探針直徑預算、Everhart–Thornley 偵測、作用體積與放大率校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on 300 kV electron wavelength, phase-contrast transfer function, Cs correction and the stability engineering behind the information limit; Scanning electron microscopes centres on probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」與「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掃描電子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” and “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scanning electron microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」與「TEM 薄片製備的厚度與損傷預算」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" and "Thickness and damage budget of TEM lamella preparation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning electron microscopes must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ion–solid sputtering, current versus spot size, liquid-metal ion sources, dual-beam geometry, TEM-lamella damage and milling-rate calibration; Scanning electron microscopes centres on probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」與「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掃描電子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” and “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scanning electron microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: X 光光電子能譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「濺射、離子化機率與有用產率」與「相對靈敏度因子與深度尺度校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；X 光光電子能譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sputtering, ionisation probability and useful yield" and "Relative sensitivity factors and depth-scale calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of X-ray photoelectron spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦濺射與離子化機率、有用產率、質量解析、相對靈敏度因子與深度剖析的痕量分析工程；X 光光電子能譜儀則以光電子結合能、非彈性平均自由徑、單色器與半球分析器的表面化學分析工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sputtering and ionisation probability, useful yield, mass resolution, relative sensitivity factors and depth-profiling engineering for trace analysis; X-ray photoelectron spectrometers centres on photoelectron binding energy, inelastic mean free path, monochromator and hemispherical analyser engineering for surface chemistry, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「碰撞級聯與二次離子」與「光電子動能與結合能」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到X 光光電子能譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「定量分析、偵測極限與雜訊」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Collision cascade and secondary ions” and “Photoelectron kinetic and binding energy”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to X-ray photoelectron spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quantification, detection limits and noise", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 超導磁體低溫系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「拉莫進動與自旋極化」與「勻場、磁場均勻度與線形校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超導磁體低溫系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Larmor precession and spin polarisation" and "Shimming, field homogeneity and line-shape calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拉莫頻率、化學位移、超導磁體與鎖場、探頭訊噪比、勻場與定量 NMR 的弛豫預算；超導磁體低溫系統則以NbTi/Nb₃Sn 臨界面、4 K 熱負載預算、電流引線、失超保護與持續電流運轉為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on larmor frequency, chemical shift, superconducting magnet and lock, probe signal-to-noise, shimming and relaxation budgets for quantitative NMR; Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets centres on NbTi/Nb3Sn critical surface, 4 K heat-load budget, current leads, quench protection and persistent-mode operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「主磁場中的核自旋」與「NbTi 導體工作點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導磁體低溫系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「失超偵測、儲能 ½LI² 與氦氣釋放」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Nuclear spins in the main field” and “NbTi conductor operating point”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quench detection, stored energy ½LI² and helium release", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 超導磁體低溫系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「³He 有限溶解度與稀釋製冷」與「毫克耳文溫度計量與校正鏈」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超導磁體低溫系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on continuous cooling from ³He/⁴He phase separation, heat exchangers, heat-load budgets and millikelvin thermometry; Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets centres on NbTi/Nb3Sn critical surface, 4 K heat-load budget, current leads, quench protection and persistent-mode operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「混合腔相界面」與「NbTi 導體工作點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導磁體低溫系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「失超偵測、儲能 ½LI² 與氦氣釋放」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Mixing-chamber phase boundary” and “NbTi conductor operating point”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quench detection, stored energy ½LI² and helium release", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transfer: 可遷移「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」與「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" and "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦出氣率、傳導率、金屬密封、烘烤與壓力量測構成的 10⁻¹¹ mbar 腔體工程；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統則以鍶光晶格鐘的超高真空、冷卻與鐘雷射、系統位移與 10⁻¹⁸ 級評估為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on outgassing, conductance, metal seals, bakeout and pressure measurement that make a 10⁻¹¹ mbar chamber; Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems centres on ultrahigh vacuum, cooling and clock lasers, systematic shifts and 10⁻¹⁸-level evaluation of a strontium lattice clock, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「腔壁的氣體來源」與「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「不確定度預算與穩定度瓶頸」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Gas sources at the chamber wall” and “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Uncertainty budget and stability bottlenecks", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: OptoSigma：振動阻尼與隔振概念
references.titleEn: OptoSigma: Vibration damping and isolation concepts
references.scope: 說明傳遞率、√2 隔振起點、阻尼取捨、氣墊隔振腳、自動水平閥與蜂巢桌面結構的公開產品技術頁。
references.scopeEn: Public product-technology page on transmissibility, the √2 isolation threshold, the damping trade-off, pneumatic isolators, auto-leveling valves and honeycomb top construction.

references.title: DAEIL SYSTEMS：被動隔振系統技術說明
references.titleEn: DAEIL SYSTEMS: Passive vibration isolation system technical note
references.scope: 以質量—彈簧—阻尼模型解釋氣墊隔振、頻率比與阻尼比對傳遞率的影響，以及被動隔振在 10 Hz 以下的限制。
references.scopeEn: Explains pneumatic isolation with a mass–spring–damper model, the effect of frequency ratio and damping ratio on transmissibility, and the limits of passive isolation below 10 Hz.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：震動隔離（四級擺與主動平台）
references.titleEn: LIGO Laboratory: Vibration isolation (quadruple pendulum and active platforms)
references.scope: 說明 40 kg 測試質量、360 kg 四級擺、0.4 mm 石英纖維、主鏈與反作用鏈、平台 2×10⁻¹³ m 與懸吊再降六個數量級的公開數字。
references.scopeEn: Gives the public figures for the 40 kg test mass, 360 kg quadruple pendulum, 0.4 mm silica fibres, main and reaction chains, 2×10⁻¹³ m delivered by the platforms and the further six orders from the suspensions.

references.title: 亞利桑那大學 OPTI 521 教材：光學科學與工程的隔振
references.titleEn: University of Arizona OPTI 521 tutorial: Vibration isolation for optical science and engineering
references.publisher: University of Arizona College of Optical Sciences
references.scope: 光機課程的學生教材，整理傳遞率公式、氣墊隔振器原理、蜂巢桌面與柔度曲線等效能指標。
references.scopeEn: Optomechanics course tutorial summarizing the transmissibility formula, pneumatic isolator principles, honeycomb tops and performance metrics such as the compliance curve.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：LIGO 的干涉儀
references.scope: 4 km 臂長、法布里–培羅臂腔與功率回收的公開說明，提供鎖定取得單元所需的腔體參數背景。
references.scopeEn: Public description of the 4 km arms, Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and power recycling, giving the cavity background used in the lock-acquisition unit.

references.title: Virgo 合作團隊：偵測器介紹
references.scope: 3 km 雙臂干涉儀的公開架構說明，用於對照超級衰減器的設計脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Public architecture description of the 3 km two-arm interferometer, used as context for the superattenuator design.

references.title: 格拉斯哥大學重力研究所
references.titleEn: University of Glasgow: Institute for Gravitational Research
references.scope: 列出準單體懸吊與石英纖維拉製等 Advanced LIGO 關鍵技術的研究單位頁面。
references.scopeEn: Research-group page listing quasi-monolithic suspensions and silica-fibre pulling among its Advanced LIGO enabling technologies.

references.title: Scienta Omicron：LT STM Lab 低溫掃描穿隧顯微鏡
references.titleEn: Scienta Omicron: LT STM Lab low-temperature STM
references.scope: 液氦槽式低溫 STM 的公開規格：基礎溫度 < 5 K、持冷時間 > 65 h、能量解析度 < 1 meV、雙層輻射屏；課程中的雜訊與熱負載數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public specifications of a helium-bath low-temperature STM: base temperature below 5 K, hold time above 65 h, energy resolution below 1 meV, two radiation shields; course noise and heat-load numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: IBM 歷史：掃描穿隧顯微鏡
references.titleEn: IBM history: The scanning tunneling microscope
references.scope: IBM 蘇黎世實驗室 1981 年發明 STM 的公開工程史與後續原子操控成果；不含儀器設計細節。
references.scopeEn: Public engineering history of the 1981 STM invention at IBM Zurich and later atom-manipulation results; no instrument design details.

references.title: 諾貝爾基金會：1986 年物理獎摘要
references.titleEn: Nobel Foundation: The Nobel Prize in Physics 1986 summary
references.scope: Binnig 與 Rohrer 因設計掃描穿隧顯微鏡獲獎的官方說明，提供穿隧原理與歷史脈絡。
references.scopeEn: Official statement of the prize to Binnig and Rohrer for the design of the scanning tunneling microscope, giving the tunneling principle and historical context.

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源
references.scope: 說明 3 GeV、周長 518 m 的台灣光子源儲存環與光束線規劃，作為本課 3 GeV 儲存環參數的公開背景。
references.scopeEn: Describes the 3 GeV, 518 m Taiwan Photon Source ring and its beamline plan, the public background for the 3 GeV ring parameters used here.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源
references.scope: 公開說明混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格以每晶胞 7 片彎轉磁鐵取代 2 片，水平發射度降至約 150 pm。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the hybrid multi-bend achromat lattice that replaces 2 dipoles per cell with 7, lowering horizontal emittance to about 150 pm.

references.title: Diamond：同步輻射光源如何運作
references.titleEn: Diamond Light Source: How Diamond Works
references.scope: 直線加速器、增能環、儲存環彎轉磁鐵與光束線整體鏈路的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the chain from linac and booster to storage-ring bending magnets and beamlines.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 射頻腔以振盪電場加速並使粒子成團的公開說明（以 LHC 為例），作為同步相位與 RF 桶的觀念參照。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of how RF cavities accelerate particles with an oscillating field and sort them into bunches, using the LHC; a conceptual reference for synchronous phase and the RF bucket.

references.title: Forck（GSI）：束流儀測與診斷講義（JUAS）
references.titleEn: Forck (GSI): Lecture Notes on Beam Instrumentation and Diagnostics (JUAS)
references.scope: 大學加速器學校講義，含電容式與鈕扣式拾取電極的位置量測原理；課程中的轉移阻抗與靈敏度數值為依其原理建立的教學假設。
references.scopeEn: University accelerator-school notes covering capacitive and button pickups for position measurement; course transfer-impedance and sensitivity numbers are teaching assumptions built on its principles.

references.title: Bergoz：依量測類型選擇產品（BPM 與電流變壓器）
references.titleEn: Bergoz: Products by measurement type (BPM electronics and current transformers)
references.scope: 列出對數比、單次通過與多次通過的 BPM 電子學以及非破壞性束流電流變壓器；公開產品分類，不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Lists log-ratio, single-pass and multi-pass BPM electronics and non-destructive beam-current transformers; public product classification, not a design manual.

references.title: Instrumentation Technologies：Libera 束流診斷產品入口
references.scope: 數位 BPM 處理器與低階射頻控制產品的公開入口；課程不引用任何專有規格。
references.scopeEn: Public portal for digital BPM processors and low-level RF products; the course quotes no proprietary specification.

references.title: X 光資料手冊 2.1 節：同步輻射特性
references.titleEn: X-Ray Data Booklet Section 2.1: Characteristics of synchrotron radiation
references.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Center for X-Ray Optics and Advanced Light Source
references.scope: 彎轉磁鐵、扭擺磁鐵與波盪器的光譜、功率與亮度公式；課程中的功率與諧波估算依此整理。
references.scopeEn: Spectral, power and brightness formulas for bending magnets, wigglers and undulators; the course's power and harmonic estimates follow it.

references.title: X 光資料手冊 4.2 節：掠射鏡面反射率
references.titleEn: X-Ray Data Booklet Section 4.2: Specular reflectivities for grazing-incidence mirrors
references.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Center for X-Ray Optics
references.scope: 常用塗層在不同掠射角的 X 光反射率曲線與臨界角概念；課程的臨界角數值為自由電子近似的教學估算。
references.scopeEn: X-ray reflectivity curves of common coatings versus grazing angle and the critical-angle concept; the course's critical angles are free-electron teaching estimates.

references.title: 同步輻射期刊 2025：NSRRC 蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A、TPS 07A 與 TLS 15A1 現況
references.titleEn: J. Synchrotron Rad. 2025: Status of the NSRRC protein-crystallography core facility (TPS 05A, TPS 07A, TLS 15A1)
references.publisher: International Union of Crystallography, Journal of Synchrotron Radiation
references.scope: 描述 TPS 3 GeV、1.6 nm·rad 儲存環上以 IU22 波盪器與 KB 鏡聚焦的光束線配置與光斑尺寸。
references.scopeEn: Describes beamline layouts with IU22 undulators and KB focusing on the 3 GeV, 1.6 nm·rad TPS ring, with achieved spot sizes.

references.title: 第四代高能 X 光同步輻射光源的同調性質
references.titleEn: Coherence properties of the high-energy fourth-generation X-ray synchrotron sources
references.scope: 討論發射度與同調分率的關係及第四代光源的同調性提升，作為相空間單元的延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Discusses emittance versus coherent fraction and the coherence gain of fourth-generation sources; further reading for the phase-space unit.

references.scopeEn: Public explanation of accelerating electron bunches in niobium superconducting resonators near absolute zero, with facility overview.

references.title: LCLS：設施總覽
references.scope: 說明 LCLS 自 2009 年運轉、120 Hz 脈衝、LCLS-II 升級到每秒百萬脈衝的公開概述。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of LCLS operating since 2009 at 120 Hz and the LCLS-II upgrade to a million pulses per second.

references.title: LCLS：機器參數
references.scope: 公布銅直線加速器 120 Hz、光子能量 200 eV 到 25 keV、脈衝能量 0.5 到 2 mJ、脈衝寬度 10 到 50 fs，以及超導直線加速器 4 GeV 的參數。
references.scopeEn: Publishes copper-linac parameters of 120 Hz, 200 eV to 25 keV photon energy, 0.5 to 2 mJ pulse energy and 10 to 50 fs duration, plus the 4 GeV superconducting-linac parameters.

references.title: LCLS-II-HE：設計與性能
references.scope: 說明 LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 的超導模組（L1 到 L3）、1 MHz 重複率、軟 X 光與硬 X 光波盪器，以及 LCLS-II-HE 延伸到 8 GeV 的規劃。
references.scopeEn: Describes the LCLS-II superconducting modules in the first 750 m of tunnel (L1 to L3), 1 MHz repetition rate, soft and hard X-ray undulators, and the LCLS-II-HE extension to 8 GeV.

references.title: 傑佛遜實驗室：SRF 研究所

references.scopeEn: Describes design, fabrication, testing and installation of SRF cavities and cryomodules, plus niobium cavity testing and film research; no proprietary recipes.

references.title: Padamsee：超導射頻腔與附屬元件設計主題（CAS 講義）

references.scopeEn: CERN Accelerator School notes covering cavity shape design, couplers and tuners; course values for R/Q, G and K_L are teaching assumptions built on its principles.

references.title: 傑佛遜實驗室：SRF 研究所

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源（TPS）
references.scope: 公開說明 TPS 的 3 GeV 等級能量、518 m 周長、24 晶胞 DBA 晶格、24 個插件直線段與 500 MHz 超導射頻模組。
references.scopeEn: Public description of TPS: 3 GeV-class energy, 518 m circumference, 24-cell DBA lattice, 24 insertion-device straights and a 500 MHz superconducting RF module.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源
references.scope: 公開說明混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格以每晶胞 7 片彎轉磁鐵取代 2 片，水平發射度降至約 150 pm。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the hybrid multi-bend achromat lattice that replaces 2 dipoles per cell with 7, lowering horizontal emittance to about 150 pm.

references.title: Diamond：同步輻射光源如何運作

references.scope: 直線加速器、增能環、儲存環彎轉磁鐵與光束線整體鏈路的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the chain from linac and booster to storage-ring bending magnets and beamlines.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 射頻腔以振盪電場加速並使粒子成團的公開說明（以 LHC 為例），作為同步相位與 RF 桶的觀念參照。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of how RF cavities accelerate particles with an oscillating field and sort them into bunches, using the LHC; a conceptual reference for synchronous phase and the RF bucket.

references.title: 傑佛遜實驗室：SRF 研究所
references.scope: 說明超導射頻腔與低溫模組的設計、製作、測試與安裝，以及鈮腔測試與鈮薄膜研究；不含專有配方。
references.scopeEn: Describes design, fabrication, testing and installation of SRF cavities and cryomodules, plus niobium cavity testing and film research; no proprietary recipes.

references.title: 歐洲 XFEL：運作原理（鈮超導諧振腔）
references.titleEn: European XFEL: How it works (niobium superconducting resonators)
references.scope: 公開說明以鈮製超導諧振腔在接近絕對零度下加速電子束的原理與設施概況。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of accelerating electron bunches in niobium superconducting resonators near absolute zero, with facility overview.

references.title: Padamsee：超導射頻腔與附屬元件設計主題（CAS 講義）
references.titleEn: Padamsee: Design Topics for Superconducting RF Cavities and Ancillaries (CAS lecture notes)
references.scope: CERN 加速器學校講義，涵蓋腔形設計、耦合器與調諧器；課程中的 R/Q、G、K_L 等數值為依其原理建立的教學假設。
references.scopeEn: CERN Accelerator School notes covering cavity shape design, couplers and tuners; course values for R/Q, G and K_L are teaching assumptions built on its principles.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 說明射頻腔如何以振盪電場加速並分群束流，以及 LHC 的 400 MHz 超導腔配置；為科普層級概述。
references.scopeEn: Explains how RF cavities accelerate and bunch beams with oscillating fields and the LHC 400 MHz superconducting cavity layout; outreach-level overview.

references.title: CERN 加速器學校：射頻腔設計講義（E. Jensen）
references.titleEn: CERN Accelerator School: RF Cavity Design (E. Jensen, Chios 2011)
references.scope: 涵蓋柱形腔 TM010、R/Q、分路阻抗、Q 值、等效電路與束流負載的講義；課程公式與慣例依此整理。
references.scopeEn: Lecture covering the pillbox TM010 mode, R/Q, shunt impedance, Q, the equivalent circuit and beam loading; course formulas and conventions follow it.

references.title: KEKB 設計報告第 8 章：射頻系統
references.titleEn: KEKB Design Report, Chapter 8: RF system
references.publisher: KEK High Energy Accelerator Research Organization
references.scope: 列出 ARES 常溫腔的頻率、腔壓、壁損、Q 值、R/Q 與束流負載失諧分析；課程數值僅取其量級作教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Lists frequency, cavity voltage, wall loss, Q, R/Q and beam-loading detuning analysis for the ARES normal-conducting cavity; course values borrow only its orders of magnitude as teaching assumptions.

references.title: CERN 加速器學校論文集：加速器射頻技術（Ebeltoft 2010）
references.titleEn: Proceedings of the CAS–CERN Accelerator School: RF for Accelerators (Ebeltoft 2010)
references.scope: 射頻功率產生與傳輸、腔體與耦合器設計、低階射頻電子學與束流診斷的完整講義集。
references.scopeEn: Complete lecture collection on RF power generation and transport, cavity and coupler design, low-level RF electronics and beam diagnostics.

references.title: 美國國家強磁場實驗室：低溫研究群設施
references.scope: 低溫研究群的公開設施說明，含冷凍機、液氦研究用低溫容器、約 4 K 的流動設施與 MLI 熱量計；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public description of the cryogenics group's facilities, including cryocoolers, liquid-helium research cryostats, flow facilities near 4 K and an MLI calorimeter; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Bruker：低溫超導線材（Nb₃Sn）
references.scope: 青銅法與 RRP 法 Nb₃Sn 線材的公開產品說明，提及超過 20 T 的 NMR 磁體與加速器、核融合應用；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Public product description of bronze-route and RRP Nb3Sn wire, citing NMR magnets above 20 T and accelerator and fusion uses; no process recipes.

references.title: SHI Cryogenics：RDK-415D2 4 K 冷頭系列
references.scope: 4 K GM 冷頭的公開規格：二級 1.5 W @ 4.2 K、一級 35 W @ 50 K（50 Hz）與 10,000 小時保養週期。
references.scopeEn: Public specification of a 4 K GM cold head: 1.5 W at 4.2 K on the second stage, 35 W at 50 K on the first stage (50 Hz) and a 10,000-hour maintenance interval.

references.title: Quantum Design Oxford：超導磁體類型與技術
references.titleEn: Quantum Design Oxford: Superconducting magnet types and technology
references.scope: 螺線管、分裂對與向量磁體的公開型錄，區分 Cryofree（至 16 T）與液氦冷卻（至 20 T）系統；不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Public catalogue of solenoid, split-pair and vector magnets that separates Cryofree systems (to 16 T) from liquid-helium-cooled ones (to 20 T); not a design manual.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Synchrotron storage rings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

references.titleEn: Forck (GSI): Lecture Notes on Beam Instrumentation and Diagnostics (JUAS)
references.scope: 大學加速器學校講義，含電容式與鈕扣式拾取電極的位置量測原理；課程中的轉移阻抗與靈敏度數值為依其原理建立的教學假設。
references.scopeEn: University accelerator-school notes covering capacitive and button pickups for position measurement; course transfer-impedance and sensitivity numbers are teaching assumptions built on its principles.

references.title: Bergoz：依量測類型選擇產品（BPM 與電流變壓器）
references.titleEn: Bergoz: Products by measurement type (BPM electronics and current transformers)
references.scope: 列出對數比、單次通過與多次通過的 BPM 電子學以及非破壞性束流電流變壓器；公開產品分類，不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Lists log-ratio, single-pass and multi-pass BPM electronics and non-destructive beam-current transformers; public product classification, not a design manual.

references.title: Instrumentation Technologies：Libera 束流診斷產品入口
references.scope: 數位 BPM 處理器與低階射頻控制產品的公開入口；課程不引用任何專有規格。
references.scopeEn: Public portal for digital BPM processors and low-level RF products; the course quotes no proprietary specification.

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源（TPS）
references.scope: 公開說明 TPS 的 3 GeV 等級能量、518 m 周長、24 晶胞 DBA 晶格、24 個插件直線段與 500 MHz 超導射頻模組。
references.scopeEn: Public description of TPS: 3 GeV-class energy, 518 m circumference, 24-cell DBA lattice, 24 insertion-device straights and a 500 MHz superconducting RF module.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源
references.scope: 公開說明混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格以每晶胞 7 片彎轉磁鐵取代 2 片，水平發射度降至約 150 pm。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the hybrid multi-bend achromat lattice that replaces 2 dipoles per cell with 7, lowering horizontal emittance to about 150 pm.

references.title: Diamond：同步輻射光源如何運作
references.titleEn: Diamond Light Source: How Diamond Works
references.scope: 直線加速器、增能環、儲存環彎轉磁鐵與光束線整體鏈路的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the chain from linac and booster to storage-ring bending magnets and beamlines.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 射頻腔以振盪電場加速並使粒子成團的公開說明（以 LHC 為例），作為同步相位與 RF 桶的觀念參照。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of how RF cavities accelerate particles with an oscillating field and sort them into bunches, using the LHC; a conceptual reference for synchronous phase and the RF bucket.

references.title: CAEN：FERS-5200 分散式前端讀出平台
references.titleEn: CAEN: FERS-5200 distributed front-end readout platform
references.scope: 64/128 通道前端卡、Citiroc、Radioroc、Psiroc 與 picoTDC 前端 ASIC、電荷與時間量測、光纖集中器與通道數；為產品資訊，不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: 64/128-channel front-end cards, Citiroc, Radioroc, Psiroc and picoTDC front-end ASICs, charge and time measurement, optical concentrators and channel counts; product information, not a design manual.

references.title: ALICE 合作團：TPC 讀出與前端電子
references.titleEn: ALICE Collaboration: TPC readout and front-end electronics
references.scope: 524,160 個墊片各接一個前端通道，前端卡經 6552 條光纖以 3.28 TB/s 送往 360 片 FPGA 讀出卡；本課用作大型多通道讀出的尺度參照。
references.scopeEn: 524,160 pads each connected to one front-end channel, front-end cards streaming 3.28 TB/s over 6552 optical links to 360 FPGA readout cards; used here as the scale reference for large multi-channel readout.

references.title: CAEN：電子儀器產品總覽

references.scope: 同步輻射光束線元件供應商的公開入口，含單色器與液氮冷卻器產品類別；不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Public portal of a synchrotron beamline-component supplier with monochromator and cryocooler product categories; not a design manual.

references.title: Diamond：同步輻射光源如何運作
references.titleEn: Diamond Light Source: How Diamond Works
references.scope: 直線加速器、增能環、儲存環彎轉磁鐵與光束線整體鏈路的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the chain from linac and booster to storage-ring bending magnets and beamlines.

references.title: X 光資料手冊 2.1 節：同步輻射特性

references.scopeEn: Spectral, power and brightness formulas for bending magnets, wigglers and undulators; the course's power and harmonic estimates follow it.

references.title: X 光資料手冊 4.2 節：掠射鏡面反射率

references.scopeEn: X-ray reflectivity curves of common coatings versus grazing angle and the critical-angle concept; the course's critical angles are free-electron teaching estimates.

references.publisher: International Union of Crystallography, Journal of Synchrotron Radiation
references.scope: 描述 TPS 3 GeV、1.6 nm·rad 儲存環上以 IU22 波盪器與 KB 鏡聚焦的光束線配置與光斑尺寸。
references.scopeEn: Describes beamline layouts with IU22 undulators and KB focusing on the 3 GeV, 1.6 nm·rad TPS ring, with achieved spot sizes.

references.title: 第四代高能 X 光同步輻射光源的同調性質
references.titleEn: Coherence properties of the high-energy fourth-generation X-ray synchrotron sources

references.scopeEn: Discusses emittance versus coherent fraction and the coherence gain of fourth-generation sources; further reading for the phase-space unit.

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源（TPS）
references.scope: 公開說明 TPS 的 3 GeV 等級能量、518 m 周長、24 晶胞 DBA 晶格、24 個插件直線段與 500 MHz 超導射頻模組。
references.scopeEn: Public description of TPS: 3 GeV-class energy, 518 m circumference, 24-cell DBA lattice, 24 insertion-device straights and a 500 MHz superconducting RF module.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源
references.scope: 公開說明混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格以每晶胞 7 片彎轉磁鐵取代 2 片，水平發射度降至約 150 pm。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the hybrid multi-bend achromat lattice that replaces 2 dipoles per cell with 7, lowering horizontal emittance to about 150 pm.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 射頻腔以振盪電場加速並使粒子成團的公開說明（以 LHC 為例），作為同步相位與 RF 桶的觀念參照。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of how RF cavities accelerate particles with an oscillating field and sort them into bunches, using the LHC; a conceptual reference for synchronous phase and the RF bucket.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on instrument engineering of moderators, neutron guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis spectrometers, ³He detection efficiency and counting statistics; Scintillation particle detectors centres on light yield, Birks quenching, light collection, PMT and SiPM photodetection, energy resolution, gain drift and coincidence timing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱中子與冷中子能譜」與「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到閃爍體粒子偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” and “Activator luminescence centre and decay time”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scintillation particle detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 時間投影室偵測器
related.transfer: 可遷移「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」與「空間解析度：節距、電荷分享與測試束」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；時間投影室偵測器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" and "Spatial resolution: pitch, charge sharing and test beams" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Time-projection-chamber detectors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準；時間投影室偵測器則以氣體漂移、GEM 增益、空間電荷校正與連續讀出的 TPC 工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment; Time-projection-chamber detectors centres on gas drift, GEM gain, space-charge calibration and continuous readout for TPC engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」與「中央電極與漂移體積」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到時間投影室偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” and “Central electrode and drift volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Time-projection-chamber detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
related.transfer: 可遷移「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」與「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；矽像素粒子追蹤器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification" and "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Silicon-pixel particle trackers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦電荷靈敏前端的 ENC、整形時間與系統雜訊預算；矽像素粒子追蹤器則以MIP 訊號、空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、輻射損傷、物質量、讀出頻寬與軌跡式對準為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ENC, shaping time and system noise budgets for charge-sensitive front ends; Silicon-pixel particle trackers centres on MIP signal, depletion and Lorentz drift, radiation damage, material budget, readout bandwidth and track-based alignment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「感測器電荷與回授電容」與「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到矽像素粒子追蹤器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「物質量 X/X₀、多重散射與撞擊參數」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” and “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Silicon-pixel particle trackers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Material budget X/X₀, multiple scattering and impact parameter", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 分段鏡共相控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；分段鏡共相控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Segmented-mirror co-phasing control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測；分段鏡共相控制則以段鏡 piston 誤差的光學代價、邊緣感測器與致動器、2π 模糊、共相相機、設定點校正與段鏡更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」與「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到分段鏡共相控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmented-mirror co-phasing control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.whyEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" and "Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems must be respecified.

related.title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
related.transfer: 可遷移「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」與「波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" and "Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of ESO Very Large Telescope must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦階梯光柵色散、光纖擾頻、真空溫控、波長校正與公分每秒級徑向速度誤差預算；ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT則以四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的薄主鏡、可變形副鏡、雷射導引星、干涉延遲線與 coudé 光譜整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on echelle dispersion, fibre scrambling, vacuum thermal control, wavelength calibration and cm/s radial-velocity error budgets; ESO Very Large Telescope centres on thin primaries, deformable secondary, laser guide stars, interferometric delay lines and coudé spectroscopy across four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」與「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「VLTI 基線、延遲線與光程差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Doppler shift of stellar lines” and “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to ESO Very Large Telescope, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "VLTI baselines, delay lines and the OPD budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.
