references.title: ESO：ESPRESSO 高穩定度光譜儀
references.titleEn: ESO: ESPRESSO, Echelle SPectrograph for Rocky Exoplanets and Stable Spectroscopic Observations
references.scope: 1-UT 與 4-UT 模式、經 coudé 光路進入合併 coudé 設施、解析度模式與 10 cm/s 徑向速度目標。
references.scopeEn: 1-UT and 4-UT modes, light delivery through the coudé trains into the combined coudé facility, resolving-power modes and the 10 cm/s radial-velocity goal.

references.title: ESO：HARPS 高精度徑向速度行星搜尋儀
references.titleEn: ESO: HARPS High Accuracy Radial velocity Planet Searcher
references.scope: 官方頁面，說明 HARPS 為 ESO 3.6 m 望遠鏡上專門搜尋系外行星的光纖饋入高解析階梯光柵光譜儀。
references.scopeEn: Official page describing HARPS as a fibre-fed high-resolution echelle spectrograph on the ESO 3.6 m telescope dedicated to exoplanet searches.

references.title: ESPRESSO：下一代歐洲系外行星獵手（設計論文）
references.titleEn: ESPRESSO: The next European exoplanet hunter (design paper)
references.scope: 儀器團隊公開的設計概述，涵蓋光纖連結、瞳切割、真空與溫控架構與校正策略。
references.scopeEn: Public design overview by the instrument team covering the fibre link, pupil slicing, vacuum and thermal architecture and calibration strategy.

references.title: 天文頻率梳的精度與一致性
references.scope: 以高解析光譜儀上的雷射頻率梳研究波長校正的重複性與一致性，作為頻率梳校正單元的背景。
references.scopeEn: Study of the repeatability and consistency of laser-frequency-comb wavelength calibration on a high-resolution spectrograph, used as background for the comb calibration unit.

references.title: NIST：光學頻率梳主題頁
references.titleEn: NIST: Optical frequency combs topic page
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 國家實驗室對頻率梳原理、自參考與應用（光鐘、光譜、距離量測）的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: National-laboratory public explanation of comb principles, self-referencing and applications such as optical clocks, spectroscopy and ranging.

references.title: NIST 出版品：光學頻率梳—相干地統一電磁頻譜
references.titleEn: NIST publication: Optical frequency combs, coherently uniting the electromagnetic spectrum
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 回顧文章的出版品頁，涵蓋梳齒方程式、f-2f 自參考、光纖梳與微梳的發展；本課的物理關係以此類公開文獻為依據。
references.scopeEn: Publication page of a review covering the comb equation, f-2f self-referencing, fibre combs and microcombs; the course's physical relations follow such public literature.

references.title: Menlo Systems：光學頻率梳產品頁
references.scope: 商用摻鉺光纖梳的公開產品分類與架構（振盪器、放大、f-2f、鎖定電子）；課程數值為教學假設，不引用其規格。
references.scopeEn: Public product classification and architecture of commercial erbium fibre combs (oscillator, amplification, f-2f, locking electronics); course numbers are teaching assumptions and do not quote its specifications.

references.title: TOPTICA：CERO 載波包絡偏移技術頁
references.scope: 說明以腔內方式消除載波包絡偏移頻率的公開技術概念，作為 f_ceo 穩定方法的對照。
references.scopeEn: Public description of an intracavity approach to eliminating the carrier-envelope-offset frequency, used as a contrast to f_ceo locking methods.

references.title: ESO：VLT 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡
references.scope: 單元望遠鏡的 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計、副鏡五自由度、Cassegrain／Nasmyth／coudé 焦點、地平式機架與約 50 t 主鏡單元。
references.scopeEn: Ritchey–Chrétien design of the Unit Telescopes, five-degree-of-freedom secondary, Cassegrain, Nasmyth and coudé foci, alt-azimuth mount and the roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit.

references.title: ESO：VLT 主鏡製作與驗收資料
references.scope: 8.2 m Zerodur 鏡坯尺寸、膨脹係數、150 點支撐、f/1.8、主動模式下的波前與 Strehl 驗收數據，以及 SCHOTT 與 REOSC 的角色。
references.scopeEn: Dimensions, expansion coefficient, 150-point support, f/1.8, active-mode wavefront and Strehl acceptance data of the 8.2 m Zerodur blanks, and the roles of SCHOTT and REOSC.

references.title: ESO：VLT 可變形副鏡
references.titleEn: ESO: The Adaptive Secondary Mirror for the VLT
references.scope: 1120 mm 直徑、1170 個音圈致動器、約 28 mm 間距、90 µm 間隙、80 kHz 內迴路、散熱需求與參與廠商。
references.scopeEn: 1120 mm diameter, 1170 voice-coil actuators, roughly 28 mm pitch, 90 µm gap, 80 kHz internal loop, cooling requirement and participating companies.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 分段鏡共相控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」與「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；分段鏡共相控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" and "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Segmented-mirror co-phasing control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦VLTI 與 CHARA 延遲線、條紋追蹤與雷射計量如何把光程差控制在奈米等級；分段鏡共相控制則以段鏡 piston 誤差的光學代價、邊緣感測器與致動器、2π 模糊、共相相機、設定點校正與段鏡更換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how VLTI and CHARA delay lines, fringe tracking and laser metrology hold optical-path difference at the nanometre level; Segmented-mirror co-phasing control centres on optical cost of segment piston, edge sensors and actuators, 2π ambiguity, phasing cameras, set-point calibration and segment exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「基線向量與幾何延遲」與「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到分段鏡共相控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” and “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Segmented-mirror co-phasing control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: ESO：GRAVITY 儀器介紹（VLTI 四光束合成器）
references.titleEn: ESO: GRAVITY instrument page (VLTI four-beam combiner)
references.scope: 說明 GRAVITY 結合四台望遠鏡、K 波段 2.0–2.4 µm、自帶條紋追蹤器與數十微角秒天體測量精度；公開儀器概述，非設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: States that GRAVITY combines four telescopes in the 2.0–2.4 µm K band, carries its own fringe tracker and reaches tens-of-microarcsecond astrometry; a public instrument overview, not a design manual.

references.title: ESO：GRAVITY 使用者手冊（PDF）
references.scope: 觀測者用手冊，描述條紋追蹤器、光譜模式、計量系統與觀測限制；課程中的延遲率與誤差預算數值為依其原理建立的教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Observer manual describing the fringe tracker, spectral modes, metrology system and observing limits; the course's delay-rate and error-budget numbers are teaching assumptions built on its principles.

references.title: 喬治亞州立大學 CHARA 陣列設施頁
references.titleEn: Georgia State University: The CHARA Array facility page
references.publisher: Center for High Angular Resolution Astronomy, Georgia State University
references.scope: 描述六台 1 m 望遠鏡、34–331 m 的 15 條基線、真空光管與光程延遲線等化、以及光束合成器的配置。
references.scopeEn: Describes the six 1 m telescopes, 15 baselines from 34 to 331 m, vacuum beam pipes, optical-path-length delay lines and beam-combiner configurations.

references.title: MPIA：GRAVITY 儀器計畫頁
references.scope: 合作機構對 GRAVITY 的技術說明，包括條紋追蹤、計量與天體測量目標；用於交叉確認儀器架構。
references.scopeEn: Partner-institute technical description of GRAVITY including fringe tracking, metrology and astrometric goals; used to cross-check the instrument architecture.

references.title: W. M. 凱克天文台：望遠鏡介紹
references.scope: 說明 Keck I 與 Keck II 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片六角段鏡組成，並以感測器與致動器維持段鏡相對位置；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: States that the Keck I and II 10 m primaries consist of 36 hexagonal segments held in relative position by sensors and actuators; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: 凱克望遠鏡段鏡共相：寬頻共相演算法
references.titleEn: Phasing the Mirror Segments of the Keck Telescopes: The Broadband Phasing Algorithm
references.scope: Chanan 等人的寬頻共相方法，摘要列出 ±30 µm 捕獲範圍與約 30 nm 殘差。
references.scopeEn: Chanan and colleagues' broadband phasing method, whose abstract cites a ±30 µm capture range and about 30 nm residual.

references.title: ESO ELT：主鏡 M1
references.titleEn: ESO ELT: The primary mirror M1
references.scope: ELT 798 片段鏡、4 mm 間隙、27 點 whiffletree、warping harness、位置致動器與邊緣感測器，以及每 18 個月重鍍的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public description of the ELT's 798 segments, 4 mm gaps, 27-point whiffletree, warping harness, position actuators and edge sensors, and 18-month recoating cycle.

references.title: ESO 公告：ELT 主鏡邊緣感測器與位置致動器設計進展
references.titleEn: ESO announcement ann20032: ELT M1 edge sensors and position actuators
references.scope: 2020 年公告列出 2,394 支位置致動器與 4,608 個邊緣感測器，以及 FAMES、PI、Safran Reosc 等承包商。
references.scopeEn: 2020 announcement listing 2,394 position actuators and 4,608 edge sensors and contractors including FAMES, PI and Safran Reosc.

related.transfer: 可遷移「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」與「Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on noise temperature, Friis cascade, calibration and stability engineering from feed horn to cryogenic HEMT/SIS front end; Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array centres on millimetre interferometric imaging with 66 antennas at 5000 m: atmosphere, antenna surfaces, SIS receivers, water-vapour phase correction and the correlator, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」與「查南托高原大氣視窗」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “System noise temperature Tsys” and “Chajnantor atmospheric window”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scope: 說明 54 座 12 m 與 12 座 7 m 天線、25 µm 面形精度、0.6″ 指向精度與運輸車重組；不含承包商設計細節。
references.scopeEn: Describes the 54 twelve-metre and 12 seven-metre antennas, 25 µm surface accuracy, 0.6″ pointing and transporter reconfiguration; no contractor design detail.

references.title: ESO：ALMA 望遠鏡頁
references.scope: 站址海拔 4576–5044 m、卡塞格林光學與經緯儀架台、基線與波長範圍的官方規格表。
references.scopeEn: Official specification table: site altitude 4576–5044 m, Cassegrain optics on alt-azimuth mounts, baseline and wavelength ranges.

references.title: NRAO：ALMA 望遠鏡頁
references.scope: 接收頻率 35–950 GHz、192 個天線基座、約 6600 m² 集光面積與各配置的角解析度範圍。
references.scopeEn: Receiver coverage 35–950 GHz, 192 antenna pads, about 6600 m² collecting area and the angular-resolution range of each configuration.

related.title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
related.transfer: 可遷移「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」與「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；LIGO 重力波觀測站的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" and "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of LIGO gravitational-wave observatories must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程；LIGO 重力波觀測站則以4 km Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀的應變量測：臂腔、40 kg 測試質量、四重擺、散粒雜訊與壓縮光為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on isolation transfer function of quadruple-pendulum suspensions, fused-silica fibre thermal noise and damping-control engineering; LIGO gravitational-wave observatories centres on strain measurement with a 4 km Fabry–Pérot Michelson: arm cavities, 40 kg test masses, quadruple pendulums, shot noise and squeezed light, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地面震動與測試質量」與「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到LIGO 重力波觀測站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「絕對校正與雜訊預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Ground motion and the test mass” and “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to LIGO gravitational-wave observatories, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Absolute calibration and the noise budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」與「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；Virgo 重力波干涉儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" and "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程；Virgo 重力波干涉儀則以3 km 干涉儀的低頻工程：超級衰減器、倒立擺、熱補償、牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與超高真空為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on isolation transfer function of quadruple-pendulum suspensions, fused-silica fibre thermal noise and damping-control engineering; Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer centres on low-frequency engineering of a 3 km interferometer: superattenuator, inverted pendulum, thermal compensation, Newtonian noise, Newtonian calibrator and ultra-high vacuum, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地面震動與測試質量」與「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到Virgo 重力波干涉儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Ground motion and the test mass” and “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：震動隔離（四級擺與主動平台）
references.titleEn: LIGO Laboratory: Vibration isolation (quadruple pendulum and active platforms)
references.scope: 說明 40 kg 測試質量、360 kg 四級擺、0.4 mm 石英纖維、主鏈與反作用鏈、平台 2×10⁻¹³ m 與懸吊再降六個數量級的公開數字。
references.scopeEn: Gives the public figures for the 40 kg test mass, 360 kg quadruple pendulum, 0.4 mm silica fibres, main and reaction chains, 2×10⁻¹³ m delivered by the platforms and the further six orders from the suspensions.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：LIGO 的干涉儀
references.scope: 官方說明 4 km 臂、Fabry–Pérot 臂腔約 280 次往返、功率循環把 200 W 提升到約 750 kW、訊號循環鏡的作用。
references.scopeEn: Official explanation of the 4 km arms, about 280 round trips in the Fabry–Pérot arm cavities, power recycling from 200 W to about 750 kW and the role of signal recycling.

references.title: Virgo 合作組織：偵測器頁
references.scope: 官方說明兩條互相垂直的 3 km 臂、分光鏡與暗紋輸出、臂長變化約為質子直徑的千分之一，並連結雜訊與靈敏度頁。
references.scopeEn: Official description of the two perpendicular 3 km arms, the beam splitter and dark-fringe output, arm changes of about one thousandth of a proton diameter, with links to the noise and sensitivity pages.

references.title: 格拉斯哥大學重力研究所
references.titleEn: University of Glasgow: Institute for Gravitational Research
references.scope: 列出準單體懸吊與石英纖維拉製等 Advanced LIGO 關鍵技術的研究單位頁面。
references.scopeEn: Research-group page listing quasi-monolithic suspensions and silica-fibre pulling among its Advanced LIGO enabling technologies.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：LIGO 技術
references.scope: 40 kg 測試質量與奈米級多層鍍膜、四級擺（上兩級金屬 20 kg、下兩級石英 40 kg）、主動與被動隔振、超高真空的官方技術概述。
references.scopeEn: Official technology overview: 40 kg test masses with nanometre-scale multilayer coatings, the four-stage pendulum (two 20 kg metal stages above two 40 kg silica stages), active and passive isolation and the ultra-high vacuum.

references.title: LIGO 實驗室：超高真空
references.scope: 約 10,000 m³ 真空體積、10⁻⁹ Torr 壓力、1.2 m 直徑光束管與真空的必要性。
references.scopeEn: About 10,000 m³ of vacuum volume, 10⁻⁹ Torr pressure, 1.2 m diameter beam tubes and why vacuum is required.

references.title: LIGO 科學合作組織首頁
references.scope: 合作組織的任務說明與 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 事件目錄入口；不含偵測器規格。
references.scopeEn: Mission statement of the collaboration and entry point to the LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA event catalogue; no detector specifications.

references.title: Virgo 合作組織：Virgo 歷史
references.scope: 1987 年提案、1997 年動工、2003 年落成、2007 年科學觀測、2017 年 Advanced Virgo 與 GW170814、GW170817 的官方年表。
references.scopeEn: Official timeline: proposal in 1987, construction from 1997, inauguration in 2003, science observations from 2007, Advanced Virgo in 2017 and GW170814 and GW170817.

references.title: 歐洲重力觀測站 EGO 首頁
references.scope: 卡希納站址的營運機構入口，說明 EGO 是 Virgo 的所在地與三座最靈敏重力波偵測器之一；不含詳細規格。
references.scopeEn: Entry point of the operating body at Cascina, stating that EGO hosts Virgo, one of the three largest and most sensitive gravitational-wave detectors; no detailed specifications.

related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發」與「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦HgCdTe 混成陣列的截止波長、暗電流、多次取樣讀出與低溫特性化工程；科學級 CCD 成像系統則以背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cutoff wavelength, dark current, multi-sample readout and cryogenic characterisation of HgCdTe hybrid arrays; Scientific CCD imaging systems centres on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」與「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CCD 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength” and “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CCD imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scope: 公開規格書：2048×2048 背照式 13.5 µm 像素、−70 到 −100 °C 的暗電流、不同像素速率的讀出雜訊、100 000 e⁻ 滿井與 16 位元數位化；課程引用其數值作為暗電流與讀出雜訊範例。

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 低溫紅外偵測器
related.transfer: 可遷移「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」與「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；低溫紅外偵測器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" and "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic infrared detectors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦熱點偵測機制、光學腔效率、動態電感重置、暗計數與皮秒時間抖動預算；低溫紅外偵測器則以HgCdTe 混成陣列的截止波長、暗電流、多次取樣讀出與低溫特性化工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hotspot detection, optical-cavity efficiency, kinetic-inductance reset, dark counts and picosecond timing-jitter budgets; Cryogenic infrared detectors centres on cutoff wavelength, dark current, multi-sample readout and cryogenic characterisation of HgCdTe hybrid arrays, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」與「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到低溫紅外偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” and “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic infrared detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: NIST：量子網路用單光子偵測器
references.titleEn: NIST: Single-photon detectors for quantum networks
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 公開說明 SNSPD 以曲折超導奈米線構成，列出高效率、極低暗計數、皮秒級抖動與 2.5 K 以下操作等特性；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation that SNSPDs are meandering superconducting nanowires, listing high efficiency, very low dark counts, picosecond jitter and operation below 2.5 K; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: NIST 出版品：超導奈米線單光子偵測器
references.titleEn: NIST publication: Superconducting nanowire single photon detectors
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: NIST 對 SNSPD 原理、材料與性能的公開出版紀錄，作為熱點機制與效率章節的背景。
references.scopeEn: NIST public publication record on SNSPD principles, materials and performance, used as background for the hotspot and efficiency units.

references.title: Single Quantum：SNSPD 技術說明
references.scope: 商用系統的公開技術頁，說明 90% 以上效率、15 ps 以下時間解析、數十 ns 恢復與 2.5 K 閉循環低溫操作。
references.scopeEn: Public technology page of a commercial system describing efficiency above 90%, timing resolution below 15 ps, recovery within tens of nanoseconds and closed-cycle operation at 2.5 K.

references.title: ID Quantique：SNSPD 技術原理
references.scope: 公開說明熱點約 1 kΩ 的電阻尖峰、偏置接近 Ic、50 Ω 讀出與恢復時間約為 L_k/R_L 的模型。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the roughly 1 kΩ hotspot resistance spike, bias near Ic, 50 Ω readout and the recovery time constant of about L_k/R_L.

references.title: STScI JWST 文件：NIRCam 偵測器總覽
references.titleEn: STScI JWST documentation: NIRCam detector overview
references.scope: 10 塊 Teledyne H2RG（8 短波 2.5 µm 截止、2 長波 5 µm 截止）、18 µm 像素、4 圈參考像素與 SIDECAR ASIC 的官方說明。
references.scopeEn: Official description of the 10 Teledyne H2RGs (8 short-wave with 2.5 µm cutoff, 2 long-wave with 5 µm cutoff), 18 µm pixels, 4-pixel reference border and SIDECAR ASICs.

references.title: STScI JWST 文件：NIRCam 偵測器性能
references.titleEn: STScI JWST documentation: NIRCam detector performance
references.scope: 提供 CDS 讀出雜訊、1000 s 多次取樣有效雜訊、暗電流、滿阱、增益、QE 與持續影像的公開量測值，約 40 K 工作。
references.scopeEn: Provides public measured values of CDS read noise, 1000 s multi-accum effective noise, dark current, full well, gain, QE and persistence at about 40 K.

references.title: Teledyne Space Imaging：產品總覽
references.scope: 太空與科學用影像感測器（CCD、EMCCD、CMOS、InGaAs 與紅外陣列）的製造商產品入口；課程數值非該公司規格。
references.scopeEn: Manufacturer's product portal for space and science image sensors (CCD, EMCCD, CMOS, InGaAs and infrared arrays); course numbers are not the company's specifications.

references.title: Lynred：紅外偵測器製造商首頁
references.titleEn: Lynred: infrared detector manufacturer home page
references.scope: 由 Sofradir 與 ULIS 合併而成的歐洲冷卻與非冷卻紅外偵測器供應商，涵蓋太空市場。
references.scopeEn: European supplier of cooled and uncooled infrared detectors formed from Sofradir and ULIS, serving the space market among others.

references.title: CAEN：FERS-5200 分散式前端讀出平台
references.titleEn: CAEN: FERS-5200 distributed front-end readout platform
references.scope: 64/128 通道前端卡、Citiroc、Radioroc、Psiroc 與 picoTDC 前端 ASIC、電荷與時間量測、光纖集中器與通道數；為產品資訊，不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: 64/128-channel front-end cards, Citiroc, Radioroc, Psiroc and picoTDC front-end ASICs, charge and time measurement, optical concentrators and channel counts; product information, not a design manual.

references.title: ALICE 合作團：TPC 讀出與前端電子
references.titleEn: ALICE Collaboration: TPC readout and front-end electronics
references.scope: 524,160 個墊片各接一個前端通道，前端卡經 6552 條光纖以 3.28 TB/s 送往 360 片 FPGA 讀出卡；本課用作大型多通道讀出的尺度參照。
references.scopeEn: 524,160 pads each connected to one front-end channel, front-end cards streaming 3.28 TB/s over 6552 optical links to 360 FPGA readout cards; used here as the scale reference for large multi-channel readout.

references.title: CAEN：電子儀器產品總覽
references.scope: 核子與粒子物理用電子儀器的分類：數位化器、讀出平台、高壓與低壓電源；公開產品分類。
references.scopeEn: Categories of electronic instrumentation for nuclear and particle physics: digitisers, readout platforms, high- and low-voltage supplies; public product classification.

related.title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」與「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CMOS 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" and "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CMOS imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正；科學級 CMOS 成像系統則以背照式 sCMOS 的像素物理、讀出雜訊、快門時序、EMVA 1288 校正與系統訊噪比預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration; Scientific CMOS imaging systems centres on pixel physics, read noise, shutter timing, EMVA 1288 calibration and system SNR budgets for back-illuminated sCMOS, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「背照式矽吸收層」與「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CMOS 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「固定圖樣雜訊：DSNU、PRNU 與影像校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” and “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CMOS imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fixed-pattern noise: DSNU, PRNU and image correction", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: Andor：iKon-L 936 深冷 CCD 相機規格
references.titleEn: Andor: iKon-L 936 deep-cooled CCD camera specifications
references.scope: 公開規格書：2048×2048 背照式 13.5 µm 像素、−70 到 −100 °C 的暗電流、不同像素速率的讀出雜訊、100 000 e⁻ 滿井與 16 位元數位化；課程引用其數值作為暗電流與讀出雜訊範例。

references.scope: 說明 189 片科學 CCD 與 12 片導星對焦 CCD、3×3 拼板、250 µm 以內的間隙、10 µm 以內的傾斜、每片 16 個輸出與約 2 秒讀出。

references.title: SPIE：CCD 電荷收集效率與光子轉移技術

related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」與「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」與「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CCD 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” and “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CCD imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scopeEn: Public machine overview: 26,659 m circumference, 1232 dipoles and 392 quadrupoles, 1.9 K, 8 cavities per beam at 2 MV and 400 MHz, 25 ns bunch spacing and 11,245 turns per second.

references.title: CERN 工程：低溫技術——低溫、高性能
references.titleEn: CERN engineering: Cryogenics, low temperatures, high performance
references.scope: 說明 1.9 K 超流氦、120 噸氦、36,000 噸冷質量、8.33 T 與 11,850 A 的線圈電流、以及 40 MW 的製冷電力。
references.scopeEn: Explains 1.9 K superfluid helium, 120 tonnes of helium, 36,000 tonnes of cold mass, 8.33 T at 11,850 A coil current and the 40 MW of refrigeration electricity.

references.title: LHC 設計報告第一卷：LHC 主環（CERN-2004-003-V-1）
references.titleEn: LHC Design Report Volume 1: The LHC Main Ring (CERN-2004-003-V-1)
references.scope: 設計參數的原始出處：亮度公式與 10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹ 設計值、磁鐵、低溫、RF、準直與機器保護各章；課程數值為依其公開參數建立的教學估算。
references.scopeEn: Original source of design parameters: the luminosity formula and the 10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹ design value, with chapters on magnets, cryogenics, RF, collimation and machine protection; course numbers are teaching estimates built on its public parameters.

references.title: CERN 工程：射頻腔如何加速粒子
references.scope: 公開說明 LHC 的 16 個 400 MHz 超導腔、每腔 2 MV、每束 16 MV，以及 RF 如何把束流整理成團。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the LHC's 16 superconducting 400 MHz cavities, 2 MV each and 16 MV per beam, and how RF sorts the beam into bunches.

references.title: 美國國家強磁場實驗室：低溫研究群設施
references.scope: 低溫研究群的公開設施說明，含冷凍機、液氦研究用低溫容器、約 4 K 的流動設施與 MLI 熱量計；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public description of the cryogenics group's facilities, including cryocoolers, liquid-helium research cryostats, flow facilities near 4 K and an MLI calorimeter; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Bruker：低溫超導線材（Nb₃Sn）
references.scope: 青銅法與 RRP 法 Nb₃Sn 線材的公開產品說明，提及超過 20 T 的 NMR 磁體與加速器、核融合應用；不含製程配方。
references.scopeEn: Public product description of bronze-route and RRP Nb3Sn wire, citing NMR magnets above 20 T and accelerator and fusion uses; no process recipes.

references.title: SHI Cryogenics：RDK-415D2 4 K 冷頭系列
references.scope: 4 K GM 冷頭的公開規格：二級 1.5 W @ 4.2 K、一級 35 W @ 50 K（50 Hz）與 10,000 小時保養週期。
references.scopeEn: Public specification of a 4 K GM cold head: 1.5 W at 4.2 K on the second stage, 35 W at 50 K on the first stage (50 Hz) and a 10,000-hour maintenance interval.

references.title: Quantum Design Oxford：超導磁體類型與技術
references.titleEn: Quantum Design Oxford: Superconducting magnet types and technology
references.scope: 螺線管、分裂對與向量磁體的公開型錄，區分 Cryofree（至 16 T）與液氦冷卻（至 20 T）系統；不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Public catalogue of solenoid, split-pair and vector magnets that separates Cryofree systems (to 16 T) from liquid-helium-cooled ones (to 20 T); not a design manual.

references.title: CERN：超級質子同步加速器
references.scope: 官方概述：周長近 7 km、1317 台常溫磁鐵（含 744 台偶極）、最高 450 GeV、1976 年啟用、1983 年 W/Z 發現與 LHC 注入角色。
references.scopeEn: Official overview: nearly 7 km circumference, 1317 warm magnets including 744 dipoles, up to 450 GeV, 1976 start-up, the 1983 W/Z discovery and the LHC injector role.

references.title: arXiv：SPS 束流傾卸設施綜合設計研究
references.titleEn: arXiv: SPS Beam Dump Facility comprehensive design study
references.scope: 公開設計報告，含 400 GeV/c 三階共振慢引出、4.8 s spill、靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列、損失比例與彎晶遮蔽等數據。
references.scopeEn: Public design report including 400 GeV/c third-integer slow extraction, 4.8 s spills, the tungsten–rhenium wire electrostatic septa, loss fractions and bent-crystal shadowing.

references.title: ESRF 研討會：SPS 兆瓦級連續波固態功率放大器的挑戰
references.titleEn: ESRF workshop: Challenges of a megawatt CW-class solid-state power amplifier for the SPS at CERN
references.scope: 說明 LIU 的 200 MHz 固態放大器架構：Thales 承製、32 座放大塔、2560 個 1.8 kW 模組、腔數由 4 增為 6 與效率分析。
references.scopeEn: Describes the LIU 200 MHz solid-state amplifier architecture: built by Thales, 32 towers, 2560 modules of 1.8 kW, cavities increased from four to six, and efficiency analysis.

references.title: IPAC2021：SPS 的非晶碳鍍膜
references.titleEn: IPAC2021: Amorphous carbon coating in the SPS
references.scope: LS2 期間 SPS 聚焦四極束管與短直線段的非晶碳鍍膜數量、平均最大 SEY 約 0.99 與倍增門檻。
references.scopeEn: LS2 amorphous-carbon coating of SPS focusing-quadrupole beam pipes and short straight sections, with an average maximum SEY of about 0.99 and multipacting thresholds.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: CERN 大型強子對撞機
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」與「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；CERN 大型強子對撞機的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness" and "Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of CERN Large Hadron Collider must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦H⁻ 離子源、352.2 MHz RFQ 與 DTL/CCDTL/PIMS、斬波、相位掃描與電荷交換注入的束流品質預算；CERN 大型強子對撞機則以27 km 超導對撞機的磁剛度、亮度、1.9 K 低溫、機器保護與試運轉工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on H⁻ source, 352.2 MHz RFQ and DTL/CCDTL/PIMS, chopping, phase scans and charge-exchange injection beam-quality budgets; CERN Large Hadron Collider centres on magnetic rigidity, luminosity, 1.9 K cryogenics, machine protection and commissioning of a 27 km superconducting collider, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」與「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到CERN 大型強子對撞機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” and “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to CERN Large Hadron Collider, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 加速器束流位置監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」與「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；加速器束流位置監測的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

把本課算例的一個假設移到加速器束流位置監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「解析度、頻寬與長期穩定的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” and “Bunch field and wall image current”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Accelerator beam-position monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Resolution, bandwidth and the long-term stability budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: CERN：Linac4 直線加速器
references.scope: 官方介紹：H⁻ 加速到 160 MeV、RFQ 3 MeV、DTL 50 MeV、CCDTL 100 MeV、PIMS 160 MeV、86 m 長、地下 12 m、400 µs 脈衝，2020 年取代 Linac2。
references.scopeEn: Official overview: H⁻ accelerated to 160 MeV with RFQ to 3 MeV, DTL to 50 MeV, CCDTL to 100 MeV and PIMS to 160 MeV, 86 m long, 12 m underground, 400 µs pulses, replacing Linac2 in 2020.

references.title: CERN 黃皮書：Linac4 設計報告（CERN-2020-006）
references.titleEn: CERN Yellow Report: Linac4 design report (CERN-2020-006)
references.scope: 官方設計報告，涵蓋 45 keV 離子源、3 m RFQ、斬波線、三槽 DTL、七模組 CCDTL、十二槽 PIMS、流強、脈衝長度、傳輸率與發射度預算。
references.scopeEn: Official design report covering the 45 keV source, 3 m RFQ, chopper line, three-tank DTL, seven-module CCDTL, twelve-tank PIMS, currents, pulse length, transmission and emittance budget.

references.title: CERN Courier：通往 Linac4 的漫長道路
references.titleEn: CERN Courier: The long road to Linac4
references.scope: 回顧 Linac4 的時程、沿用 LEP 352 MHz RF 元件、108 個永久磁鐵四極、可靠度運轉 91% 可用率與國際合作機構。
references.scopeEn: Retrospective on the Linac4 timeline, reuse of LEP 352 MHz RF components, 108 permanent-magnet quadrupoles, 91% availability in the reliability run and partner institutes.

references.title: Forck（GSI）：束流儀測與診斷講義（JUAS）
references.titleEn: Forck (GSI): Lecture Notes on Beam Instrumentation and Diagnostics (JUAS)
references.scope: 大學加速器學校講義，含電容式與鈕扣式拾取電極的位置量測原理；課程中的轉移阻抗與靈敏度數值為依其原理建立的教學假設。

references.title: Bergoz：依量測類型選擇產品（BPM 與電流變壓器）
references.titleEn: Bergoz: Products by measurement type (BPM electronics and current transformers)
references.scope: 列出對數比、單次通過與多次通過的 BPM 電子學以及非破壞性束流電流變壓器；公開產品分類，不是設計手冊。
references.scopeEn: Lists log-ratio, single-pass and multi-pass BPM electronics and non-destructive beam-current transformers; public product classification, not a design manual.

references.title: Instrumentation Technologies：Libera 束流診斷產品入口
references.scope: 數位 BPM 處理器與低階射頻控制產品的公開入口；課程不引用任何專有規格。
references.scopeEn: Public portal for digital BPM processors and low-level RF products; the course quotes no proprietary specification.

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源
references.scope: 說明 3 GeV、周長 518 m 的台灣光子源儲存環與光束線規劃，作為本課 3 GeV 儲存環參數的公開背景。
references.scopeEn: Describes the 3 GeV, 518 m Taiwan Photon Source ring and its beamline plan, the public background for the 3 GeV ring parameters used here.

related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV" and "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of CERN Linac4 linear accelerator must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦6.9 km 常溫磁鐵同步加速器的磁剛度、200 MHz 射頻、電子雲、慢引出損失與 LHC 注入保護；CERN Linac4 直線加速器則以H⁻ 離子源、352.2 MHz RFQ 與 DTL/CCDTL/PIMS、斬波、相位掃描與電荷交換注入的束流品質預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on magnetic rigidity, 200 MHz RF, electron cloud, slow-extraction losses and LHC injection protection in a 6.9 km warm-magnet synchrotron; CERN Linac4 linear accelerator centres on H⁻ source, 352.2 MHz RFQ and DTL/CCDTL/PIMS, chopping, phase scans and charge-exchange injection beam-quality budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「744 台主偶極磁鐵」與「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到CERN Linac4 直線加速器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「發射度成長、束流損失與 H⁻ 剝離預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “744 main dipole magnets” and “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to CERN Linac4 linear accelerator, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Emittance growth, beam loss and H⁻ stripping budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: CERN：超級質子同步加速器
references.scope: 官方概述：周長近 7 km、1317 台常溫磁鐵（含 744 台偶極）、最高 450 GeV、1976 年啟用、1983 年 W/Z 發現與 LHC 注入角色。
references.scopeEn: Official overview: nearly 7 km circumference, 1317 warm magnets including 744 dipoles, up to 450 GeV, 1976 start-up, the 1983 W/Z discovery and the LHC injector role.

references.title: arXiv：SPS 束流傾卸設施綜合設計研究
references.titleEn: arXiv: SPS Beam Dump Facility comprehensive design study
references.scope: 公開設計報告，含 400 GeV/c 三階共振慢引出、4.8 s spill、靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列、損失比例與彎晶遮蔽等數據。
references.scopeEn: Public design report including 400 GeV/c third-integer slow extraction, 4.8 s spills, the tungsten–rhenium wire electrostatic septa, loss fractions and bent-crystal shadowing.

references.title: ESRF 研討會：SPS 兆瓦級連續波固態功率放大器的挑戰
references.titleEn: ESRF workshop: Challenges of a megawatt CW-class solid-state power amplifier for the SPS at CERN
references.scope: 說明 LIU 的 200 MHz 固態放大器架構：Thales 承製、32 座放大塔、2560 個 1.8 kW 模組、腔數由 4 增為 6 與效率分析。
references.scopeEn: Describes the LIU 200 MHz solid-state amplifier architecture: built by Thales, 32 towers, 2560 modules of 1.8 kW, cavities increased from four to six, and efficiency analysis.

references.title: IPAC2021：SPS 的非晶碳鍍膜
references.titleEn: IPAC2021: Amorphous carbon coating in the SPS
references.scope: LS2 期間 SPS 聚焦四極束管與短直線段的非晶碳鍍膜數量、平均最大 SEY 約 0.99 與倍增門檻。
references.scopeEn: LS2 amorphous-carbon coating of SPS focusing-quadrupole beam pipes and short straight sections, with an average maximum SEY of about 0.99 and multipacting thresholds.

references.title: CERN：大型強子對撞機官方介紹
references.scope: 公開的機器概述：26,659 m 周長、1232 顆偶極與 392 顆四極、1.9 K、每束 8 個 400 MHz 腔各 2 MV、25 ns 團間距與每秒 11,245 圈。
references.scopeEn: Public machine overview: 26,659 m circumference, 1232 dipoles and 392 quadrupoles, 1.9 K, 8 cavities per beam at 2 MV and 400 MHz, 25 ns bunch spacing and 11,245 turns per second.

references.title: CERN 工程：低溫技術——低溫、高性能
references.titleEn: CERN engineering: Cryogenics, low temperatures, high performance
references.scope: 說明 1.9 K 超流氦、120 噸氦、36,000 噸冷質量、8.33 T 與 11,850 A 的線圈電流、以及 40 MW 的製冷電力。
references.scopeEn: Explains 1.9 K superfluid helium, 120 tonnes of helium, 36,000 tonnes of cold mass, 8.33 T at 11,850 A coil current and the 40 MW of refrigeration electricity.

references.title: LHC 設計報告第一卷：LHC 主環（CERN-2004-003-V-1）
references.titleEn: LHC Design Report Volume 1: The LHC Main Ring (CERN-2004-003-V-1)
references.scope: 設計參數的原始出處：亮度公式與 10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹ 設計值、磁鐵、低溫、RF、準直與機器保護各章；課程數值為依其公開參數建立的教學估算。
references.scopeEn: Original source of design parameters: the luminosity formula and the 10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹ design value, with chapters on magnets, cryogenics, RF, collimation and machine protection; course numbers are teaching estimates built on its public parameters.

references.title: CERN 工程：射頻腔如何加速粒子
references.scope: 公開說明 LHC 的 16 個 400 MHz 超導腔、每腔 2 MV、每束 16 MV，以及 RF 如何把束流整理成團。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the LHC's 16 superconducting 400 MHz cavities, 2 MV each and 16 MV per beam, and how RF sorts the beam into bunches.

references.title: CERN：Linac4 直線加速器
references.scope: 官方介紹：H⁻ 加速到 160 MeV、RFQ 3 MeV、DTL 50 MeV、CCDTL 100 MeV、PIMS 160 MeV、86 m 長、地下 12 m、400 µs 脈衝，2020 年取代 Linac2。
references.scopeEn: Official overview: H⁻ accelerated to 160 MeV with RFQ to 3 MeV, DTL to 50 MeV, CCDTL to 100 MeV and PIMS to 160 MeV, 86 m long, 12 m underground, 400 µs pulses, replacing Linac2 in 2020.

references.title: CERN 黃皮書：Linac4 設計報告（CERN-2020-006）
references.titleEn: CERN Yellow Report: Linac4 design report (CERN-2020-006)
references.scope: 官方設計報告，涵蓋 45 keV 離子源、3 m RFQ、斬波線、三槽 DTL、七模組 CCDTL、十二槽 PIMS、流強、脈衝長度、傳輸率與發射度預算。
references.scopeEn: Official design report covering the 45 keV source, 3 m RFQ, chopper line, three-tank DTL, seven-module CCDTL, twelve-tank PIMS, currents, pulse length, transmission and emittance budget.

references.title: CERN Courier：通往 Linac4 的漫長道路
references.titleEn: CERN Courier: The long road to Linac4
references.scope: 回顧 Linac4 的時程、沿用 LEP 352 MHz RF 元件、108 個永久磁鐵四極、可靠度運轉 91% 可用率與國際合作機構。
references.scopeEn: Retrospective on the Linac4 timeline, reuse of LEP 352 MHz RF components, 108 permanent-magnet quadrupoles, 91% availability in the reliability run and partner institutes.

把本課算例的一個假設移到CERN 超級質子同步加速器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Iridium target and magnetic horn” and “744 main dipole magnets”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to CERN Super Proton Synchrotron, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: IPAC2015：TPS 增能環與儲存環磁鐵設計與場品質控制
references.titleEn: IPAC2015: Magnet design and control of field quality for TPS booster and storage rings
references.scope: DBA 晶格 1.6 nm·rad、240 台四極與 168 台六極、機械與磁中心偏差、2014 年 12 月 31 日無修正磁鐵首光與真空室磁化效應。
references.scopeEn: DBA lattice at 1.6 nm·rad, 240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles, mechanical and magnetic centre offsets, first light without correctors on 31 December 2014, and vacuum-chamber magnetization effects.

references.title: IPAC2015：TPS 增能環硬體改善與束流試運轉
references.titleEn: IPAC2015: Hardware improvements and beam commissioning of the booster ring in TPS
references.scope: 496.8 m 同隧道同心增能環、組合功能 FODO 晶格、10 nm·rad 發射度與 2014 年 12 月的試運轉時程。
references.scopeEn: The 496.8 m concentric booster in the shared tunnel, combined-function FODO lattice, 10 nm·rad emittance and the December 2014 commissioning timeline.

references.title: 三菱重工：TPS 500 MHz 超導射頻模組交貨紀錄
references.titleEn: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries: 500 MHz SRF module delivery record for TPS
references.scope: 單 cell 純鈮 500 MHz 超導腔、4.5 K、2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸ 與 300 kW 連續波耦合器等公開規格。
references.scopeEn: Public specifications of the single-cell pure-niobium 500 MHz cavity: 4.5 K, 2.4 MV, Q of 5×10⁸ and a 300 kW CW coupler.

references.title: Lightsources.org：國家同步輻射研究中心 TLS 與 TPS
references.titleEn: Lightsources.org: TLS and TPS at NSRRC
references.scope: 光源設施聯盟的設施頁：TPS 3 GeV、518.4 m、1.6 nm·rad／16 pm·rad、500 mA、同隧道增能環與光束線規劃。
references.scopeEn: Light-source consortium facility page: TPS at 3 GeV, 518.4 m, 1.6 nm·rad and 16 pm·rad, 500 mA, a booster in the same tunnel and beamline plans.

references.title: PAC1993：同步輻射研究中心現況
references.scope: TLS 原始設計參數：120 m、6 個超週期、18 台偶極、ρ = 3.495 m、1.24 T、19.2 nm·rad、499.654 MHz、h = 200、工作點與 1993 年試運轉時程。
references.scopeEn: Original TLS design parameters: 120 m, six superperiods, 18 dipoles, ρ = 3.495 m, 1.24 T, 19.2 nm·rad, 499.654 MHz, h = 200, tunes and the 1993 commissioning timeline.

references.title: EPAC2000：6 T 超導波長位移器對 TLS 運轉晶格的影響
references.titleEn: EPAC2000: Influence of a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter on the TLS operation lattice
references.publisher: JACoW / SRRC (G. H. Luo et al.)
references.scope: 1.5 GeV 運轉的 TBA 晶格、25.6 nm·rad 自然發射度、動量壓縮因子、能量分散與 SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失。
references.scopeEn: The 1.5 GeV TBA operating lattice, 25.6 nm·rad natural emittance, momentum compaction, energy spread and the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV loss per turn.

references.title: EPAC2006：TLS 消色散段內超導扭擺器的安裝與測試
references.titleEn: EPAC2006: In-achromatic superconducting wiggler in TLS, installation and test results
references.publisher: JACoW / NSRRC (C. H. Chang et al.)
references.scope: IASW 的 3.1 T、61 mm 週期、16 極、19 mm 間隙、2 kW 輻射功率、液氦消耗、工作點補償與冷壁保護的軌道偏移。
references.scopeEn: IASW parameters: 3.1 T, 61 mm period, 16 poles, 19 mm gap, 2 kW radiated power, helium consumption, tune compensation and the orbit offset protecting the cold wall.

references.title: APAC2007：台灣光源的現況與未來
references.titleEn: APAC2007: Status and future of Taiwan Light Source
references.publisher: JACoW / NSRRC (K. S. Liang et al.)
references.scope: CESR-III 型超導腔取代 Doris 腔、100 kW 發射機、300 mA 時束流負載 4.2、每 60 s 頂注與 ±0.25% 電流穩定、射頻跳脫率與低溫系統。
references.scopeEn: The CESR-III-type SRF cavity replacing Doris cavities, the 100 kW transmitter, beam-loading factor 4.2 at 300 mA, 60 s top-up with ±0.25% current stability, RF trip rate and cryogenics.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 加速器參數
references.scope: 公布 EBS 儲存環的能量 6 GeV、周長 843.977 m、電流 200 mA、發射度 130/10 pm、各填充模式的壽命與束團長度。
references.scopeEn: Publishes EBS storage-ring energy 6 GeV, circumference 843.977 m, current 200 mA, emittance 130/10 pm, and lifetime and bunch length per filling mode.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源計畫說明
references.titleEn: ESRF: EBS Extremely Brilliant Source overview
references.scope: 說明 HMBA 晶格、32 個 27 m 單元、每單元 7 個彎轉與 31 個磁鐵、發射度降低約 30 倍、亮度提升 100 倍與增能環改造。
references.scopeEn: Describes the HMBA lattice, 32 cells of 27 m, seven bends and 31 magnets per cell, the roughly 30-fold emittance reduction, the 100-fold brilliance gain and the booster modifications.

references.title: IPAC2021 MOXA01：ESRF-EBS 調試與首年運轉
references.titleEn: IPAC2021 MOXA01: ESRF-EBS commissioning and first operation
references.scope: 加速器會議的公開論文頁，記錄 EBS 調試階段、達成的發射度與運轉性能；課程中的數值仍為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Open conference paper page recording the EBS commissioning stages, achieved emittance and operating performance; course numbers remain teaching assumptions.

references.scope: DBA 晶格 1.6 nm·rad、240 台四極與 168 台六極、機械與磁中心偏差、2014 年 12 月 31 日無修正磁鐵首光與真空室磁化效應。

references.scopeEn: The 496.8 m concentric booster in the shared tunnel, combined-function FODO lattice, 10 nm·rad emittance and the December 2014 commissioning timeline.

references.title: 三菱重工：TPS 500 MHz 超導射頻模組交貨紀錄
references.titleEn: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries: 500 MHz SRF module delivery record for TPS
references.scope: 單 cell 純鈮 500 MHz 超導腔、4.5 K、2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸ 與 300 kW 連續波耦合器等公開規格。
references.scopeEn: Public specifications of the single-cell pure-niobium 500 MHz cavity: 4.5 K, 2.4 MV, Q of 5×10⁸ and a 300 kW CW coupler.

references.title: Lightsources.org：國家同步輻射研究中心 TLS 與 TPS
references.titleEn: Lightsources.org: TLS and TPS at NSRRC
references.scope: 光源設施聯盟的設施頁：TPS 3 GeV、518.4 m、1.6 nm·rad／16 pm·rad、500 mA、同隧道增能環與光束線規劃。
references.scopeEn: Light-source consortium facility page: TPS at 3 GeV, 518.4 m, 1.6 nm·rad and 16 pm·rad, 500 mA, a booster in the same tunnel and beamline plans.

references.title: 國家同步輻射研究中心：台灣光子源（TPS）
references.scope: 公開說明 TPS 的 3 GeV 等級能量、518 m 周長、24 晶胞 DBA 晶格、24 個插件直線段與 500 MHz 超導射頻模組。
references.scopeEn: Public description of TPS: 3 GeV-class energy, 518 m circumference, 24-cell DBA lattice, 24 insertion-device straights and a 500 MHz superconducting RF module.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源
references.scope: 公開說明混合多彎消色散（HMBA）晶格以每晶胞 7 片彎轉磁鐵取代 2 片，水平發射度降至約 150 pm。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of the hybrid multi-bend achromat lattice that replaces 2 dipoles per cell with 7, lowering horizontal emittance to about 150 pm.

references.title: Diamond：同步輻射光源如何運作
references.titleEn: Diamond Light Source: How Diamond Works
references.scope: 直線加速器、增能環、儲存環彎轉磁鐵與光束線整體鏈路的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the chain from linac and booster to storage-ring bending magnets and beamlines.

references.title: CERN：加速用射頻腔
references.scope: 射頻腔以振盪電場加速並使粒子成團的公開說明（以 LHC 為例），作為同步相位與 RF 桶的觀念參照。
references.scopeEn: Public explanation of how RF cavities accelerate particles with an oscillating field and sort them into bunches, using the LHC; a conceptual reference for synchronous phase and the RF bucket.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
related.transfer: 可遷移「同步輻射的臨界能量與輻射功率」與「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Critical energy and radiated power of synchrotron light" and "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Diamond Light Source must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦6 GeV HMBA 儲存環的發射度、亮度與軌道穩定工程；Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施則以3 GeV 中能量儲存環的射頻、插件磁鐵、熱負載與 Diamond-II 升級工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on emittance, brilliance and orbit-stability engineering of the 6 GeV HMBA storage ring; Diamond Light Source centres on RF, insertion devices, heat load and the Diamond-II upgrade of a 3 GeV medium-energy ring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「6 GeV 儲存環與彎轉磁鐵輻射」與「3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “6 GeV ring and bending-magnet radiation” and “3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Diamond Light Source, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scopeEn: Publishes 3 GeV, 561.571 m circumference, 300 mA, 3.14 nm/8 pm emittance, 499.680 MHz RF, 533.8 kHz revolution frequency and the 936-bunch maximum.

references.title: Diamond：儲存環元件說明
references.scope: 說明儲存環的磁鐵、真空、射頻與診斷元件的功能分工；不含設計圖面。
references.scopeEn: Explains the functional roles of storage-ring magnets, vacuum, RF and diagnostics components; no design drawings.

references.title: Diamond：Diamond-II 升級計畫
references.scope: 說明能量提高到 3.5 GeV、雙三彎消色散晶格、中段直線段與新增光束線的升級目標。
references.scopeEn: Describes the upgrade goals: energy raised to 3.5 GeV, the double-triple-bend achromat lattice, mid-cell straights and additional beamlines.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 加速器參數
references.scope: 公布 EBS 儲存環的能量 6 GeV、周長 843.977 m、電流 200 mA、發射度 130/10 pm、各填充模式的壽命與束團長度。
references.scopeEn: Publishes EBS storage-ring energy 6 GeV, circumference 843.977 m, current 200 mA, emittance 130/10 pm, and lifetime and bunch length per filling mode.

references.title: ESRF：EBS 極亮光源計畫說明
references.titleEn: ESRF: EBS Extremely Brilliant Source overview
references.scope: 說明 HMBA 晶格、32 個 27 m 單元、每單元 7 個彎轉與 31 個磁鐵、發射度降低約 30 倍、亮度提升 100 倍與增能環改造。
references.scopeEn: Describes the HMBA lattice, 32 cells of 27 m, seven bends and 31 magnets per cell, the roughly 30-fold emittance reduction, the 100-fold brilliance gain and the booster modifications.

references.title: IPAC2021 MOXA01：ESRF-EBS 調試與首年運轉
references.titleEn: IPAC2021 MOXA01: ESRF-EBS commissioning and first operation
references.scope: 加速器會議的公開論文頁，記錄 EBS 調試階段、達成的發射度與運轉性能；課程中的數值仍為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Open conference paper page recording the EBS commissioning stages, achieved emittance and operating performance; course numbers remain teaching assumptions.

references.title: PAC1993：同步輻射研究中心現況
references.scope: TLS 原始設計參數：120 m、6 個超週期、18 台偶極、ρ = 3.495 m、1.24 T、19.2 nm·rad、499.654 MHz、h = 200、工作點與 1993 年試運轉時程。
references.scopeEn: Original TLS design parameters: 120 m, six superperiods, 18 dipoles, ρ = 3.495 m, 1.24 T, 19.2 nm·rad, 499.654 MHz, h = 200, tunes and the 1993 commissioning timeline.

references.title: EPAC2000：6 T 超導波長位移器對 TLS 運轉晶格的影響
references.titleEn: EPAC2000: Influence of a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter on the TLS operation lattice
references.publisher: JACoW / SRRC (G. H. Luo et al.)
references.scope: 1.5 GeV 運轉的 TBA 晶格、25.6 nm·rad 自然發射度、動量壓縮因子、能量分散與 SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失。
references.scopeEn: The 1.5 GeV TBA operating lattice, 25.6 nm·rad natural emittance, momentum compaction, energy spread and the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV loss per turn.

references.title: EPAC2006：TLS 消色散段內超導扭擺器的安裝與測試
references.titleEn: EPAC2006: In-achromatic superconducting wiggler in TLS, installation and test results
references.publisher: JACoW / NSRRC (C. H. Chang et al.)
references.scope: IASW 的 3.1 T、61 mm 週期、16 極、19 mm 間隙、2 kW 輻射功率、液氦消耗、工作點補償與冷壁保護的軌道偏移。
references.scopeEn: IASW parameters: 3.1 T, 61 mm period, 16 poles, 19 mm gap, 2 kW radiated power, helium consumption, tune compensation and the orbit offset protecting the cold wall.

references.title: APAC2007：台灣光源的現況與未來
references.titleEn: APAC2007: Status and future of Taiwan Light Source
references.publisher: JACoW / NSRRC (K. S. Liang et al.)
references.scope: CESR-III 型超導腔取代 Doris 腔、100 kW 發射機、300 mA 時束流負載 4.2、每 60 s 頂注與 ±0.25% 電流穩定、射頻跳脫率與低溫系統。
references.scopeEn: The CESR-III-type SRF cavity replacing Doris cavities, the 100 kW transmitter, beam-loading factor 4.2 at 300 mA, 60 s top-up with ±0.25% current stability, RF trip rate and cryogenics.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF
related.transfer: 可遷移「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」與「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary" and "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of European Synchrotron Radiation Facility must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦8 GeV 高能儲存環的硬 X 光取得、注入、束團純度與 SPring-8-II 降能升級；歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF則以6 GeV HMBA 儲存環的發射度、亮度與軌道穩定工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hard X-ray generation, injection, bunch purity and the SPring-8-II lower-energy upgrade of an 8 GeV ring; European Synchrotron Radiation Facility centres on emittance, brilliance and orbit-stability engineering of the 6 GeV HMBA storage ring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」與「6 GeV 儲存環與彎轉磁鐵輻射」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” and “6 GeV ring and bending-magnet radiation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to European Synchrotron Radiation Facility, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

以「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。

references.title: 理研 SPring-8 中心：加速器硬體開發組

references.scopeEn: Describes the R&D mission of keeping SPring-8 and SACLA running stably and driving SPring-8-II's emittance reduction and brightness increase.

references.title: J. Synchrotron Rad. 2024：SPring-8 的綠色升級

references.title: LCLS：設施總覽
references.scope: 說明 LCLS 自 2009 年運轉、120 Hz 脈衝、LCLS-II 升級到每秒百萬脈衝的公開概述。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of LCLS operating since 2009 at 120 Hz and the LCLS-II upgrade to a million pulses per second.

references.title: LCLS-II-HE：設計與性能

references.scopeEn: Describes the LCLS-II superconducting modules in the first 750 m of tunnel (L1 to L3), 1 MHz repetition rate, soft and hard X-ray undulators, and the LCLS-II-HE extension to 8 GeV.

related.title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
related.transfer: 可遷移「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of European XFEL must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級；European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射則以突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」與「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” and “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to European XFEL, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.why: 可遷移「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

references.title: LCLS：設施總覽
references.scope: 說明 LCLS 自 2009 年運轉、120 Hz 脈衝、LCLS-II 升級到每秒百萬脈衝的公開概述。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of LCLS operating since 2009 at 120 Hz and the LCLS-II upgrade to a million pulses per second.

references.title: LCLS：機器參數
references.scope: 公布銅直線加速器 120 Hz、光子能量 200 eV 到 25 keV、脈衝能量 0.5 到 2 mJ、脈衝寬度 10 到 50 fs，以及超導直線加速器 4 GeV 的參數。
references.scopeEn: Publishes copper-linac parameters of 120 Hz, 200 eV to 25 keV photon energy, 0.5 to 2 mJ pulse energy and 10 to 50 fs duration, plus the 4 GeV superconducting-linac parameters.

references.title: LCLS-II-HE：設計與性能
references.scope: 說明 LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 的超導模組（L1 到 L3）、1 MHz 重複率、軟 X 光與硬 X 光波盪器，以及 LCLS-II-HE 延伸到 8 GeV 的規劃。
references.scopeEn: Describes the LCLS-II superconducting modules in the first 750 m of tunnel (L1 to L3), 1 MHz repetition rate, soft and hard X-ray undulators, and the LCLS-II-HE extension to 8 GeV.

references.title: European XFEL：設施數據一覽
references.scope: 官方公布的設施長度 3.4 km、17.5 GeV 電子能量、每秒 27,000 發、0.05 到 4.7 nm 波長範圍與模組數；課程中的推導為教學估算。
references.scopeEn: Official facility length of 3.4 km, 17.5 GeV electron energy, 27,000 pulses per second, 0.05 to 4.7 nm wavelength range and module count; derivations in the course are teaching estimates.

references.title: European XFEL：光束線與波盪器

references.scopeEn: Magnetic lengths of SASE1, SASE2 (175 m) and SASE3 (105 m), 5 m segments with 1.1 m intersections, photon-energy ranges and the instruments served.

references.scopeEn: AGIPD 200 µm pixels, 352 memory cells, 4.5 MHz intra-train frame rate, three gain stages, 500 µm sensor and between-train readout.

references.title: IPAC2016：European XFEL 超導腔性能（Reschke）
references.titleEn: IPAC2016: Performance of Superconducting Cavities for the European XFEL (Reschke)

references.scopeEn: Official Japanese overview page: 8 GeV, roughly 1.5 km circumference, beamline count, and the planning statement for SPring-8-II and later upgrades.

references.title: 理研 SPring-8 中心：加速器硬體開發組
references.titleEn: RIKEN SPring-8 Center: Accelerator Hardware Development Group
references.scope: 說明維持 SPring-8 與 SACLA 穩定運轉、推動 SPring-8-II 降低發射度與提升亮度的研發任務。
references.scopeEn: Describes the R&D mission of keeping SPring-8 and SACLA running stably and driving SPring-8-II's emittance reduction and brightness increase.

references.title: J. Synchrotron Rad. 2024：SPring-8 的綠色升級
references.titleEn: J. Synchrotron Rad. 2024: Green upgrading of SPring-8
references.publisher: International Union of Crystallography (RIKEN / JASRI authors)
references.scope: 公開期刊論文：6 GeV 五彎消色散、裸發射度 111 pm 與阻尼扭擺後 50 pm、周長 1435.428 m、200 mA、SACLA 直接注入與約一年停機的規劃。
references.scopeEn: Open journal paper: 6 GeV five-bend achromat, 111 pm bare emittance and 50 pm with damping wigglers, 1435.428 m circumference, 200 mA, SACLA direct injection and the planned one-year blackout.

references.title: lightsources.org：SPring-8 設施頁

references.scopeEn: Facility summary on the light-source collaboration site, used only as background cross-reference.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
related.transfer: 可遷移「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」與「掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" and "Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程；SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射則以SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors; SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source centres on SASE gain, bunch compression, single-shot diagnostics and the LCLS-II superconducting upgrade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」與「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 超導加速腔製作

related.difference: 本課聚焦突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程；超導加速腔製作則以1.3 GHz 鈮九腔的 BCS 表面電阻、Q₀、材料與表面處理到低溫垂直測試的工程鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors; Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication centres on BCS surface resistance, Q₀, niobium material, surface treatment and 2 K vertical testing of 1.3 GHz nine-cell cavities, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」與「九腔鈮腔與 2 K 氦槽」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導加速腔製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「頻率、場平坦度與失諧預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and “Nine-cell niobium cavity and 2 K helium bath”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Superconducting accelerating-cavity fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Frequency, field flatness and the detuning budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transfer: 可遷移「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」與「雷射導引星、地表層修正與光點拉長」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文干涉儀光程控制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的薄主鏡、可變形副鏡、雷射導引星、干涉延遲線與 coudé 光譜整合；天文干涉儀光程控制則以VLTI 與 CHARA 延遲線、條紋追蹤與雷射計量如何把光程差控制在奈米等級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on thin primaries, deformable secondary, laser guide stars, interferometric delay lines and coudé spectroscopy across four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes; Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers centres on how VLTI and CHARA delay lines, fringe tracking and laser metrology hold optical-path difference at the nanometre level, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」與「基線向量與幾何延遲」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到天文干涉儀光程控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可見度損失預算與校正星」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: ALMA 天文台：天線技術頁
references.scope: 說明 54 座 12 m 與 12 座 7 m 天線、25 µm 面形精度、0.6″ 指向精度與運輸車重組；不含承包商設計細節。
references.scopeEn: Describes the 54 twelve-metre and 12 seven-metre antennas, 25 µm surface accuracy, 0.6″ pointing and transporter reconfiguration; no contractor design detail.

references.title: ESO：ALMA 望遠鏡頁
references.scope: 站址海拔 4576–5044 m、卡塞格林光學與經緯儀架台、基線與波長範圍的官方規格表。
references.scopeEn: Official specification table: site altitude 4576–5044 m, Cassegrain optics on alt-azimuth mounts, baseline and wavelength ranges.

references.title: NRAO：ALMA 望遠鏡頁
references.scope: 接收頻率 35–950 GHz、192 個天線基座、約 6600 m² 集光面積與各配置的角解析度範圍。
references.scopeEn: Receiver coverage 35–950 GHz, 192 antenna pads, about 6600 m² collecting area and the angular-resolution range of each configuration.

references.title: ALMA 天文台：接收機技術頁
references.scope: 說明 ALMA 前端以多個波段卡匣裝於單一低溫恆溫器、使用超導 SIS 混頻器與 4 K 冷卻的公開概述。
references.scopeEn: Public overview of the ALMA front end with multiple band cartridges in one cryostat, superconducting SIS mixers and 4 K cooling.

references.title: 綠堤天文台：GBT 接收機參考文件
references.titleEn: Green Bank Observatory: GBT receivers reference
references.scope: 列出 GBT 各波段接收機的頻率範圍、典型 Tsys 與校正方式；課程的 SEFD 數值為依其量級建立的教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Lists frequency ranges, typical Tsys and calibration methods of the GBT receivers; the course's SEFD values are teaching assumptions at the same order of magnitude.

references.title: Low Noise Factory：LNF-LNC4_8F_LG 低溫低雜訊放大器產品頁
references.titleEn: Low Noise Factory: LNF-LNC4_8F_LG cryogenic LNA product page
references.scope: 4–8 GHz 低溫 HEMT 放大器的公開規格頁（雜訊溫度、增益、功耗），作為 Friis 級聯第一級的量級參照。
references.scopeEn: Public specification page of a 4–8 GHz cryogenic HEMT amplifier (noise temperature, gain, dissipation), used as the order-of-magnitude reference for the Friis first stage.

references.title: 中研院天文所：ALMA Band 1 接收機新聞稿

references.publisher: Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics
references.scope: 台灣主導的 ALMA Band 1（35–50 GHz）接收機開發與交付的公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Public account of the Taiwan-led development and delivery of the ALMA Band 1 (35–50 GHz) receivers.

references.title: ALMA 天文台：相關器超級電腦就緒新聞稿
references.titleEn: ALMA Observatory: Supercomputer ready to make ALMA a powerful telescope
references.scope: 描述 64 天線相關器在 5000 m 操作站完成安裝、處理能力與基本架構的官方公開說明。
references.scopeEn: Official public account of the 64-antenna correlator's completion at the 5000 m operations site, its processing capacity and basic architecture.

references.title: NRAO：VLA 觀測狀態摘要之 WIDAR 相關器章節
references.titleEn: NRAO: VLA Observational Status Summary, WIDAR correlator
references.scope: 說明 WIDAR 的 3 位元與 8 位元取樣器頻寬、子頻帶與通道數限制、基線板配置與再循環模式。
references.scopeEn: Documents WIDAR's 3-bit and 8-bit sampler bandwidths, subband and channel limits, baseline-board layout and recirculation modes.

references.title: CASPER：電波天文訊號處理開源硬體與工具鏈

references.scope: 介紹 ROACH 等 FPGA 板、參數化韌體庫與封包化相關器設計，包括 FPGA F 引擎搭配 GPU X 引擎的案例。
references.scopeEn: Introduces FPGA boards such as ROACH, parameterised gateware libraries and packetised correlator designs, including an FPGA F-engine paired with a GPU X-engine.

references.title: Escoffier 等：The ALMA correlator（A&A 462, 801, 2007）
references.titleEn: Escoffier et al.: The ALMA correlator (A&A 462, 801, 2007)

references.scopeEn: Design paper by the construction team covering digital filter banks, the lag-correlator architecture, quantisation and observing modes.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
related.titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄鏡與主動光學的系統邏輯」與「波前量測：Shack–Hartmann 分析儀與模態分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why a thin mirror needs active optics" and "Wavefront sensing: the Shack–Hartmann analyser and modal decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Active support of telescope primary mirrors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦3.58 m 薄鏡主動光學望遠鏡：薄鏡支撐、Shack–Hartmann 波前量測、熱控圓頂與影像品質預算；望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐則以薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 3.58 m thin-mirror active-optics telescope: meniscus support, Shack–Hartmann wavefront sensing, thermally controlled enclosure and image-quality budgets; Active support of telescope primary mirrors centres on gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “3.58 m Zerodur meniscus” and “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Active support of telescope primary mirrors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.title: ESO 科學營運：NTT 望遠鏡頁

references.scopeEn: Alt-azimuth Ritchey–Chrétien design, two Nasmyth foci, the 1997 upgrade, pointing error of about 1.5″ RMS and current instruments (SOXS, EFOSC2, ULTRACAM).

references.title: EIE Group：NTT 旋轉圓頂專案頁
references.titleEn: EIE Group: NTT rotating-enclosure project page
references.scope: 承建商的專案紀錄：1986–1989 年旋轉與輔助建築的設計、製造與安裝，24 cm 厚 Zerodur 薄鏡與擋風網、百葉等圓頂系統。
references.scopeEn: Contractor project record: design, manufacture and erection of the rotating and auxiliary building in 1986–1989, the 24 cm Zerodur meniscus and enclosure systems such as the windscreen and louvres.

references.title: 維基百科：新技術望遠鏡
references.scope: 背景概覽與年表；僅作次要參考，技術數值以 ESO 官方頁為準。
references.scopeEn: Background overview and timeline; secondary reference only, technical values defer to ESO's official pages.

references.title: ESO：VLT 主動光學系統
references.titleEn: ESO: The VLT Active Optics System
references.scope: 說明 150 支軸向致動器、Shack–Hartmann 感測、約 30 秒積分、最高約 1 Hz 快速修正與副鏡修正離焦和彗差；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Describes the 150 axial actuators, Shack–Hartmann sensing, about 30 s integration, fast corrections up to about 1 Hz and secondary-mirror correction of focus and coma; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: ESO：VLT 主鏡製作與驗收資料
references.scope: 8.2 m Zerodur 鏡坯尺寸、膨脹係數、150 點支撐、f/1.8、主動模式下的波前與 Strehl 驗收數據，以及 SCHOTT 與 REOSC 的角色。
references.scopeEn: Dimensions, expansion coefficient, 150-point support, f/1.8, active-mode wavefront and Strehl acceptance data of the 8.2 m Zerodur blanks, and the roles of SCHOTT and REOSC.

references.title: ESO：主動光學技術說明

references.scopeEn: ESO's public explanation of active-optics principles and its first application on the NTT; overview, not a design manual.

references.title: 現代大型光學望遠鏡中的主動光學（回顧論文）
references.titleEn: Active Optics in Modern, Large Optical Telescopes
references.scope: 主動光學的彎曲模態、波前感測與控制架構的回顧論文，用於理解模態修正的工程邏輯。
references.scopeEn: Review of bending modes, wavefront sensing and control architecture in active optics, used for the engineering logic of modal correction.

references.title: ESO：VLT 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡
references.scope: 單元望遠鏡的 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計、副鏡五自由度、Cassegrain／Nasmyth／coudé 焦點、地平式機架與約 50 t 主鏡單元。
references.scopeEn: Ritchey–Chrétien design of the Unit Telescopes, five-degree-of-freedom secondary, Cassegrain, Nasmyth and coudé foci, alt-azimuth mount and the roughly 50 t primary-mirror unit.

references.title: ESO：VLT 可變形副鏡

related.title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
related.transfer: 可遷移「3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度」與「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；重力波干涉儀懸吊的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms" and "Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦3 km 干涉儀的低頻工程：超級衰減器、倒立擺、熱補償、牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與超高真空；重力波干涉儀懸吊則以四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low-frequency engineering of a 3 km interferometer: superattenuator, inverted pendulum, thermal compensation, Newtonian noise, Newtonian calibrator and ultra-high vacuum; Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions centres on isolation transfer function of quadruple-pendulum suspensions, fused-silica fibre thermal noise and damping-control engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」與「地面震動與測試質量」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到重力波干涉儀懸吊，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” and “Ground motion and the test mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
related.transfer: 可遷移「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」與「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" and "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Radio-telescope low-noise receivers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦主動反射面即時拋物面成形、索驅饋源艙定位、19 波束接收與面形指向誤差預算；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機則以從饋源到低溫 HEMT／SIS 前端的雜訊溫度、Friis 級聯、校正與穩定度工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on active-reflector paraboloid forming, cable-driven feed-cabin positioning, 19-beam reception and surface and pointing error budgets; Radio-telescope low-noise receivers centres on noise temperature, Friis cascade, calibration and stability engineering from feed horn to cryogenic HEMT/SIS front end, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」與「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” and “System noise temperature Tsys”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Radio-telescope low-noise receivers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列
related.transfer: 可遷移「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」與「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" and "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦主動反射面即時拋物面成形、索驅饋源艙定位、19 波束接收與面形指向誤差預算；ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列則以5000 公尺高原上 66 座天線的毫米波干涉成像：大氣、天線面形、SIS 接收機、水汽相位校正與相關器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on active-reflector paraboloid forming, cable-driven feed-cabin positioning, 19-beam reception and surface and pointing error budgets; Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array centres on millimetre interferometric imaging with 66 antennas at 5000 m: atmosphere, antenna surfaces, SIS receivers, water-vapour phase correction and the correlator, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」與「查南托高原大氣視窗」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” and “Chajnantor atmospheric window”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.publisher: National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences
references.scope: 營運機構的公開介紹，涵蓋喀斯特窪地台址、逾 4450 塊主動面板、六索輕型饋源艙與 2016 年第一道光。

references.scopeEn: Project team's design paper: 300 m-radius sphere, 300 m illuminated aperture, f/D 0.4665, 5 mm surface requirement, 40° zenith limit, six-cable feed and Stewart platform; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Jiang 等（2020）：FAST 搭配 19 波束 L 波段接收機的基本性能
references.titleEn: Jiang et al. (2020): The Fundamental Performance of FAST with 19-beam Receiver at L Band
references.publisher: arXiv / Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics
references.scope: 試運行量測：1.05–1.45 GHz、天頂角 26.4° 內口徑效率約 0.63、T_sys 低於 24 K、指向 7.9″、增益 3.5 小時內穩定度優於 1%。
references.scopeEn: Commissioning measurements: 1.05–1.45 GHz, aperture efficiency about 0.63 and T_sys below 24 K within 26.4° zenith angle, 7.9″ pointing and gain stability better than 1% over 3.5 hours.

references.title: 中國科學院：FAST 發現超過 1000 顆脈衝星

references.scopeEn: Official November 2024 news stating that FAST had found more than a thousand new pulsars, began formal operation in January 2020 and opened internationally in March 2021.

references.title: ALMA 天文台：接收機技術頁

references.title: Low Noise Factory：LNF-LNC4_8F_LG 低溫低雜訊放大器產品頁

references.title: ALMA 天文台：ALMA 概覽
