references.title: ALMA 天文台：天線技術頁

references.scopeEn: Official specification table: site altitude 4576–5044 m, Cassegrain optics on alt-azimuth mounts, baseline and wavelength ranges.

references.title: NRAO：ALMA 望遠鏡頁
references.scope: 接收頻率 35–950 GHz、192 個天線基座、約 6600 m² 集光面積與各配置的角解析度範圍。

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」與「風洞試驗的相似性與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" and "Similarity and Reynolds effects in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首座主跨超過 2,000 m 的懸索橋：垂跨比、1,960 MPa 鋼絲、隔震式沉箱基礎與雙箱梁抗風；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first suspension span beyond 2,000 m: sag ratio, 1,960 MPa wire, isolated caisson foundations and twin-box wind resistance; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」與「風洞試驗的相似性與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；里翁—安提里翁大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦首座主跨超過 2,000 m 的懸索橋：垂跨比、1,960 MPa 鋼絲、隔震式沉箱基礎與雙箱梁抗風；里翁—安提里翁大橋則以在 65 m 深海、軟弱沉積層與活動斷層上，以可滑移基礎與連續全懸吊橋面化解地震與構造位移為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first suspension span beyond 2,000 m: sag ratio, 1,960 MPa wire, isolated caisson foundations and twin-box wind resistance; Rion–Antirion Bridge centres on sliding foundations and a continuous fully suspended deck that absorb earthquakes and tectonic movement in 65 m of water on soft sediments, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」與「墩間相對位移」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” and “Relative pier movement”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rion–Antirion Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「以船舶撞擊風險決定主跨」與「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Setting the main span from ship-collision risk" and "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由船舶撞擊風險決定主跨、以封閉鋼箱梁與導流板處理渦振、以除濕延長主纜壽命的海峽懸索橋；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A strait suspension bridge whose span was set by ship-collision risk, whose box girder needed guide vanes against vortex shedding, and whose cables were dehumidified for long life; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「東航道船舶撞擊」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “East Channel ship impact” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」與「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；蘇通長江公路大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck" and "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sutong Yangtze River Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦颱風區千米跨斜張橋：分離雙箱梁氣動、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與混凝土背跨的整合；蘇通長江公路大橋則以長江口軟弱深厚地層上的 1,088 m 斜張橋：摩擦樁群、300 m 塔、阻尼限位體系與長索控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A typhoon-zone 1 km cable-stayed span: split twin-box aerodynamics, composite stainless monopole towers and concrete back spans; Sutong Yangtze River Bridge centres on A 1,088 m cable-stayed span on deep soft estuary ground: friction pile groups, 300 m towers, damper–limiter system and long-stay control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「中央開槽雙箱梁」與「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到蘇通長江公路大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「氣彈模型試驗與施工期抗風驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Split twin-box deck” and “Tower–deck viscous dampers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sutong Yangtze River Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aeroelastic model testing and construction-stage wind checks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Split twin-box deck” and “Deck-level design wind speed”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Spring-mounted section-model testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transfer: 可遷移「地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求」與「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；皇后渡口大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦在 65 m 深海、軟弱沉積層與活動斷層上，以可滑移基礎與連續全懸吊橋面化解地震與構造位移；皇后渡口大橋則以三塔斜張橋以跨中交叉斜索穩定中塔，並以防風屏障、監測與檢查通道確保蘇格蘭海灣的全天候營運為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sliding foundations and a continuous fully suspended deck that absorb earthquakes and tectonic movement in 65 m of water on soft sediments; Queensferry Crossing centres on A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墩間相對位移」與「中塔塔頂」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到皇后渡口大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Relative pier movement” and “Central tower head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Queensferry Crossing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」與「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；里翁—安提里翁大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system" and "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rion–Antirion Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦三塔斜張橋以跨中交叉斜索穩定中塔，並以防風屏障、監測與檢查通道確保蘇格蘭海灣的全天候營運；里翁—安提里翁大橋則以在 65 m 深海、軟弱沉積層與活動斷層上，以可滑移基礎與連續全懸吊橋面化解地震與構造位移為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service; Rion–Antirion Bridge centres on sliding foundations and a continuous fully suspended deck that absorb earthquakes and tectonic movement in 65 m of water on soft sediments, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「中塔塔頂」與「墩間相對位移」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到里翁—安提里翁大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Central tower head” and “Relative pier movement”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rion–Antirion Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦三塔斜張橋以跨中交叉斜索穩定中塔，並以防風屏障、監測與檢查通道確保蘇格蘭海灣的全天候營運；橋梁健康監測感測網則以從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「中塔塔頂」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Central tower head” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「上緣水線如何讓圓形斜索不穩定」與「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；伊拉斯謨大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How an upper rivulet destabilises a circular stay" and "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Erasmus Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水線氣動機制、史庫頓數、表面處理、阻尼器與交叉索，診斷並抑制斜索的雨風振動；伊拉斯謨大橋則以建築造型主導的單塔不對稱斜張橋：彎折鋼塔、背索、開合橋與通車後的斜索雨風振動為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagnosing and suppressing rain–wind stay vibration through rivulet aerodynamics, Scruton number, surface treatment, dampers and cross-ties; Erasmus Bridge centres on an architecture-led single-pylon asymmetric bridge: bent steel pylon, back stays, bascule span and post-opening rain–wind stay vibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上緣水線」與「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到伊拉斯謨大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Upper water rivulet” and “139 m bent steel pylon”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Erasmus Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagnosing and suppressing rain–wind stay vibration through rivulet aerodynamics, Scruton number, surface treatment, dampers and cross-ties; Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning centres on A closed loop of calculation and measurement for stay forces: target forces, influence matrices, equal-strand stressing, vibration measurement, acceptance and re-tuning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
related.transfer: 可遷移「金烈水道海況與荷載組合」與「脊背索索力量測與調整」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；港珠澳大橋橋梁段的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦在強海流、大潮差與花崗岩海床上，以脊背橋、全套管基樁與預鑄節塊完成跨海公路橋；港珠澳大橋橋梁段則以以 120 年設計壽命、大型化預製與颱風季風險管理，完成約 22.9 公里跨海橋梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a sea-crossing road bridge on granite under strong currents and large tides with an extradosed main bridge, cased bored piles and precast segments; Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works centres on delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「深槽區鋼套管」與「颱風與 120 年設計基準」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「風洞試驗與渦激振動」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deep-channel steel casing” and “Typhoon and 120-year design basis”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦在強海流、大潮差與花崗岩海床上，以脊背橋、全套管基樁與預鑄節塊完成跨海公路橋；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工則以以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a sea-crossing road bridge on granite under strong currents and large tides with an extradosed main bridge, cased bored piles and precast segments; Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction centres on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

references.scopeEn: First-hand review by a developer of precast segmental construction, including segment sizes and erection methods of early bridges such as Choisy-le-Roi.

references.title: WJE：Koror–Babeldaob 橋倒塌鑑定專案

references.title: Structurae：Bendorf 橋資料

references.scopeEn: Bridge database entry listing main span, depth range, construction period and the balanced-cantilever method; for further reading.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁頂推施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」與「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁頂推施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Valley wind and traffic safety" and "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Incremental bridge launching must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面；橋梁頂推施工則以以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley; Incremental bridge launching centres on launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面風屏」與「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁頂推施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支承高程偏差與反力量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck wind screens” and “Front cantilever moment with nose”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Incremental bridge launching, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support level deviations and reaction measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 皇后渡口大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」與「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；皇后渡口大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Valley wind and traffic safety" and "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Queensferry Crossing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面；皇后渡口大橋則以三塔斜張橋以跨中交叉斜索穩定中塔，並以防風屏障、監測與檢查通道確保蘇格蘭海灣的全天候營運為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley; Queensferry Crossing centres on A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面風屏」與「中塔塔頂」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到皇后渡口大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「防風屏障與高側車輛的行車安全」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck wind screens” and “Central tower head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Queensferry Crossing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind shielding and high-sided vehicle safety", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: Roads & Bridges：米約高架橋頂推設備報導

related.title: 大貝爾特東橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「零阻水要求與海峽環境」與「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大貝爾特東橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "The zero-blocking requirement" and "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Great Belt East Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在零阻水的環境約束下，以整跨預製與浮吊安裝完成公路鐵路雙層斜張橋；大貝爾特東橋則以由船舶撞擊風險決定主跨、以封閉鋼箱梁與導流板處理渦振、以除濕延長主纜壽命的海峽懸索橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint; Great Belt East Bridge centres on A strait suspension bridge whose span was set by ship-collision risk, whose box girder needed guide vanes against vortex shedding, and whose cables were dehumidified for long life, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋墩阻水斷面」與「東航道船舶撞擊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大貝爾特東橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pier blockage cross-section” and “East Channel ship impact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Great Belt East Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint; Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works centres on delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 厄勒海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「伶仃洋環境與設計基準」與「風洞試驗與渦激振動」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；厄勒海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Lingdingyang conditions and design basis" and "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oresund Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 120 年設計壽命、大型化預製與颱風季風險管理，完成約 22.9 公里跨海橋梁；厄勒海峽大橋則以在零阻水的環境約束下，以整跨預製與浮吊安裝完成公路鐵路雙層斜張橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management; Oresund Bridge centres on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「颱風與 120 年設計基準」與「橋墩阻水斷面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到厄勒海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Typhoon and 120-year design basis” and “Pier blockage cross-section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oresund Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management; Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments centres on sling geometry, dynamic amplification, floating stability and weather windows that bring thousand-tonne prefabricated segments safely from barge to pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Typhoon and 120-year design basis” and “Slings and spreader beam”.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones" and "Monitoring ice forces and response" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oresund Bridge must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on crossing the ice-covered Northumberland Strait with ice-shield cones, very large precast components and a 100-year durability design; Oresund Bridge centres on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「冰盾錐體」與「橋墩阻水斷面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到厄勒海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ice-shield cone” and “Pier blockage cross-section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oresund Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transfer: 可遷移「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」與「1932 年機車載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；新河峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" and "The 1932 locomotive load test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of New River Gorge Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港；新河峽大橋則以以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets; New River Gorge Bridge centres on spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

以「線形量測與溫度修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-hinged arch bearings” and “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to New River Gorge Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry surveys and temperature correction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」與「線形量測與溫度修正」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雪梨港灣大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch" and "Geometry surveys and temperature correction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sydney Harbour Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷；雪梨港灣大橋則以以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering; Sydney Harbour Bridge centres on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「兩鉸桁架拱推力」與「雙鉸拱支承」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雪梨港灣大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「1932 年機車載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” and “Two-hinged arch bearings”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sydney Harbour Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The 1932 locomotive load test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” and “System change at closure”.

related.title: 米約高架橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「交變彎矩與導梁的作用」與「支承高程偏差與反力量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；米約高架橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
related.transfer: 可遷移「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復則以由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes; Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair centres on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」與「蓋板端部焊趾」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and “Cover-plate end weld toe”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
related.transfer: 可遷移「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of UHPC bridge-deck closure joints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面；橋面超高性能混凝土接縫則以以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes; UHPC bridge-deck closure joints centres on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」與「接縫介面彎曲應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋面超高性能混凝土接縫，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「材料驗收試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and “Joint-interface flexural stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to UHPC bridge-deck closure joints, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Material acceptance testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁轉體施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」與「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁轉體施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move" and "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bridge rotation construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋；橋梁轉體施工則以以球鉸承壓、重心平衡、摩擦力矩與牽引控制，把在障礙物旁建好的萬噸級橋體安全轉到設計軸線為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours; Bridge rotation construction centres on spherical-hinge bearing, centre-of-gravity balance, friction torque and traction control that swing a structure of thousands of tonnes from beside an obstacle onto its design axis, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」與「轉動 T 構與跨越線」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “SPMT support points and overhangs” and “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge rotation construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pre-rotation weighing test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合
related.transfer: 可遷移「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」與「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築模組化吊裝與接合的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move" and "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋；建築模組化吊裝與接合則以以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours; Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections centres on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」與「角柱與雙層樓板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “SPMT support points and overhangs” and “Corner posts and double floors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮吊工法的系統與吊索傳力」與「吊重與重心的量測驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；聯邦大橋（加拿大）的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "System logic and sling load path" and "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Confederation Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以吊索幾何、動態放大、浮體穩定與天候窗口控制，把千噸級預製橋段從駁船安全吊上橋墩；聯邦大橋（加拿大）則以以冰盾錐體、超大型預製構件與百年耐久設計，跨越冬季浮冰的諾森伯蘭海峽為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sling geometry, dynamic amplification, floating stability and weather windows that bring thousand-tonne prefabricated segments safely from barge to pier; Confederation Bridge centres on crossing the ice-covered Northumberland Strait with ice-shield cones, very large precast components and a 100-year durability design, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「吊索與吊梁」與「冰盾錐體」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到聯邦大橋（加拿大），標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「冰力與結構反應監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slings and spreader beam” and “Ice-shield cone”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confederation Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Monitoring ice forces and response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 球面支承安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「週期移轉與荷載路徑」與「原型試驗與量產試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；球面支承安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period shift and load path" and "Prototype and production testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Spherical bridge-bearing installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承；球面支承安裝則以以約束配置、轉角與摩擦力矩、預設偏移與灌漿墊層，讓球面支承如設計般轉動與滑動為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings; Spherical bridge-bearing installation centres on restraint layout, rotation and friction moment, presetting and bedding grout so a spherical bearing rotates and slides as designed, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震週期 T_eff」與「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到球面支承安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「型式試驗與出廠檢驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period T_eff” and “Fixed, guided and free layout”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Spherical bridge-bearing installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Type testing and factory inspection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transfer: 可遷移「週期移轉與荷載路徑」與「原型試驗與量產試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有建築基礎隔震改造的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period shift and load path" and "Prototype and production testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承；既有建築基礎隔震改造則以以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings; Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings centres on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震週期 T_eff」與「隔震層週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有建築基礎隔震改造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period T_eff” and “Isolated period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強則以以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse; FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers centres on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「超強度彎矩 M_o」與「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overstrength moment M_o” and “Three deficiencies of old piers”.

related.why: 可遷移「容量設計與破壞層級」與「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
related.transfer: 可遷移「容量設計與破壞層級」與「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鉛心橡膠支承隔震的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Quasi-static cyclic column testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌；鉛心橡膠支承隔震則以以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse; Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation centres on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「超強度彎矩 M_o」與「隔震週期 T_eff」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鉛心橡膠支承隔震，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗與量產試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overstrength moment M_o” and “Isolated period T_eff”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype and production testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: Fyfe FRP 案例：加州橋柱剪力補強（Caltrans 跨越橋）

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
related.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
related.transfer: 可遷移「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」與「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" and "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計則以以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength; Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers centres on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「舊橋墩三種缺陷」與「超強度彎矩 M_o」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋墩塑鉸韌性設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three deficiencies of old piers” and “Overstrength moment M_o”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quasi-static cyclic column testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
related.transfer: 可遷移「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」與「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有建築基礎隔震改造的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" and "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度；既有建築基礎隔震改造則以以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength; Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings centres on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「舊橋墩三種缺陷」與「隔震層週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有建築基礎隔震改造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three deficiencies of old piers” and “Isolated period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總沖刷深度三分量」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「模態識別與環境效應分離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three components of total scour” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Modal identification and environmental effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「材料驗收試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；自行式模組運輸車換橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Material acceptance testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of SPMT bridge replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水；自行式模組運輸車換橋則以以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接縫介面彎曲應力」與「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到自行式模組運輸車換橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and “SPMT support points and overhangs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SPMT bridge replacement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「材料驗收試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Material acceptance testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接縫介面彎曲應力」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
related.transfer: 可遷移「灌漿的功能與鋼腱腐蝕後果」與「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁預力鋼腱更換的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What grout does and the consequences of tendon corrosion" and "Grout testing and field mock-ups" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕；橋梁預力鋼腱更換則以在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades; Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement centres on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「灌漿的功能與鋼腱腐蝕後果」與「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工則以以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades; Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction centres on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼腱有效預力 P_e」與「墩頂變高度箱梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Tendon effective force P_e” and “Haunched box girder at the pier”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry survey and camber feedback", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷；預力混凝土孔道灌漿則以以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record; Prestressing-duct grouting centres on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and “Tendon effective force P_e”.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」與「全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of external tendons" and "Network-wide tendon survey and sampling" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；正交異性鋼橋面板製作的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Orthotropic steel deck fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期；正交異性鋼橋面板製作則以以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals; Orthotropic steel deck fabrication centres on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「蓋板端部焊趾」與「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到正交異性鋼橋面板製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Orthotropic steel deck fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and “Beam-flange CJP groove weld”.

related.transfer: 可遷移「監測目的決定量測項目」與「模態識別與環境效應分離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁基礎沖刷監測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策；橋梁基礎沖刷監測則以以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

related.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
related.transfer: 可遷移「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」與「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁健康監測感測網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" and "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以受控的車輛、人群與激振試驗量出實際動力放大、頻率與阻尼，並把結果轉成評等與舒適度決策；橋梁健康監測感測網則以從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measuring actual dynamic amplification, frequency and damping with controlled vehicle, crowd and shaker tests, and turning the results into rating and comfort decisions; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「動力放大係數」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁健康監測感測網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模態識別與環境效應分離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dynamic amplification factor” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Modal identification and environmental effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a triangular tubular steel truss, an independent concrete central column with oil dampers and knuckle-wall foundations carry a 634 m broadcasting tower; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 威利斯大樓
related.transfer: 可遷移「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威利斯大樓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Willis Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統；威利斯大樓則以九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness; Willis Tower centres on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「削角錐形體量」與「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威利斯大樓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「經驗週期公式與實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Chamfered tapering massing” and “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Willis Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Empirical period formulas versus measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計則以以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness; Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design centres on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「削角錐形體量」與「局部破壞範圍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到結構抗連鎖倒塌設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Chamfered tapering massing” and “Extent of local damage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」與「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心筒與八根巨柱」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core and eight mega-columns” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load; Bundled-tube tall-building systems centres on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" and "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在填海地盤與颱風環境中，以核心筒、八根巨柱、四道外伸臂與摩擦型壁樁支撐 484 m 塔樓；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on supporting a 484 m tower on reclaimed land in a typhoon climate with a core, eight mega-columns, four outrigger levels and friction barrettes; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凹角方形平面」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Notched square plan” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築施工階段結構分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction-stage structural analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工；建築施工階段結構分析則以依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mixed zoning of steel offices, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes and a steel crown, built with a top-down core; Construction-stage structural analysis centres on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「用途分區與樓板質量」與「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築施工階段結構分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「施工測量的溫度效應修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Use zoning and floor mass” and “One-step versus staged loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction-stage structural analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature correction of construction surveys", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工；跨層轉換桁架施工則以把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Use zoning and floor mass” and “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Multi-storey transfer-truss construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 台北 101
related.transfer: 可遷移「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」與「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台北 101的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How outriggers restrain core rotation" and "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei 101 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂；台北 101則以以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers; Taipei 101 centres on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」與「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北 101，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” and “Sawtooth corner notches”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

Using "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 束筒高層結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；束筒高層結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bundled-tube tall-building systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斜柱軸力同時抵抗重力與側力的斜交網格：斜角取捨、樓板環向繫材、節點、施工幾何與耐火維護；束筒高層結構系統則以把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagrids that carry gravity and lateral load through diagonal axial force: angle trade-offs, floor hoop ties, nodes, erection geometry and fire upkeep; Bundled-tube tall-building systems centres on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「斜柱角度」與「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diagonal angle” and “Shear lag in a framed tube”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bundled-tube tall-building systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 威利斯大樓
related.transfer: 可遷移「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」與「邊界層風洞試驗與束筒外形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威利斯大樓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps" and "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Willis Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒；威利斯大樓則以九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles; Willis Tower centres on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「框架筒剪力滯後」與「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威利斯大樓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「經驗週期公式與實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Willis Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Empirical period formulas versus measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and “Diagonal angle”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-rise diagrid structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
related.transfer: 可遷移「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「環境振動量測與系統識別」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液態調諧阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned liquid dampers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內；液態調諧阻尼器則以以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits; Tuned liquid dampers centres on sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頂層樓板加速度」與「屋頂水槽群」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

related.transfer: 可遷移「風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型」與「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper" and "Froude similitude and model testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器則以以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits; Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings centres on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「屋頂水槽群」與「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「環境振動量測與系統識別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rooftop tank array” and “Top-floor acceleration”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
