related.title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
related.titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
related.transfer: 可遷移「附加阻尼的性能目標」與「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Performance targets for supplemental damping" and "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器則以以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping; Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings centres on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「附加阻尼比」與「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築調諧質量阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「環境振動量測與系統識別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Supplemental damping ratio” and “Top-floor acceleration”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transfer: 可遷移「縮短的三個來源」與「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築施工階段結構分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Three sources of shortening" and "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction-stage structural analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償；建築施工階段結構分析則以依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback; Construction-stage structural analysis centres on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」與「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” and “One-step versus staged loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction-stage structural analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
related.transfer: 可遷移「一次加載模型的假想內力」與「施工測量的溫度效應修正」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築差異縮短補償的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fictitious forces from one-step loading" and "Temperature correction of construction surveys" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機；高層建築差異縮短補償則以預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states; Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings centres on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「一次加載與逐層加載」與「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築差異縮短補償，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “One-step versus staged loading” and “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」與「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through a transfer truss" and "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on members, joints, erection, camber, de-propping and inspection when one- to three-storey trusses carry upper column loads onto columns or mega-columns below; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「從自由曲面到球面解」與「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "From free-form sails to the spherical solution" and "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Thin-shell concrete roof construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱、環氧接縫與後拉預力，把自由造型的帆形屋殼變成可製造、可架設的結構；薄殼混凝土屋頂施工則以以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on precast rib arches cut from one sphere, epoxy joints and post-tensioning that turned free-form sails into a buildable structure; Thin-shell concrete roof construction centres on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「75 m 共同球面」與「薄膜內力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到薄殼混凝土屋頂施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Common 75 m sphere” and “Membrane forces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Thin-shell concrete roof construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A portalised steel roof of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, its nodes, falsework and staged unloading; Retractable stadium roofs centres on treating thousand-tonne moving roof panels as combined structure and machinery: wheel loads, drives, skew and operating wind limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「12 m 深主桁架網」與「運轉風速門檻」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “12 m deep primary truss grid” and “Operating wind limit”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Retractable stadium roofs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Commissioning, first operation and travel-time acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
related.transfer: 可遷移「跨越三座獨立塔樓的平台」與「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大跨度空間桁架提升的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "A platform spanning three independent towers" and "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lifting of long-span space trusses must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦橫跨三座獨立擺動塔樓、離地約 200 m 的鋼構平台，及其 66.5 m 懸臂、滑動支承與鋼絞線千斤頂提升；大跨度空間桁架提升則以在地面組裝大跨度鋼屋蓋後，以鋼絞線千斤頂或頂升機構整體提升，並控制吊點反力、同步誤差、塔架穩定與就位轉換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A steel platform about 200 m up across three independently swaying towers: its 66.5 m cantilever, sliding bearings and strand-jack lifting; Lifting of long-span space trusses centres on ground-assembling long-span steel roofs and lifting them whole by strand jacks or push-up, controlling lift-point reactions, synchronisation, tower stability and final transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「三塔相對變位」與「地面組裝與整體提升」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「試提升、重量核對與變形量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Relative movement of three towers” and “Ground assembly and integral lift”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lifting of long-span space trusses, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦橫跨三座獨立擺動塔樓、離地約 200 m 的鋼構平台，及其 66.5 m 懸臂、滑動支承與鋼絞線千斤頂提升；吉隆坡雙子星塔則以高強度混凝土管中管、可隨兩塔移動的雙鉸拱空橋，以及喀斯特地質上的深樁筏基為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「三塔相對變位」與「核心筒與周邊柱環」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Relative movement of three towers” and “Core and perimeter column ring”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Petronas Twin Towers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" and "Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護；張拉膜屋蓋成形則以由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep; Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs centres on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

把本課算例的一個假設移到張拉膜屋蓋成形，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Radial net and 12 masts” and “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 索網屋蓋張拉
related.transfer: 可遷移「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」與「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；索網屋蓋張拉的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets" and "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cable-net roof tensioning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 75 cm 等網目鞍形索網、邊索、桅桿與 3 × 3 m 壓克力板構成的 1972 年奧運帳篷屋蓋，及其形狀計算、張拉與保存；索網屋蓋張拉則以以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the 1972 Olympic tent roof of saddle-shaped cable nets with a uniform 75 cm mesh, edge cables, masts and 3 × 3 m acrylic panels: shape computation, tensioning and conservation; Cable-net roof tensioning centres on giving cable nets stiffness through prestress: tensioning strategies for saddle nets and spoked wheels, dual force–geometry control, frequency checks and long-term force management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鞍形索網曲面」與「預拉力與幾何勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” and “Prestress and geometric stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cable-net roof tensioning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ground-assembling long-span steel roofs and lifting them whole by strand jacks or push-up, controlling lift-point reactions, synchronisation, tower stability and final transfer; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark centres on A steel platform about 200 m up across three independently swaying towers: its 66.5 m cantilever, sliding bearings and strand-jack lifting, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地面組裝與整體提升」與「三塔相對變位」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「提升過程的荷載、水平度與風速監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ground assembly and integral lift” and “Relative movement of three towers”.

Using "Monitoring load, levelness and wind during lifts", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋
related.transfer: 可遷移「索網的勁度來自預拉力與曲率」與「以振動頻率量測索力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cable-net stiffness comes from prestress and curvature" and "Measuring cable force from vibration frequency" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Munich Olympic Stadium roof must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理；慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋則以以 75 cm 等網目鞍形索網、邊索、桅桿與 3 × 3 m 壓克力板構成的 1972 年奧運帳篷屋蓋，及其形狀計算、張拉與保存為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on giving cable nets stiffness through prestress: tensioning strategies for saddle nets and spoked wheels, dual force–geometry control, frequency checks and long-term force management; Munich Olympic Stadium roof centres on the 1972 Olympic tent roof of saddle-shaped cable nets with a uniform 75 cm mesh, edge cables, masts and 3 × 3 m acrylic panels: shape computation, tensioning and conservation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「預拉力與幾何勁度」與「鞍形索網曲面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「從 Frei Otto 實體模型到迭代電腦計算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Prestress and geometric stiffness” and “Saddle-shaped net surfaces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Munich Olympic Stadium roof, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "From Frei Otto's physical models to iterative computation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦把會移動的千噸級屋面板當成結構與機械的組合，控制輪壓、驅動、偏斜與運轉風速；大跨度空間桁架提升則以在地面組裝大跨度鋼屋蓋後，以鋼絞線千斤頂或頂升機構整體提升，並控制吊點反力、同步誤差、塔架穩定與就位轉換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

related.title: 雪梨歌劇院
related.transfer: 可遷移「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」與「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雪梨歌劇院的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell form and membrane action" and "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sydney Opera House must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制；雪梨歌劇院則以以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱、環氧接縫與後拉預力，把自由造型的帆形屋殼變成可製造、可架設的結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control; Sydney Opera House centres on precast rib arches cut from one sphere, epoxy joints and post-tensioning that turned free-form sails into a buildable structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄膜內力」與「75 m 共同球面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雪梨歌劇院，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Membrane forces” and “Common 75 m sphere”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sydney Opera House, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control; Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs centres on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 哈里發塔
related.transfer: 可遷移「高程泵送的壓力組成」與「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；哈里發塔的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" and "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Burj Khalifa must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把黏稠的高強度混凝土推上數百公尺：靜壓、管壁摩擦、輸送管強度、可泵性與連續供料；哈里發塔則以扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pushing viscous high-strength concrete hundreds of metres up: static head, wall friction, pipeline strength, pumpability and continuous supply; Burj Khalifa centres on how a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「泵送壓力需求」與「Y 形扶壁核心」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到哈里發塔，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pump pressure demand” and “Y-shaped buttressed core”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Burj Khalifa, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」與「超音波與相位陣列檢測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度螺栓預拉力施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" and "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以焊接程序、預熱與熱輸入控制、施工停留點與非破壞檢測，確保厚板全滲透焊接頭能承受設計力與地震、疲勞需求；高強度螺栓預拉力施工則以以夾緊力、接觸面等級、預拉方法與安裝前驗證，確保摩擦型與預拉接頭在施工及數十年使用中保持設計夾緊力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on securing thick-plate complete-joint-penetration joints for design, seismic and fatigue demands through procedures, preheat and heat-input control, hold points and nondestructive testing; Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts centres on securing design clamping force in slip-critical and pretensioned joints through clamp force, faying-surface class, pretensioning method and pre-installation verification, during construction and decades of service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」與「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高強度螺栓預拉力施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「安裝前驗證試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” and “Clamp force and slip coefficient”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pre-installation verification testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” and “Cover-plate end weld toe”.

related.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「組合梁的水平剪力流」與「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度螺栓預拉力施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" and "Visual, ring and replacement checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以剪力流計算、穿板焊接條件控制、首件彎曲試驗與推出試驗，確保鋼梁與混凝土樓板真正組合受力；高強度螺栓預拉力施工則以以夾緊力、接觸面等級、預拉方法與安裝前驗證，確保摩擦型與預拉接頭在施工及數十年使用中保持設計夾緊力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests; Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts centres on securing design clamping force in slip-critical and pretensioned joints through clamp force, faying-surface class, pretensioning method and pre-installation verification, during construction and decades of service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」與「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Beam–slab interface shear” and “Clamp force and slip coefficient”.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests; Structural-steel fireproofing application centres on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」與「附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；懸索橋主纜除濕系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" and "Adhesion and film-defect testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Suspension-cable dehumidification systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦依腐蝕環境選擇塗裝系統，以表面處理、露點與膜厚控制施工品質，並以狀態評估決定局部修補或全面重塗；懸索橋主纜除濕系統則以以露點、流路壓降、包覆氣密、除濕機容量與生命週期決策，設計並驗證主纜乾燥空氣系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on selecting coating systems by corrosivity, controlling quality through surface preparation, dew point and film thickness, and using condition surveys to choose spot repair or full repainting; Suspension-cable dehumidification systems centres on designing and verifying main-cable dry-air systems through dew point, flow-path pressure drop, wrap airtightness, dehumidifier capacity and life-cycle decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」與「主纜內部露點」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到懸索橋主纜除濕系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「感測器網路與露點裕度判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” and “Dew point inside the cable”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Suspension-cable dehumidification systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sensor network and dew-point margin", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「異常荷載與不成比例倒塌」與「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse" and "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic connections for precast concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「局部破壞範圍」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Extent of local damage” and “Diaphragm connectors”.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌；高層建築消防分區設計則以以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse; Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings centres on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「局部破壞範圍」與「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Extent of local damage” and “Compartment floor area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
related.transfer: 可遷移「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」與「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鉛心橡膠支承隔震的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building" and "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷；鉛心橡膠支承隔震則以以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage; Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation centres on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震層週期」與「隔震週期 T_eff」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period” and “Isolated period T_eff”.

related.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」與「AISC 341 資格試驗與 ω、β 係數」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" and "AISC 341 qualification tests and the ω and β factors" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Viscous-damper performance verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心降伏力、層間變位換算的核心應變、安裝時機與配合誤差控制，確保挫屈束制支撐只在地震時才降伏耗能；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on core yield force, drift-to-core-strain conversion, installation timing and fit-up control that keep buckling-restrained braces yielding only in earthquakes; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「支撐核心降伏力」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黏滯阻尼器性能驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Brace core yield force” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre; Precast prestressed double-tee roofs centres on section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」與「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" and "Transfer checks and plant quality control" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic connections for precast concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斷面性質、預力反拱、缺口梁端、翼板連接器與吊裝連接完成度，確保雙 T 梁屋蓋從工廠到使用期間都可靠；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙 T 梁斷面」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄混凝土耐震接頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Double-tee section” and “Diaphragm connectors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic connections for precast concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" and "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計則以以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure; Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design centres on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「防火區劃面積」與「局部破壞範圍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到結構抗連鎖倒塌設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Compartment floor area” and “Extent of local damage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.scopeEn: Official inquiry report page with four volumes and an executive summary covering the fire's course, the exterior wall and evacuation strategy; the course cites only public conclusions.

references.title: NIST：世界貿易中心 7 號大樓調查常見問答
references.titleEn: NIST: WTC 7 investigation frequently asked questions
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 調查機關說明 WTC 7 的樓層數、倒塌時間、火災與熱膨脹導致 79 號柱失效的過程及建議；不含接頭設計細節。
references.scopeEn: Investigating agency's account of WTC 7 storeys, collapse time, the fire and thermal-expansion sequence that failed Column 79, and recommendations; no connection design details.

references.title: 維基百科：2021 年高雄城中城大樓火災（英文）
references.scope: 火災日期、建築規模、傷亡、起火位置與後續法規檢討的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the date, building size, casualties, origin and regulatory follow-up of the fire, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：One Meridian Plaza（英文）
references.scope: 1991 年火災的樓層、延燒範圍、灑水頭阻止火勢與立管壓力問題的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the 1991 fire's floors, extent of spread, sprinkler stop and standpipe pressure problems, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：Grenfell Tower 火災（英文）
references.scope: 建築規模、改裝外牆材料、火勢蔓延、避難策略與防火門問題的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of building size, refurbishment façade materials, fire spread, evacuation strategy and fire-door issues, for further reading.

references.title: NIST：依世界貿易中心調查建議通過的 ICC 建築與消防規範修訂
references.titleEn: NIST: Changes to ICC building and fire codes from the WTC investigation (FY 2008)
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 說明高層建築 SFRM 黏結強度提高的倍數、現場安裝要求與特別檢驗項目；不含個別產品資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes the multiples by which high-rise SFRM bond strength was raised, field-installation requirements and special-inspection items; no product data.

references.title: NIST：世界貿易中心樓板系統 UL 耐火試驗公開簡報
references.titleEn: NIST: Public briefing on UL fire resistance tests of the WTC floor system
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 列出樓板桁架被覆的原規定與升級厚度、實測平均與變異、四次 ASTM E119 試驗的跨度與等級。
references.scopeEn: Lists the original and upgraded floor-truss fireproofing specifications, measured averages and variability, and the spans and ratings of four ASTM E119 tests.

references.title: AISC《現代鋼構》：耐火被覆厚度換算與 W/D 替代式
references.titleEn: AISC Modern Steel Construction: fire-protection thickness and the W/D substitution equation
references.scope: 說明梁替代式的形式、適用於非約束等級、最小厚度與 ASTM E119 梁溫度判準；課程數值另為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Explains the beam substitution equation, its limitation to unrestrained ratings, minimum thickness and ASTM E119 beam temperature criteria; course numbers are separate teaching assumptions.

references.title: SteelConstruction.info：紐約時報大樓外露鋼構防火案例
references.titleEn: SteelConstruction.info: The New York Times Building fire protection case study

references.scope: 外露鋼構面積、環氧膨脹漆塗膜厚度、耐火時效要求與樣品試驗的公開案例說明。
references.scopeEn: Public case description of exposed steel area, epoxy intumescent film thickness, rating requirement and mock-up trials.

references.title: New Steel Construction：馬德里溫莎大樓火災的教訓
references.titleEn: New Steel Construction: Lessons from Madrid
references.scope: 溫莎大樓的結構組成、改修中未完成的外圍鋼柱被覆與局部崩塌經過；不含原始調查資料。
references.scopeEn: Structure of the Windsor Building, the unfinished perimeter-column protection retrofit and the partial collapse; no original investigation data.

references.title: NIST：Champlain Towers South 部分倒塌技術結論新聞稿
references.titleEn: NIST: Technical findings on what caused the 2021 Champlain Towers South partial collapse
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 說明穿孔剪力起始破壞、設計與施工偏差、增加荷載與腐蝕的影響及倒塌順序；最終報告與建議尚待發布。
references.scopeEn: Describes the initiating punching shear failure, design and construction deviations, added loads and corrosion, and the collapse sequence; the final report and recommendations are still to come.

references.title: WBDG：UFC 4-023-03 建築物抗連鎖倒塌設計（2016 年第 3 次修訂）
references.titleEn: WBDG: UFC 4-023-03 Design of Buildings to Resist Progressive Collapse, Change 3 (2016)
references.publisher: US Department of Defense via Whole Building Design Guide
references.scope: 設計準則全文，含風險類別、拉結力公式、0.20 rad 轉角要求與替代路徑程序；課程只引用公式型式。
references.scopeEn: Full design criteria with risk categories, tie-force equations, the 0.20 rad rotation requirement and alternate-path procedures; the course quotes only the form of the equations.

references.title: NIST：降低建築物連鎖倒塌潛勢的最佳實務（NISTIR 7396）
references.titleEn: NIST: Best Practices for Reducing the Potential for Progressive Collapse in Buildings (NISTIR 7396)
references.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.scope: 說明風險架構、拉結力、局部抵抗與替代路徑三種方法，以及各國規範回顧與案例。
references.scopeEn: Describes the risk framework, the tie-force, specific local resistance and alternate-path methods, a review of national standards and case studies.

references.title: 維基百科：Ronan Point（英文）
references.scope: Ronan Point 倒塌經過、調查結論與英國法規變更的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the Ronan Point collapse, inquiry findings and UK regulatory changes, for further reading.

related.transfer: 可遷移「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」與「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築消防分區設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" and "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以臨界溫度、斷面係數與現場厚度、密度、黏結抽驗，確保鋼構件在火害中維持設計耐火時效；高層建築消防分區設計則以以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance; Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings centres on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼構件臨界溫度」與「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築消防分區設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical steel temperature” and “Compartment floor area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" and "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Protective coating of large steel structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以臨界溫度、斷面係數與現場厚度、密度、黏結抽驗，確保鋼構件在火害中維持設計耐火時效；大型鋼構防蝕塗裝則以依腐蝕環境選擇塗裝系統，以表面處理、露點與膜厚控制施工品質，並以狀態評估決定局部修補或全面重塗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance; Protective coating of large steel structures centres on selecting coating systems by corrosivity, controlling quality through surface preparation, dew point and film thickness, and using condition surveys to choose spot repair or full repainting, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical steel temperature” and “ISO 12944 corrosivity category”.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」與「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" and "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以玻璃肋的面內彎曲、側向扭轉挫屈、膠合中間膜耦合與破損後承載，控制全玻璃立面的設計、吊裝與驗收；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on in-plane bending, lateral–torsional buckling, interlayer coupling and post-breakage capacity that govern the design, lifting and acceptance of all-glass façades; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fin tributary wind load” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」與「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" and "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以腔體熱平衡、浮力通風、外層支撐結構與防火排煙整合，讓雙層幕牆在節能、舒適與安全間取得平衡；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavity heat balance, buoyancy ventilation, outer-skin support and fire and smoke integration that balance energy, comfort and safety in double-skin façades; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風腔體熱平衡」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cavity heat balance” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 高層建築消防分區設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」與「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築消防分區設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" and "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以腔體熱平衡、浮力通風、外層支撐結構與防火排煙整合，讓雙層幕牆在節能、舒適與安全間取得平衡；高層建築消防分區設計則以以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavity heat balance, buoyancy ventilation, outer-skin support and fire and smoke integration that balance energy, comfort and safety in double-skin façades; Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings centres on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風腔體熱平衡」與「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築消防分區設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cavity heat balance” and “Compartment floor area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 建築雷射掃描竣工比對
related.transfer: 可遷移「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」與「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築雷射掃描竣工比對的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" and "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Laser-scan verification of as-built construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突；建築雷射掃描竣工比對則以以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction; Laser-scan verification of as-built construction centres on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「天花板內管線空間」與「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築雷射掃描竣工比對，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ceiling service void” and “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Laser-scan verification of as-built construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；工程數位模型碰撞檢查的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of BIM-based construction clash detection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；工程數位模型碰撞檢查則以以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; BIM-based construction clash detection centres on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「天花板內管線空間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到工程數位模型碰撞檢查，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Ceiling service void”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to BIM-based construction clash detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 施工測量控制網
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；施工測量控制網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction surveying control networks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；施工測量控制網則以以誤差預算、坐標系統、穩定控制點與統計平差，讓放樣、貫通與監測都建立在可信的基準上為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; Construction surveying control networks centres on error budgets, coordinate systems, stable control points and statistical adjustment that give set-out, breakthrough and monitoring a trustworthy reference, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「主控制網」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到施工測量控制網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Primary control network”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction surveying control networks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；自行式模組運輸車換橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of SPMT bridge replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築；自行式模組運輸車換橋則以以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「服務邊界與路線代價」與「設備備援與共同失效」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英法海底隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Equipment redundancy and common failure" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Channel Tunnel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦火災系統邊界、既有襯砌與跨境協作；英法海底隧道則以主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fire-system boundaries, existing lining and cross-border coordination; Channel Tunnel centres on running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「路線里程與端點」與「測壓水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英法海底隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疏散時間與分區可用性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and “Piezometric head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Channel Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Evacuation time and zone availability", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「地下儲存與地面介面」與「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英法海底隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" and "Storage capacity and product inventory" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Channel Tunnel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦岩洞楔體、水力封存與產品庫存；英法海底隧道則以主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavern wedges, hydraulic containment and product inventory; Channel Tunnel centres on running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「幾何等效面積」與「測壓水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英法海底隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疏散時間與分區可用性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Geometric equivalent area” and “Piezometric head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Channel Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Evacuation time and zone availability", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋
related.transfer: 可遷移「覆土重量基準」與「彈性各向異性」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；孔內電視與裂隙判釋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Overburden stress baseline" and "Elastic anisotropy" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型；孔內電視與裂隙判釋則以以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model; Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation centres on interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「覆土重量基準」與「光學與聲學互補」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到孔內電視與裂隙判釋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「裂隙組與取樣偏差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overburden stress baseline” and “Optical and acoustic complementarity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Joint sets and sampling bias", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 掌子面攝影測量
related.transfer: 可遷移「總應力與有效應力」與「停機與壓力演變」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；掌子面攝影測量的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Total and effective stress" and "Standstill and pressure evolution" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel-face photogrammetry must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型；掌子面攝影測量則以以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence; Tunnel-face photogrammetry centres on reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總應力與有效應力」與「像素尺度與可見細節」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掌子面攝影測量，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「重投影與獨立精度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Total and effective stress” and “Pixel scale and visible detail”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel-face photogrammetry, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Reprojection versus independent accuracy", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.title: 擠壓性地層讓壓支護
related.transfer: 可遷移「彈性能與釋放比例」與「串聯力鏈與容量區分」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；擠壓性地層讓壓支護的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" and "Serial force paths and capacity distinctions" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Yielding support in squeezing ground must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求；擠壓性地層讓壓支護則以把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty; Yielding support in squeezing ground centres on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性能與釋放比例」與「應力強度比與初篩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到擠壓性地層讓壓支護，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” and “Stress-strength ratio and screening”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Yielding support in squeezing ground, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Shotcrete slots and local crushing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道湧水排導系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「礦物反應與含水條件」與「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道湧水排導系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” and “Groundwater and process-water balance”.

Using "Blockage sensitivity and maintenance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 沉管基床整平
related.transfer: 可遷移「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；沉管基床整平的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Permanent slabs as early braces" and "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載；沉管基床整平則以以海床幾何、接觸壓力與沉陷驗證沉管基床為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls; Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling centres on verify immersed-tunnel bedding through seabed geometry, contact pressure and settlement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「溝槽斷面與開挖體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到沉管基床整平，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「高點接觸與局部壓力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Permanent slabs as early braces” and “Trench section and dredging volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "High-point contact and local pressure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 連續壁槽溝穩定
related.transfer: 可遷移「相變熱量的機理與驗證」與「凍脹差異的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；連續壁槽溝穩定的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦凍結壁閉合、地下水熱輸送與融沉控制；連續壁槽溝穩定則以穩定液壓差、槽壁滲透與連續壁接頭品質為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on frozen-wall closure, groundwater heat transport and thaw settlement; Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls centres on slurry pressure balance, trench permeability and diaphragm-wall joints, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「相變熱量」與「穩定液壓差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到連續壁槽溝穩定，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Latent heat” and “Slurry pressure margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 砂井與垂直排水板

related.transfer: 可遷移「有效應力增量」與「沉陷壓密比例」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；砂井與垂直排水板的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on relate suction transfer, drainage capacity and unloading rebound to vacuum consolidation; Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains centres on radial drainage, smear effects and consolidation completion, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「有效應力增量」與「排水距離尺度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到砂井與垂直排水板，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「有效應力成長的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective stress increment” and “Drainage-length scale”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Effective-stress gain mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 管道原位固化內襯
related.transfer: 可遷移「閉合電流迴路」與「雜散電流電量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；管道原位固化內襯的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Closed current circuit" and "Stray current charge" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cured-in-place pipe lining must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈；管道原位固化內襯則以連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion; Cured-in-place pipe lining centres on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閉合電流迴路」與「剩餘厚度判讀」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到管道原位固化內襯，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水理容量比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Closed current circuit” and “Remaining thickness interpretation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cured-in-place pipe lining, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hydraulic capacity comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道耐震接頭設計

related.difference: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈；隧道耐震接頭設計則以以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion; Seismic tunnel-joint design centres on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閉合電流迴路」與「波傳軸向應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道耐震接頭設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斷層變形帶需求」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Closed current circuit” and “Wave induced axial strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic tunnel-joint design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fault deformation band demand", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
